4762d32a.description:
#### **Job ID**

67404

#### **Work Style**

Hybrid Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

#### **Department**

Technology

#### **Job Type**

Full Time

#### **Date Posted**

19 November 2026

21 November 2026

Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture

Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.

What you'll be doing

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale

If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
www.hsbc.com/careers

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

4d5efe85.title: Technical Architect
4d5efe85.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**1. Executive Summary & Role Purpose**

The **Technical Architect – Banking as a Service (BaaS)** will serve as the technical authority and architectural designer for our next-generation BaaS and Embedded Finance platform. In this role, you will define the end-to-end architecture enabling third-party fintechs, enterprise platforms, and digital ecosystems to consume core banking services—such as digital accounts, payments, card issuing, lending, and compliance services—via secure, highly scalable, and developer-friendly APIs.

You will bridge the gap between high-level business strategy and deep technical execution, designing resilient multi-tenant architectures, modernizing integration with core banking ledgers, and ensuring rigorous security, operational resilience, and regulatory compliance.

**2. Key Responsibilities & Scope of Work**

**Architectural Strategy & Solution Design**

* **Platform Architecture:** Architect, design, and govern enterprise-grade, multi-tenant BaaS platforms capable of handling ultra-low latency, high-throughput financial transactions with 99.999% availability.
* **API-First & Ecosystem Design:** Drive comprehensive API lifecycle standards (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC), establishing developer portal architectures, SDK generation, sandboxes, and webhook event-distribution systems.
* **Domain-Driven Design (DDD):** Decompose complex banking domains (Accounts, Ledgering, Clearing, Payments, FX, Cards, Lending) into decoupled, bounded-context microservices and event-driven choreographies.
* **Modern Integration Patterns:** Design integration layers between modern cloud-native service fabrics and mission-critical legacy core banking platforms, payment gateways, and clearing networks (FedNow, RTP, ACH, SEPA, SWIFT / ISO 20022).

**Security, Governance & Regulatory Compliance**

* **Regulatory & Compliance by Design:** Ensure all architectural patterns strictly comply with local regulations, sanctions screening and regional financial authority guidelines.
* **Auditing & Immutability:** Design comprehensive audit logging, data lineage, idempotency mechanisms, and non-repudiation systems across all customer- and partner-facing touchpoints.

**Scalability, Resilience & Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)**

* **High Availability & Disaster Recovery:** Architect multi-region, active-active cloud deployments with zero-data-loss recovery point objectives (RPO=0) and near-zero recovery time objectives (RTO~0).
* **Distributed Data Patterns:** Formulate data architectures incorporating Event Sourcing, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), distributed caching, and transactional outbox patterns.
* **Observability & SRE:** Define standards for distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), APM monitoring, distributed rate limiting, circuit breakers, and automated canary deployments.

**Technical Leadership & Partner Enablement**

* **Engineering Guidance:** Mentor principal engineers and tech leads, providing hands-on architectural blueprints, sequence flows, proof-of-concept (PoC) implementations, and RFC reviews.
* **Architecture Governance:** Lead the BaaS Technical Design Authority (TDA) and Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews.
* **Technical Partner Advisory:** Collaborate with product managers, developer advocates, and key enterprise partner architects during technical pre-sales and platform integration phases.

**3. Required Technical Experience & Domain Expertise**

**Architectural Paradigms :** Microservices Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), Domain-Driven Design (DDD), CQRS, Event Sourcing, Multi-Tenancy Isolation, Hexagonal / Clean Architecture.

**Core Banking & BaaS :** Embedded Banking, Account Issuance, Virtual IBANs, Ledger Architecture, ISO 20022 messaging, KYC/AML orchestration.

**APIs & Integration :** RESTful APIs, Webhooks/EventSub, Apigee Gateway, Kafka

**Data & Storage :** Oracle DB

**Functional Expertise :** Payments, Banking as a Service, Payer IDs and Virtual Account capabilities.

**4. Candidate Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* **Professional Experience:** 12+ years of software engineering and architectural experience, with at least 4+ years dedicated to technical/solution architecture within Financial Services, Fintech, Neobanks, or BaaS ecosystems.
* **Proven Track Record:** Demonstrated experience in designing and launching production-scale, multi-tenant digital banking platforms, API platforms, or payment networks.
* **Preferred Certifications (Bonus)** Certified Cloud Architect (AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, GCP Professional Cloud Architect, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert) Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or TOGAF Certification

**5. Core Competencies & Soft Skills**

* **Systems Thinking:** Ability to evaluate trade-offs (e.g., latency vs. consistency, build vs. buy) across complex enterprise landscapes.
* **Strategic Communication:** Strong capability to articulate complex architectural concepts to both C-level executives and hands-on software engineers.
* **Pragmatic Innovation:** Focus on solving real-world customer problems with proven, resilient technologies rather than chasing ungrounded trends.
* **Mentorship & Culture:** Passion for coaching engineering talent and fostering a high-performance, quality-driven engineering culture.

79eadb3f.title: Solution Architect
79eadb3f.description:
**Position Title:**
Solution Architect
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
44959
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The HR Solution Architect operates at the intersection of HR strategy, process and experience design, enterprise data, and technology architecture. The role is the discipline-keeper for how HR ideas become solutions, ensuring that decisions begin with a clearly defined business problem and are evaluated through a consistent, evidence-based solutioning approach.
  
  
This role evaluates the full range of pathways, including process redesign, native SaaS capability, AI agents and automation, enterprise data platforms, API integration, custom applications, and hybrid approaches. It is platform-agnostic and vendor-neutral, with accountability for recommending solutions that are valuable, scalable, secure, responsible, human-centered, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
The HR Solution Architect is a bridge role, not a platform administrator and not a pure enterprise architect. The role translates business needs into end-to-end workflows and architecture choices, builds the case for the recommended approach, and guides the solution through architecture, data, security, privacy, legal, and delivery governance. The role must communicate with equal credibility in an HR leadership discussion and a technical architecture review.
  
  
**Guiding principle: Start with the business problem and the work to be redesigned, not the technology.**
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Problem-First Solution Design
  
  
Lead structured discovery, blueprinting, and solution design engagements that define the business problem, intended outcomes, user needs, process constraints, data needs, and value measures before identifying technology options.
  
  
Evaluate process redesign, native SaaS capability, AI or agentic solutions, enterprise data platforms, custom applications, integrations, and hybrid approaches using a consistent framework for fit, value, risk, complexity, security, data readiness, and change impact.
  
  
Create clear solution recommendations, decision records, target-state designs, and business cases that explain why the selected path is preferred and what trade-offs were considered.
  
  
Dynamic Work and Experience Design
  
  
Analyze HR services and workflows end to end before recommending technology.
  
  
Map employee, candidate, manager, HR, and shared-service experiences across process steps, handoffs, channels, decisions, controls, and data flows.
  
  
Distinguish work that requires human judgment, empathy, accountability, or exception handling from work suited to automation or AI-led execution.
  
  
Design human-in-the-loop controls and escalation paths, especially where outcomes may materially affect employees or candidates.
  
  
AI Solutioning, Experimentation, and Orchestration
  
  
Assess AI opportunities across HR with practical rigor and responsible experimentation.
  
  
Determine whether a use case is best addressed through human-process redesign, embedded HCM AI, enterprise AI capabilities, third-party agents, internally developed agents, or a combination.
  
  
Define time-boxed proofs of concept with explicit success measures, data boundaries, security reviews, user validation, monitoring, and exit criteria before broader deployment.
  
  
Evaluate agent behavior and solution risks, including incorrect or fabricated outputs, bias, confidentiality, inappropriate autonomy, control failure, and performance drift.
  
  
Design how agents, applications, people, and data services work together across an end-to-end HR experience.
  
  
Integration and Interface Architecture
  
  
Own and evolve the integrated architecture for HR applications, data services, APIs, interfaces, events, automations, and agents.
  
  
Define solution patterns for secure interoperability, data exchange, orchestration, exception handling, observability, and lifecycle management.
  
  
Ensure proposals align with enterprise architecture, cyber security, privacy, identity, integration, infrastructure, and data standards.
  
  
Promote reusable interfaces and services that reduce duplication, point-to-point complexity, and vendor lock-in.
  
  
HR Data Governance and Responsible AI
  
  
Be a core architecture voice for protection and responsible use of employee and candidate data.
  
  
Embed privacy, security, data minimization, access control, retention, transparency, auditability, and regulatory requirements into solution design from the start.
  
  
Partner across HR, Data, IT, Cyber Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and Ethics to establish decision rights and ongoing governance for AI-enabled HR solutions.
  
  
Treat data quality, lineage, completeness, representativeness, and permitted use as prerequisites for AI and analytics deployment.
  
  
Ensure appropriate human review for high-impact HR decisions, including pay, performance, employment, discipline, and workforce actions.
  
  
Cross-Discipline Architecture Partnership
  
  
Act as the HR architecture partner to enterprise, security, data, integration, infrastructure, solution, and platform architects.
  
  
Represent HR requirements in the design of enterprise AI platforms, data products, integration services, identity models, and technology standards.
  
  
Participate in the Architecture Review Board and other governance forums, translating HR needs into architecture language and enterprise requirements into practical HR solution choices.
  
  
Enable product managers and delivery teams to design solutions that are extensible, reusable, secure, compliant, reliable, cost-conscious, operationally effective, and performant.
  
  
Business Translation and Stakeholder Partnership
  
  
Turn complex architecture choices into clear business language and decision-ready narratives.
  
  
Facilitate working sessions with HR leaders, centers of excellence, product managers, business users, technology teams, and vendors.
  
  
Explain the reason for a recommendation, expected value, data implications, risks, change impact, dependencies, and decision points in a way that supports informed leadership choices.
  
  
Use active listening, structured diagnosis, and influence without authority to navigate competing priorities and perspectives.
  
  
Architecture Evolution and Portfolio Roadmapping
  
  
Maintain a current and future view of HR solution architecture aligned to HR strategy, product roadmaps, enterprise technology direction, and the evolving AI landscape.
  
  
Monitor the current portfolio for aging technology, fragmented experiences, control gaps, duplication, weak interoperability, unmet business needs, and opportunities to simplify.
  
  
Maintain architecture documentation covering business capabilities, experiences, processes, applications, data, integrations, agents, standards, risks, and transition roadmaps in approved portfolio tools.
  
  
Monitor market and vendor direction without allowing a vendor roadmap to substitute for McCain business strategy or architecture judgment.
  
  
**Key Qualifications And Capabilities**
Experience and Education (Required)
  
  
15+ years of progressive experience in HR technology, enterprise technology, solution architecture, product management, technical consulting, or a closely related field, including delivery of large-scale or complex solutions.
  
  
5+ years of combined experience shaping solution architecture, technical roadmaps, enterprise designs, or cross-platform technology strategies.
  
  
Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Technical and Architecture Acumen (Required)
  
  
Demonstrated experience across cloud, API and event design, integration architecture, data engineering fundamentals, identity and security principles, and AI or automation platforms.
  
  
Understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including REST APIs, event-driven integration, middleware, data pipelines, and emerging approaches for agent interoperability.
  
  
Ability to develop conceptual and logical architectures and evaluate solutions at design level. Software engineering depth is useful but not required.
  
  
Knowledge of solution delivery methods, including agile, DevOps, incremental delivery, prototyping, and the software development lifecycle.
  
  
**HR Process, Experience, And Data Fluency (Required)**
Working knowledge of end-to-end HR processes such as talent acquisition, onboarding, core HCM, workforce management, performance, learning, total rewards, employee services, and workforce analytics.
  
  
Ability to identify where process, policy, role, data, or experience redesign is needed before applying technology.
  
  
Strong understanding of the legal, ethical, privacy, security, and trust dimensions of employee and candidate data.
  
  
Solutioning and Judgment (Required)
  
  
Proven ability to evaluate multiple solution pathways without defaulting to a familiar platform, vendor, or technology.
  
  
Experience facilitating discovery, design thinking, blueprinting, architecture, or process redesign sessions with mixed business and technical audiences.
  
  
Sound judgment in balancing business value, user experience, scalability, interoperability, risk, total cost, speed, and operational sustainability.
  
  
Communication and Business Partnership (Required)
  
  
Exceptional ability to explain technical concepts and architecture recommendations in plain business language.
  
  
Comfort presenting to senior HR and IT leaders and facilitating decisions across stakeholders with different levels of technical knowledge.
  
  
Consulting-style skills in listening, diagnosis, facilitation, storytelling, negotiation, and influence without authority.
  
  
Responsible AI and Governance (Required)
  
  
Practical understanding of responsible AI principles in HR, including fairness, bias risk, output reliability, confidentiality, transparency, explainability, human oversight, monitoring, and drift.
  
  
Ability to embed governance, controls, and human checkpoints into AI-enabled workflows and to lead cross-functional design conversations on appropriate use.
  
  
**Preferred Assets**
Experience with application portfolio management and architecture tools such as LeanIX or an equivalent.
  
  
Architecture certification such as TOGAF or an equivalent.
  
  
Experience with AI agent orchestration, conversational solution design, or prompt engineering in an enterprise context.
  
  
Familiarity with enterprise data platform architecture and HR data product or integration requirements.
  
  
Experience with one or more platforms relevant to the current HR ecosystem, such as SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow HRSD, UKG, Phenom, or comparable solutions. Platform experience is valued but is not a substitute for platform-agnostic architecture judgment.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
HR opportunities are framed as clear business problems with measurable outcomes before solution selection begins.
  
  
Process and experience redesign precede automation, and human judgment is deliberately preserved where it matters.
  
  
Solution recommendations compare credible options and document value, risk, data, architecture, and change trade-offs.
  
  
AI-enabled HR solutions have defined governance, data boundaries, human oversight, monitoring, and accountable ownership.
  
  
HR applications, agents, data products, and interfaces operate as an intentional ecosystem rather than disconnected tools.
  
  
HR and IT leaders can understand and confidently act on architecture recommendations.

3226d51c.title: Technical Architect - Remote Access Solutions
3226d51c.description:
**About IDrive**

IDrive is a leading provider of secure and scalable cloud backup, S3-compatible object storage, and remote access solutions. Trusted by over 5 million users worldwide, we empower individuals and businesses to protect, access, and manage their data with high-performance tools built for speed, reliability, and security.

**RemotePC** is a secure remote access platform that enables real-time connectivity to computers and servers across distributed locations. Supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, and web browsers, it allows users to remotely control systems, transfer files, and provide IT support. Trusted by businesses worldwide, RemotePC delivers encrypted, reliable remote access for productivity and secure operations.

  

**About the Job**

As a **Technical Architect - Remote Access Solutions**, you will lead the architecture and technical direction of our next-generation remote connectivity platforms. This role requires deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, distributed systems, and high-performance networking.

You will work closely with product, engineering, security, and DevOps teams to design and build scalable remote access platforms that enable secure connectivity across devices and environments. Your architectural decisions will directly influence the reliability, performance, and security of products used by millions of customers globally.

  

**What you will be doing:**

Architecture & System Design

* Lead the architectural design for remote access platforms including secure remote desktop solutions, VPN alternatives, zero-trust access systems, and device management services.
* Architect high-availability, low-latency remote access infrastructure capable of supporting global deployments across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Design and guide the implementation of distributed microservices-based systems that handle authentication, session management, connectivity, and device orchestration at scale.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies in remote access, networking, virtualization, and cybersecurity to drive innovation in our platform.

Remote Access & Connectivity Technologies

* Architect systems leveraging modern remote desktop and media streaming technologies, including GPU acceleration and efficient video encoding.
* Design systems using image processing pipelines and hardware acceleration technologies supporting video codecs such as H.264 and H.265 for high-performance remote rendering.
* Design resilient networking layers using TCP/IP, UDP, NAT traversal, relay servers, and firewall-friendly communication mechanisms.
* Optimize remote session performance, bandwidth usage, latency, and reliability across geographically distributed users.

Security & Compliance

* Define best practices for authentication, authorization, encryption, and identity management across remote access systems.
* Architect solutions aligned with zero-trust principles and modern enterprise security standards.
* Ensure secure data transmission and storage through encryption, secure key management, and robust access control mechanisms.
* Ensure adherence to industry standards, security frameworks, and regulatory compliance requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

* Lead architecture discussions, design reviews, and technical decision-making across engineering teams.
* Provide technical mentorship to senior engineers and development teams, guiding best practices in scalable architecture and system design.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, Security, and DevOps teams to translate product requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Drive long-term architectural vision for remote access platforms and ensure alignment with product roadmaps and business goals.

  

**What we expect from you:**

* 10 to 15 years of experience in software development and system architecture with significant exposure to remote access technologies.
* Strong understanding of remote desktop technologies, connectivity frameworks, and secure remote access architectures.
* Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, NAT traversal techniques, firewall behavior, and real-time communication protocols.
* Experience designing highly scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proficiency in one or more system-level or backend programming languages such as C++, C# (.NET), or Go.
* Proven experience leading architectural initiatives, design reviews, and large-scale system design.
* Excellent analytical thinking and ability to solve complex technical challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly articulate architecture decisions and collaborate across teams.
* Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Information Science, or a related field.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience working in product-based companies in remote access, virtualization, or cybersecurity domains.
* Exposure to endpoint security, device management, or enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Experience designing and optimizing systems that require real-time performance and minimal latency.
* Prior experience serving as a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or Technical Architect.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and architectural vision
* Strong stakeholder communication
* Decision-making and technical ownership
* Mentoring and team leadership
* Innovation mindset and technology leadership

  

**Why join us?**

At IDrive, you will work with backup, storage, virtualization, and remote access technologies, contributing to products like RemotePC, our widely used secure remote access platform. You will collaborate with experienced engineers, ship features used at scale, and help architect systems powering products trusted by millions of users and businesses worldwide.

As the platform evolves, you will have the opportunity to influence product architecture, mentor engineering teams, and drive innovation in secure remote connectivity and remote work infrastructure through RemotePC.

  
  

Startup spirit

* Dynamic work culture where ideas are encouraged and innovation is celebrated
* Opportunity to take ownership of large-scale architectural initiatives
* Hands-on exposure to emerging technologies in cloud, security, and distributed systems
* Direct impact — design systems used globally

Health & wellness

* Medical insurance with customizable coverage for you and your family
* Comprehensive life and accidental insurance
* Free annual health check-up

Culture & community

* Company events and team lunches
* Festival gifts and celebration goodies

Perks that matter

* Online storage space

Flexible work environment

* Hybrid work model with flexible working hours
* Paid time off and holidays

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. FRP support material

  

**40%**

Understanding of business domain, AI led process reimagination, Applying AI for Automaton

* MBA / PGDM in Strategy, Marketing, or Business Management from a premier institute. Engineering or quantitative undergraduate background preferred.

  

**Professional Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience across AI / data product management, strategy consulting and solution / pre-sales
* Proven track record of shaping and winning AI, GenAI, or data-driven transformation deals, or of taking AI products from strategy to launch and adoption.

Have taken AI / data products from 0

bc3d8c75.title: Senior Confluent Cloud Kafka & Flink Engineer
bc3d8c75.description:
**Job Description Confluent Cloud & Kafka**

**Experience: 10- 15 Years**

**Location: Bangalore/Chennai**

**Work Mode: WFO**

**Shift: General Shift**

  

Movate is looking for a Senior Confluent Cloud Kafka & Flink Engineer to design, develop and implement enterprise-scale real-time data streaming platforms and event-driven solutions. The role will translate business use cases into secure, reliable and production-grade streaming architectures using Confluent Cloud, Apache Kafka, Confluent Cloud for Apache Flink and modern cloud data platforms. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Confluent specialist with strong solution-architecture capability, deep streaming engineering experience and the ability to independently design, build, deploy and support complete real-time data solutions, rather than focusing only on Kafka administration.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

• Lead the architecture, design and implementation of enterprise-scale streaming solutions using Confluent Cloud, Apache Kafka and Confluent Cloud for Apache Flink. • Design Kafka topics, producers, consumers, partitions and replication strategies for scalable and reliable event processing. • Build and manage Kafka Connect integrations, managed connectors and Change Data Capture (CDC) pipelines. • Develop Flink SQL solutions for streaming transformations, joins, aggregations, windowing and event-time processing. • Configure and optimize Confluent Flink compute pools, materialized tables and streaming workloads. • Implement Confluent Tableflow integrations with Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake and cloud data platforms. • Design schemas using Avro, JSON Schema and Protobuf, and manage compatibility, versioning and schema evolution through Schema Registry. • Establish stream governance using Stream Catalog, Stream Lineage, data contracts and enterprise governance practices. • Automate Confluent Cloud infrastructure and environment management using the Confluent Terraform Provider. • Integrate streaming deployments with CI/CD pipelines and implement repeatable DevOps practices across environments. • Implement security controls using RBAC, ACLs, service accounts, API keys and secure REST API integrations. • Design and support Cluster Linking and Schema Linking for multi-cluster and cross-environment streaming requirements. • Deliver end-to-end use cases involving CDC, streaming ETL, real-time analytics, event-driven architectures and data-lake integration. • Troubleshoot production issues and improve platform monitoring, performance, reliability, scalability and cost efficiency. • Provide technical leadership, architecture guidance, code/design reviews and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

  

**Required Technical Skills**

• 10+ years of overall engineering experience with strong hands-on experience in Confluent Cloud and Apache Kafka. • Strong hands-on experience with Confluent Cloud for Apache Flink and Flink SQL. • Deep understanding of Kafka topics, producers, consumers, partitioning, Kafka Connect, managed connectors and CDC. • Experience with streaming transformations, joins, aggregations, windowing and event-time processing. • Experience with Schema Registry, Avro, JSON Schema, Protobuf, schema compatibility, versioning and evolution. Movate | Senior Confluent Cloud Kafka & Flink Engineer • Hands-on experience with Terraform, preferably the Confluent Terraform Provider, infrastructure automation and CI/CD pipelines. • Experience implementing Kafka security using RBAC, ACLs, service accounts and API keys. • Good understanding of Cluster Linking, Schema Linking and multi-environment streaming architectures. • Proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Java or Python. • Proven experience designing and delivering production-grade streaming use cases. • Strong troubleshooting, architecture, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Skills • Knowledge of Confluent Tableflow and integration with Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake. • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform. • Exposure to Databricks and modern lakehouse architectures. • Confluent certifications or relevant streaming-platform credentials. • Experience optimizing streaming-platform performance, reliability and cloud cost. • Prior technical leadership, architecture ownership, mentoring or cross-team enablement experience.

  

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• Ability to translate business requirements into end-to-end real-time streaming architectures.

• Ability to independently design, develop, deploy and support enterprise-grade streaming solutions

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened its online retail in July 1995 and today, stands as one of the world’s largest internet retailer. 9e3e40fe.title: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Architect
9e3e40fe.description:
Job Description Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Architect

  

Job title: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Architect

Total experience: 10+ years in IT

Relevant experience: 5+ years in Dynamics 365 Finance (incl. AX 2012 to D365 F&O journeys)

Team leadership: Leads a team of functional consultants

Location: Pune

Employment type : Full-time

**About the role:**

  

We are hiring a Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Architect to own the functional design of our finance transformation programmes. You will lead customer workshops, turn business requirements into scalable D365 Finance solutions, and guide a team of consultants from discovery through go-live and hypercare.

This is a client-facing leadership role. You will be the trusted advisor to CFOs, finance controllers and process owners, and the design authority for the delivery team.

  

**Key responsibilities:**

Customer workshops and requirements

* Plan and lead discovery, requirements-gathering and fit-gap workshops with business stakeholders and senior finance leaders.
* Map current-state (as-is) finance processes and design future-state (to-be) processes aligned with D365 Finance best practice.
* Run solution walkthroughs, conference room pilots (CRPs) and design sign-off sessions.
* Challenge requirements constructively and steer customers toward standard functionality to limit customisation.

Solution architecture and design

* Act as functional design authority for D365 Finance across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash and Bank Management, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, Project Management and Accounting, and Cost Accounting.
* Design the chart of accounts, financial dimensions, legal entity structure, intercompany and consolidation models.
* Produce and review Functional Design Documents (FDDs), solution blueprints and configuration workbooks.
* Define functional requirements for integrations, data migration, reporting (Financial Reporter, Power BI) and localisation, working with technical architects.
* Ensure solutions meet tax, regulatory and statutory requirements for the markets in scope.

**Team leadership:**

* Lead, mentor and coach a team of functional consultants; allocate work and review deliverables for quality.
* Set functional standards, templates and reusable assets for the practice.
* Support hiring, onboarding and skills development of consultants.

Delivery and governance

* Own the functional workstream plan, estimates, risks and dependencies.
* Guide test strategy and support SIT, UAT, cut-over planning, go-live and hypercare.
* Follow Microsoft Success by Design / FastTrack guidance and participate in solution reviews.
* Support pre-sales: solution demos, effort estimation and proposal inputs.

**Required qualifications:**

* 10+ years of overall IT experience, including ERP implementation and consulting.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance (Finance and Operations).
* At least 3 end-to-end D365 Finance implementations, with at least 1 in a lead or architect role.
* Deep knowledge of core finance modules: GL, AP, AR, Cash and Bank, Fixed Assets, Budgeting, and Project Management and Accounting.
* Proven record of leading customer workshops with senior business stakeholders.
* Experience leading and mentoring a team of 5+ functional consultants.
* Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes: record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and period-end close.
* Working knowledge of data migration (Data Management Framework), integrations, security roles and Lifecycle Services (LCS) / Power Platform admin.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Computer Science or a related field.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate (MB-310).
* Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert (MB-700).
* CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent finance qualification.
* Exposure to D365 Supply Chain Management, Project Operations or Commerce integration with Finance.
* Experience with AX 2012 to D365 upgrades or migrations from other ERPs (SAP, Oracle, legacy).
* Multi-country rollouts, localisations, global template design and shared-service models.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Power Automate, Dataverse and Electronic Reporting (ER).
* Pre-sales experience: solution demos, RFP responses and estimation.

**Key competencies:**

* **Workshop facilitation:** runs structured, outcome-driven sessions and keeps senior audiences engaged.
* **Stakeholder management:** builds trust with CFOs and finance teams; handles scope and expectation conversations confidently.
* **Leadership:** motivates, coaches and holds a consultant team to a high quality bar.
* **Communication:** explains complex designs clearly in writing and in person.
* **Problem solving:** balances business needs, standard product fit and delivery constraints.
* **Ownership:** accountable for functional outcomes from design through go-live.

  

Interested candidated kindly share their updated resume at vidhi@clicentrix.com

fe3ddb52.title: Infrastructure & Platform Architect
fe3ddb52.description:
**Company Description**

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

 **Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, deployment, and management of enterprise cloud infrastructure primarily on **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**.
* Provide technical leadership and hands-on expertise across Oracle cloud services and technologies, including:
  + **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Enterprise application integration, API-based connectivity, and integration orchestration.
  + **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data transformation, ELT workflows, and data integration.
  + **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – Change Data Capture (CDC), replication, and real-time data integration.
  + **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Modern data platform architecture, data engineering, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads.
* Architect scalable, secure, highly available, and cost-effective OCI environments.
* Design and implement cloud networking, IAM, security policies, connectivity, and resource governance.
* Lead platform modernization, infrastructure optimization, and cloud integration initiatives.
* Establish architecture standards, best practices, and operational guidelines for Oracle Cloud platforms.

**2. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Architecture**

* Design, implement, and support enterprise infrastructure and data platforms on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Provide architectural guidance across GCP services, including:
  + BigQuery
  + Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow)
  + Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
  + Cloud Run
  + Cloud Storage
  + Compute Engine
  + IAM, VPC, and Cloud Monitoring
* Design and support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures integrating OCI and GCP.
* Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to design reliable and scalable cloud data platforms.

  **3. Kubernetes & Container Platform Architecture**
* Architect, deploy, and manage enterprise Kubernetes environments, including **Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Define standards for container orchestration, workload deployment, scaling, security, and networking.
* Drive adoption of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and container-based deployment strategies.
* Provide technical guidance on Kubernetes cluster management, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and platform reliability.
* Establish best practices for container security, high availability, and disaster recovery.
* **4. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation**
* Lead the design and implementation of **Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** solutions across OCI and GCP.
* Develop standardized, reusable Terraform modules for automated cloud infrastructure provisioning.
* Architect **self-service cloud provisioning solutions** that enable engineering teams and business users to request and deploy approved cloud resources through automated workflows.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, access management, and environment lifecycle management.
* Establish infrastructure governance, policy enforcement, approval workflows, and automated compliance validation.
* Integrate infrastructure automation with GitLab CI/CD or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational effort and improve platform efficiency.
* **5. Enterprise Data Platform & Pipeline Architecture**
* Provide architectural guidance and operational oversight for enterprise data platforms and integration pipelines across OCI and GCP.
* Support Oracle GoldenGate CDC pipelines, OIC integrations, Oracle Data Transforms, and cloud-based data ingestion and transformation frameworks.
* Guide the implementation and optimization of data orchestration tools such as Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow) and dbt.
* Design reliable data integration patterns across Oracle applications, cloud databases, and enterprise analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with data architects and engineers to ensure data platform scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Establish monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational standards for enterprise data pipelines.
* **6. Infrastructure Operations, Monitoring & Platform Reliability**
* **Lead and provide technical direction to cloud infrastructure, platform support, and monitoring teams** responsible for maintaining enterprise cloud environments.
* Oversee day-to-day platform operations, infrastructure health, monitoring, incident management, and production support.
* Establish operational processes, service-level objectives (SLOs), availability targets, and platform reliability standards.
* Implement proactive monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and automated incident response across OCI and GCP.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead infrastructure patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
* Establish operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and support models.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring infrastructure support and maintenance activities.
* **7. Technical Leadership, Governance & Collaboration**
* Serve as a **senior technical leader and subject matter expert** for enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Mentor platform engineers, infrastructure engineers, DevOps engineers, and cloud support teams.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, networking, data engineering, and application teams.
* Drive cloud governance, infrastructure standardization, security compliance, and cost optimization.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and recommend platform improvements aligned with enterprise objectives.
* Provide technical oversight for vendor implementations, infrastructure upgrades, and cloud transformation initiatives.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* **10+ years of hands-on experience** in Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, or DevOps, including significant experience leading enterprise cloud infrastructure initiatives.
* **Strong, recent, and hands-on expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**, including designing, provisioning, configuring, deploying, and managing production cloud environments.
* **Demonstrated hands-on experience with Oracle cloud data and integration technologies**, particularly:
  + **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Integration development, deployment, administration, and troubleshooting.
  + **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data integration, transformation workflows, and platform administration.
  + **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – CDC, replication, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  + **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Practical knowledge of its architecture, capabilities, and integration with enterprise data and AI workloads.
* **Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, including infrastructure architecture, cloud networking, IAM, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, and core data platform services.
* **Proven experience with Kubernetes**, preferably Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), including cluster administration, container deployments, networking, scaling, security, and troubleshooting.
* **Extensive hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**, including building reusable modules, automating cloud resource provisioning, and implementing standardized infrastructure deployment frameworks.
* **Experience designing and implementing self-service infrastructure automation**, enabling automated provisioning of cloud services with appropriate governance and access controls.
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps automation**, preferably GitLab CI/CD, including infrastructure and application deployment pipelines.
* **Prior hands-on experience with enterprise data platforms and pipelines**, including data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and integration tools such as Oracle GoldenGate, OIC, ODT, BigQuery, Cloud Composer (Airflow), or dbt.
* **Demonstrated experience leading infrastructure operations, platform maintenance, and production support teams**, including incident management, monitoring, troubleshooting, and service reliability.
* **Strong experience with enterprise cloud monitoring and observability**, including OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, Google Cloud Monitoring, and centralized alerting solutions.
* **Practical experience with cloud security, networking, IAM, disaster recovery, high availability, and infrastructure governance**.
* **Proven technical leadership experience**, including architecture ownership, mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, and coordinating cross-functional engineering and support teams.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Excellent analytical, architectural decision-making, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Oracle AI Data Platform and AI-enabled enterprise data solutions.
* Experience with Oracle Autonomous Database, Oracle Fusion Cloud applications, and Oracle Database services.
* Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud integration architectures between OCI and GCP.
* Knowledge of GitOps, Helm, Argo CD, and Kubernetes deployment automation.
* Experience with enterprise cloud FinOps, cost governance, and resource optimization.

 **Additional Information**

**Important:** This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership position. Candidates must demonstrate recent implementation and operational experience with **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Oracle integration technologies**, along with the ability to architect solutions, lead engineering teams, and maintain enterprise cloud platforms. Experience limited to high-level architecture, advisory roles, or people management without hands-on technical involvement will not be sufficient.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic's complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

**About the role:**
-------------------

As a Senior Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and solve our customer's business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be focused on excellence; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.

3699e857.title: Client Facing Solution Architect
3699e857.description:
**About Us**
Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.
  
  
As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.
  
  
Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.
  
  
**About The Role**
Our Solution Architecture team is looking to bring on an experienced Solution Architect to support both ongoing and new implementations. We see significant growth in our future and would love for you to be a part of it! You will partner with customers and numerous internal teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that provide solutions to solve customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of Abacus’ offerings. As a Solutions Architect, you will demonstrate best practices around advanced cloud solutions and healthcare payer systems including claims processing (i.e., Medical, Vision, Prescription claims), clinical informatics (e.g., Lab Results), provider systems such as EHR, and CMS Interoperability mandate solutions. As a trusted customer advocate, you will have the opportunity to guide a client’s successful adoption of Abacus’ core data management offerings.
  
  
**Your day to day**

* Author the project architecture design documents, including data flows, sequence diagrams and overall system architecture, that will drive the technical implementation of the solutions. This role will primarily focus on defining solutions associated with CMS Interoperability, but may also work on other data solutions.
* Work across business and IT teams to understand the current business and system capabilities and determine the desired state to define the overall technology strategy roadmap
* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business experts, technical business analysts, project managers, sales / account executives and data engineers to successfully implement client projects which reduce technology costs and solution redundancy.
* Collaborate with Product Management to identify client-specific requirements that may translate into an existing standard product feature or a future feature on the Abacus product roadmap.
* Define the solution architecture visions for designated components that describe the long-term goals as well as near-term needs of the client.
* Provide mentorship to internal teams on business needs and use cases for seamless client implementation. Provide ongoing support to address questions and issues raised by the implementation team.

**What You Bring To The Team**

* Understanding and passion for healthcare data and systems – including payer, provider, and integration partners. Strong working knowledge of US healthcare data, including but not limited to Medical Claims, Pharmacy Claims, Membership / Enrollment, Provider and Clinical.
* Domain expertise in CMS Interoperability Mandate (9115 / 0057) - including the technology used to serve the mandated APIs as well as the data structures (FHIR) required to be compliant.
* Ability to define the solution architecture vision in architecture design documents
* Broad and general technical knowledge as well as competencies in infrastructure, data models, databases, service orientation, programming, frameworks, standards, and technical modeling. Strong experience with one or more cloud vendors (AWS / Azure / GCP) and data platforms (Databricks / Snowflake) desired.
* Strong understanding of healthcare industry trends, regulations, and customer needs with preference for previous payer / Interoperability vendor experience
* Experience translating business needs into technology solutions that enable delivery of the Abacus platform.
* Strong communicator who can leverage their domain and technical expertise effectively with the client and build working relationships with internal and external team members. Ability to communicate succinctly and clearly, both verbally and written, across technical and non-technical audiences at multiple levels, including business leaders.
* Experience working in the payer / healthcare data space and understanding of the historical data architecture needs of our clients.
* Understanding of client services or experience working for a cloud-based data management provider to large clients.

**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**

* Working knowledge of Provider (EHR) Data formats and topics – including FHIR, X-12, HL-7 V2.3, and CCDA/CDA - as well as the general system architecture required to consume and make use of this data.
* Working knowledge of Utilization Management / Care Management / Disease Management.

**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Leave & Benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

**Work arrangements**

* Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week (5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST)
* Location: Remote
* Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.

**Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer**
As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.
  
  
**AI Use in Recruitment**
We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks.
**We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.**
**Identity and Location Verification**
To protect the integrity of our hiring process, all interviews are conducted by live video with your camera on. Virtual or blurred backgrounds and headsets are not permitted absent an approved accommodation, and you should be in a well-lit, private space where your face and surroundings are clearly visible. Candidates who advance may also be asked to complete identity and location verification, which may include verifying your identity, work history, and confirming that you are located where your application states. Applications containing knowingly false or materially misrepresented information, including identity, location, or credentials, may be disqualified, and any offer may be rescinded if a material misrepresentation is discovered at any point in the process.
  
  
If you need an accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know in advance.
  
  
By applying, you acknowledge that we will collect and process your personal information for recruiting purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including for the verification steps described above. Please review our Applicant Privacy Notice for more information, including your rights.

82fc632a.description:
**Job Description**  
**Role - Azure Data Architect**  
**Role -** Azure Data Architect

**Skills Mandatory -** Azure Synapse Analytics, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Enterprise Data Architecture, Data Modelling, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure SQL, Tableau, Stakeholder Management

**Skills Primary -** Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Data Modelling, Enterprise Data Architecture, Azure Data Platform

**Qualification -** Bachelor's Degree

**Work Location -** Kochi /TVM OR Remote

**Expected Date of Onboarding-** 30 November 2026

**Number of Positions -**1

Job Purpose (both Onsite / Offshore)  
The role reviews the current Azure Synapse-based Customer Data Platform, enterprise data architecture, data modelling practices and reporting ecosystem. It also assesses the ongoing Tableau-to-Power BI migration and advises on Microsoft Fabric as a future-state analytics platform.  
The architect acts as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, leads architecture discussions and conducts technical assessments. The role delivers executive-level recommendations to improve platform effectiveness, reporting consistency and future technology direction.  
Job Description / Duties and Responsibilities  
- Lead architecture and platform assessments across Azure Synapse, Power BI, Tableau and Microsoft Fabric environments.  
- Assess the current Azure Synapse-based Customer Data Platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, semantic and reporting layers.

- Review enterprise data architecture, data domains and the implementation of medallion architecture patterns.  
- Evaluate data models, business rules, semantic models and reporting structures for consistency, reuse, scalability and maintainability.  
- Identify architectural bottlenecks, duplicated logic, technical debt and optimisation opportunities.  
- Assess Tableau and Power BI reporting environments, including migration progress, dependencies, risks and rationalisation opportunities.  
- Evaluate Microsoft Fabric capabilities against Azure Synapse and recommend the future platform direction.  
- Run architecture workshops, stakeholder interviews and discovery sessions with business and technical teams.  
- Present architecture findings, recommendations and roadmaps to client stakeholders and leadership.  
- Prepare architecture assessment reports, findings registers, migration assessments and executive presentations.  
- Recommend improvements in data architecture, governance, reporting architecture and platform modernisation.  
- Provide architecture guidance on security, scalability, governance, data quality and operational excellence.  
- Act as the primary architecture lead for the engagement and a trusted advisor on strategic data platform decisions.  
Skills and Competencies  
- Strong experience in Azure Synapse Analytics architecture and implementation.  
- Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Fabric Data Warehouse, Data Factory / Pipelines and Power BI integration.  
- Strong Power BI architecture skills: semantic modelling, DAX, governance and reporting best practices.  
- Experience evaluating and modernising enterprise analytics platforms.  
- Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data modelling, dimensional modelling, medallion architecture and analytics and reporting architecture.  
- Experience with Azure data platform services: ADLS, Azure SQL, ADF and Azure Synapse Analytics.  
- Understanding of data governance, metadata management, lineage and data quality practices.  
- Experience assessing and guiding reporting migrations from Tableau to Power BI.  
- Strong SQL and data analysis skills.  
- Experience preparing architecture assessments, recommendations and modernisation roadmaps.  
- Excellent communication and consulting skills, with the ability to engage senior business and technology stakeholders.  
- Strong facilitation and workshop leadership skills.  
- Ability to present complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.  
- Self-driven and comfortable working independently in a client-facing offshore delivery model.  
- Ability to influence architecture decisions through evidence-based recommendations.  
Good to Have  
- Databricks, Snowflake, Purview, data governance frameworks and Tableau migration experience.  
- Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Azure Data Engineer Associate, TOGAF.

50326d97.title: Technology Consultants - Public Cloud
50326d97.description:
**ABOUT US**

Ensono is a hybrid IT services provider that sees a world in transformation. We understand the world of business has become more complex, layered, and interdependent because we're enabling the IT infrastructure for that transformation. Our clients are some of the most innovative and forward-thinking companies in the world and we help keep their businesses thriving. With nearly 50 years of experience, we optimize and modernize IT infrastructure by amplifying the power of mainframes and mid-range servers with the agility of cloud. Check us out at www.ensono.com

  

**Job Description:**

  

**Role Summary**

Ensono's Public Cloud Consulting practice is looking for a Junior Azure Platform Security Engineer to support the secure operation and improvement of enterprise Microsoft Azure environments. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and architects, the role focuses on remediating security findings, implementing Private Endpoints, hardening Azure services, and validating secure network connectivity.

The successful candidate will build practical experience across Azure security, networking, DNS, infrastructure as code, and production change management while helping application and product teams reduce externally exposed attack surfaces with minimal service impact.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the implementation of Azure Private Endpoints and the transition of supported Azure services from public to private connectivity.

* Assist with remediation of security findings identified through Microsoft Defender for Cloud and related security tools.

* Apply approved hardening changes to Azure Storage Accounts, Azure SQL and database services, and Azure App Services.

* Gather application dependencies, connectivity requirements, and change-impact information before remediation activities.

* Configure and troubleshoot VNets, subnets, routes, Private Link connectivity, service-to-service traffic, and Private Endpoint DNS resolution with support from senior team members.

* Validate expected traffic flows through Azure Firewall and Palo Alto firewalls and collect evidence for troubleshooting.

* Support both Terraform-managed and manually deployed Azure environments, following existing standards and peer-review processes.

* Coordinate with application, product, and infrastructure teams to schedule, test, and safely implement changes in live environments.

* Perform pre-change and post-change validation, update technical documentation, and escalate risks or unexpected behaviour promptly.

* Help reduce public exposure and align Azure resources with approved security baselines and operational procedures.

  

**Junior-Level Role Expectations**

* Works within defined designs, standards, and change procedures.

* Completes assigned implementation and troubleshooting tasks with guidance.

* Documents work clearly and raises dependencies, risks, and blockers early.

* Develops knowledge through hands-on delivery, shadowing, and structured learning.

**Essential Technical Skills**

* Foundational hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure administration, networking, or security.

* Working knowledge of Azure Private Link, Private Endpoints, private DNS zones, and name-resolution concepts.

* Understanding of VNets, subnets, network security groups, routing, IP addressing, and basic traffic flows.

* Exposure to securing Azure Storage Accounts, Azure SQL or other database services, and Azure App Services.

* Awareness of Microsoft Defender for Cloud recommendations and security remediation workflows.

* Basic working knowledge of Terraform or another infrastructure-as-code approach, including plan review and controlled deployment.

* Familiarity with Azure Firewall; exposure to Palo Alto firewalls or similar network security platforms is beneficial.

* Ability to follow dependency checks, test plans, rollback plans, and production change controls.

* Basic troubleshooting skills using Azure Portal, logs, DNS tools, and connectivity tests.

* Clear written and verbal communication, teamwork, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Approximately 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in cloud operations, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, or technical support.

* Practical exposure to Azure through employment, internship, lab work, project delivery, or structured training.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in engineering, computer science, information technology, or a related discipline.

* Experience working with ticketing, incident, problem, or change-management processes is desirable.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, or Azure Security Engineer Associate certification.

* Exposure to Azure DevOps or GitHub workflows and peer-reviewed code changes.

* Awareness of Azure Policy, role-based access control, logging, monitoring, and security best practices.

* Experience supporting enterprise or customer-facing environments.

  

**Key Skill Areas**

Azure Security | Private Endpoints | Private Link | Azure Networking | DNS | VNets | Subnets | Routing | Storage Accounts | Azure SQL | App Services | Microsoft Defender for Cloud | Terraform | Infrastructure as Code | Azure Firewall | Palo Alto | Security Remediation | Troubleshooting | Production Change Management

1a703d85.title: AI Delivery Manager
1a703d85.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Delivery Manager based in India.**
The AI Delivery Manager will lead the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of innovative Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Generative AI projects. This role combines strong project and program management expertise with a solid understanding of AI technologies, software engineering, and modern data platforms. The successful candidate will oversee multiple AI initiatives, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with business objectives. Working closely with clients, business stakeholders, data scientists, ML engineers, software developers, and architects, the role will drive collaboration across technical and business teams. The position covers the full AI delivery lifecycle, from proof of concepts and MVPs to production deployment and ongoing optimization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI transformation initiatives in a dynamic, collaborative, and technology-driven environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI projects, from initial planning and requirements gathering through development, deployment, and production implementation.
* Define project scope, objectives, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, timelines, and success metrics in alignment with business priorities.
* Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, schedules, budgets, resource allocation, and delivery roadmaps.
* Oversee multiple AI projects and workstreams simultaneously, ensuring effective prioritization and coordination of resources.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, manage dependencies, and implement corrective actions to maintain delivery commitments.
* Ensure projects meet agreed expectations regarding scope, schedule, budget, quality, and business outcomes.
* Manage AI/ML delivery lifecycles, including data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimization.
* Coordinate the delivery of initiatives involving Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Predictive Analytics, and AI-driven automation.
* Collaborate with technical teams on AI solution architecture, model selection, data requirements, APIs, system integrations, and deployment strategies.
* Maintain a working understanding of emerging AI concepts and technologies, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, AI agents, MLOps, and LLM evaluation.
* Coordinate proof of concepts (POCs), minimum viable products (MVPs), pilot programs, and full-scale production implementations.
* Serve as the primary delivery contact between clients, business stakeholders, and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
* Organize project reviews, steering committee meetings, stakeholder discussions, and executive reporting sessions.
* Translate business requirements into actionable technical deliverables and ensure consistent alignment between business expectations and engineering execution.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, communicate project updates, highlight risks, and facilitate timely decisions.
* Drive collaboration across business, product, engineering, data, security, and architecture teams to ensure successful project delivery.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in project or program management, preferably leading AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI initiatives.
* Strong understanding of AI and Machine Learning fundamentals, including model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
* Knowledge of Generative AI technologies and Large Language Models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
* Familiarity with NLP and/or Computer Vision applications, AI agents, and agentic AI solutions.
* Understanding of model evaluation, monitoring, MLOps, and LLMOps practices.
* Ability to understand and coordinate technical discussions involving AI architecture, data pipelines, model selection, APIs, integrations, and production deployment.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Familiarity with AI development platforms and tools, including Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Databricks, and MLflow.
* Understanding of containerization and deployment technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
* Experience using project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or Smartsheet.
* Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and analytics tools for project tracking and performance reporting.
* Strong organizational, planning, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, including experience working with senior leadership, clients, and multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify delivery challenges and drive practical solutions.
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business language and actionable project plans.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, collaborative environments with evolving technology requirements and business priorities.

**Benefits**

* Flexible working arrangements, including remote work opportunities depending on project and business requirements.
* Opportunity to work on innovative AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI projects.
* Exposure to modern technologies, cloud platforms, and emerging AI solutions.
* Professional development opportunities in a rapidly evolving technology landscape.
* Collaborative and inclusive working environment that values diverse perspectives and individual contributions.
* Opportunities to work with international clients and multidisciplinary teams.
* Flexible scheduling options, including arrangements outside traditional business hours when required.
* Supportive return-to-work program for professionals resuming their careers after extended breaks due to health or family circumstances.
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on digital transformation initiatives while developing long-term career opportunities.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
  
  
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
