83dd1120.title: Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager (India)
83dd1120.description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At **Worldwide Clinical Trials** , we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.

  

With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.

  

**Make an Impact as a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager at Worldwide**

  

As a Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Program Manager, you'll play a critical role in advancing key information security initiatives that support business goals, regulatory commitments, and risk reduction objectives. Working within the Governance, Risk and Compliance team and reporting to the Senior Director of Governance, Risk and Compliance, you'll lead complex programs that drive meaningful security and operational outcomes across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you'll provide end-to-end leadership for a portfolio of information security and GRC programs, guiding strategy, governance, planning, execution, and long-term adoption. You'll partner closely with leaders across the Office of the CISO, Information Technology, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, and other business functions to ensure programs deliver measurable value and sustainable results.

Your ability to bring structure to complex initiatives, align diverse stakeholders, and provide clear executive-level insights will help strengthen security capabilities and support continued organizational success.

  

**Where You'll Work**

  

This is a REMOTE role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.

  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Lead multiple information security and GRC programs from strategy and planning through delivery, operational transition, and benefits realization.
* Develop and maintain multi-year program roadmaps aligned to security priorities, regulatory requirements, audit commitments, and business objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks, steering forums, escalation paths, and delivery standards that enable effective program execution.
* Manage program scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and change activities across multiple workstreams.
* Partner with project managers, workstream leaders, and vendors to ensure alignment, accountability, and successful delivery outcomes.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across Information Security, IT, Privacy, Legal, Quality, Vendor Management, Procurement, Clinical Operations, and business teams.
* Deliver concise, decision-focused reporting to executive leadership, including portfolio status, risks, forecasts, financials, and key milestones.
* Oversee vendor performance, program financials, stakeholder engagement, adoption planning, and operational readiness activities.
Define and monitor program success metrics, risk indicators, and benefits realization while continuously improving governance and delivery practices.  

  

**What You'll Bring**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business, Project or Program Management, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience may be considered.
* Five or more years of progressive project and program management experience, including ownership of multiple concurrent information security or cybersecurity programs.
* Proven experience leading security programs end-to-end, including strategy, governance, planning, execution, financial oversight, executive reporting, operational transition, and benefits realization.
* Experience delivering security initiatives such as identity and access management, vulnerability management, security operations, cloud security, data protection, third-party risk, compliance remediation, security tooling, or security transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of program and project management disciplines, including portfolio governance, budgeting, resource management, vendor management, risk management, and benefits tracking.
* Working knowledge of information security frameworks, controls, risk management principles, and security operations, with the ability to engage effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, workstream leads, project managers, and vendors within a matrixed environment; experience in regulated industries such as clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, or pharmaceuticals is strongly preferred.
Proficiency in English, along with excellent written, verbal, facilitation, negotiation, presentation, and executive communication skills; PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or similar certifications are preferred.  

  

**Discover the Difference**

  

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit **http://www.worldwide.com/careers** **,** or connect with us on **LinkedIn** .

89f8cf30.description:

Amagi is an Emmy-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetizationfrom live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

* 9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors
* 500,000+ hours of content processed
* 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZNand the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.

Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

  

**Work Mode : In-Office**

**Location : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)**

  

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced, proactive, enthusiastic team player with a can-do personality who is passionate about delivering a quality product to our customers. An Amagi Engagement Manager (Project Manager) is responsible for the delivery of the assigned project on schedule, within budget, and meeting the expectations of the client. The projects will include a broad range of products from Planner, Playout, to Server-Side Ad Insertion for monetization. In addition, the Project Manager has a responsibility to provide a positive experience for the customer and people working on his/her project team.

  

**What will you own?**

* Prepare top-down, structured Project Plans
* Provide high-level plans indicating key project stages and milestones.
* Stage plans should identify all of the products that will be delivered during the project cycle, along with prerequisites and activities required to accomplish the delivery of the products.
* Define a structured organisation for project delivery.
* Identify resource requirements of the project and associated hard and soft skills for each resource. Ensuring competencies are met to deliver the project to which he/she has been assigned.
* Manage and monitor the project plan to ensure successful completion of the planned activities and delivery of the project on time.
* Manage and monitor the budget to ensure the project is delivered within budget.
* Manage customers expectations and control project scope, driving the customer acceptance of the project within the boundaries of the documented project scope.
* Handling customers escalations and driving a successful resolution between all stakeholders.
* Stakeholder management.
* Prepare the various status reports, both for internal and external stakeholders, to be distributed within an agreed timeframe.
* Establish, implement, and manage processes and procedures covering configuration management, including Change Control, Risk & Issues Management, Documentation Management, and Product Assurance.
* Write specification documents and workflows.
* Establish and implement a team culture within his/her assigned project.
* Manage multiple projects at all stages while ensuring consistent high levels of service delivery.

  

**What are we looking for?**

* The ideal candidate will have 10 - 15 years of end to end project management experience in a customer facing role.
* Must have proven experience using project management tools and methodologies
* Excellent communication skills
* Excellent Customer Management & negotiation skills
* Excellent leadership skills
* University Degree in electrical or computer engineering, or Equivalent experience
* Highly knowledgeable in project management
* Project Management Professional (PMP) accreditation preferred.
* Knowledge of Broadcast, Digital, Linear, or SSAI is preferred.
* Experience with Complex Cloud Solutions
* Proven track record working in a team environment
* Proven experience in delivering real-time projects under time constraints
* Excellent project management skills and competency
* Good technical knowledge is an asset

  

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

* Be Vulnerable, Be You. Authenticity is our baseline.
* Goodness Wins. We always lead with integrity.
* Have Fun with Challenges. We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* Think Macro, Do Micro. We dream big but execute with relentless precision.

  

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

c98b9c41.title: Solutions Specialist, MCU
c98b9c41.description:
**About Us**
Ever wondered what powers the products people rely on every day? Chances are, we've helped build it.
  
  
Our software and development tools help build products for cars, hospitals, factories, homes, and industries worldwide. We help engineers solve complex challenges and create technology people can depend on.
  
  
Rooted in Nordic values and trusted by innovators worldwide, we combine deep technical expertise with a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and collaboration. With decades of engineering experience and a shared passion for technical excellence, we're helping shape the future of software and embedded development.
  
  
We take pride in building tools for people who build the world around us.
  
  
**About The Role**
Qt for MCUs is on a mission to bring Qt’s industry-leading UI framework to the most resource-constrained microcontrollers on the market — enabling rich, responsive user experiences on devices where every byte of Flash and every millisecond of CPU time matters. Our team works directly with the world’s leading silicon vendors and embedded product companies to make that vision a reality.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer — MCU, you are the technical heart of our customer engagements. You will port Qt for MCUs to new silicon platforms, design display adaptation layers, solve complex hardware-software integration challenges, and serve as the go-to subject matter expert for MCU-related opportunities across sales, pre-sales, and product engineering.
  
  
This role is located in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Port Qt for MCUs to new microcontroller platforms — from BSP bring-up and HAL integration through to display adaptation, framebuffer management, and validated performance on target hardware
* Design and optimise display and graphics pipelines for memory-constrained MCUs, including DMA-driven transfers, partial rendering, and asset optimisation using the Qt for MCUs toolchain
* Act as the primary technical SME for customer engagements, proof-of-concept projects, and evaluations — delivering workshops, demos, and training to engineering teams worldwide
* Debug complex issues spanning hardware, firmware, BSP, and UI stack layers using JTAG/SWD debuggers, logic analysers, and oscilloscopes; provide root-cause analysis and drive resolution with product engineering
* Author application notes, porting guides, and best-practice documentation; support the sales team with technical proposals and RFP responses for Qt for MCUs solutions
* Collaborate closely with silicon vendors (Infineon, Renesas, NXP, STMicroelectronics) and internal engineering teams to bridge cutting-edge Qt technology with real-world MCU constraints

**What You Bring To The Table**

* 5–8 years of hands-on embedded software engineering experience with a strong focus on microcontroller-based products and ARM Cortex-M class devices (STM32, NXP i.MX RT, Renesas RA/RH)
* Proven experience porting or adapting embedded software stacks in bare-metal and RTOS environments (FreeRTOS and/or Zephyr), with a solid grasp of MCU memory architecture
* Hands-on experience with TFT/LCD display integration: framebuffer management, pixel format handling, display controller configuration, and serial protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, DMA)
* Experience with at least one embedded GUI framework — Qt for MCUs, LVGL, Embedded Wizard, or STemWin — and proficiency in C and C++ with CMake-based build systems
* Strong communication skills in English; ability to translate deep technical knowledge into clear guidance for both engineering and commercial audiences

**Bonus Points For…**

* Experience with additional MCU families (ESP32/Espressif, PIC/Microchip) or silicon vendor BSP ecosystems such as STM32CubeIDE, MCUXpresso, e2studio, or ModusToolbox
* Prior Solutions Engineering, Field Application Engineering, or other customer-facing technical role experience
* Familiarity with Qt Widgets or Qt Quick/QML on higher-powered targets, and/or contributions to open-source embedded or GUI projects

**Build What Matters. Grow Where It Matters.**
We believe work should support your life, not the other way around. That's why our benefits are designed to be flexible, inclusive, and meaningful across every stage of your journey. From wellbeing and growth to celebrating life's big (and small) moments, we invest in what matters to you, wherever you are.
  
  

* Flexibility You Can Count On We offer hybrid working options and flexible hours, empowering you to balance your personal life and professional goals because life outside of work matters, too.
* Meaningful Wellbeing Support From mental health resources to physical wellness programs, we provide practical, accessible support tailored to local needs.
* Opportunities to Grow Whether through hands-on learning, mentorship, or international collaboration, we invest in your development so your career can grow in the direction you choose.
* Inclusive by Design You'll join a team that values different perspectives, encourages collaboration, and creates space for everyone to contribute and succeed.
* Rewarding Your Impact Our compensation and benefits packages are competitive, regularly reviewed, and locally relevant, ensuring your contribution is recognized wherever you are.

**Bring Your Whole Self**
The best ideas come from people with different experiences, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported, and able to do their best work.
  
  
We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and provide equal opportunities for all. Our technology may be what we're known for, but it's our people who make the difference.
  
  
**We'd love to learn more about you. Tell us about your skills and experience, but just as importantly, tell us what motivates you and what kind of impact you want to make.**

23f60f94.title: Engineer I - Data center Solutions Design
23f60f94.description:
**JD-Engineer I or II- Mechanical Engineering- Data center Solutions Design**

  

Seeking a ***Solutions Mechanical Engineer*** with experience in Technical Cooling Systems (TCS) / Secondary Fluid Networks (SFN) or related piping and fluid systems (HVAC, hydronics, process cooling) to design and deliver custom solutions. The role focuses on supporting customer orders from initial quote preparation through to production-ready designs, working globally with customers, offering management, and suppliers. Responsibilities include creating rapid concept layouts using configurator/automation tools, refining them into manufacturable solutions, and engaging suppliers early to balance cost, quality, and lead time. The role also requires ensuring layouts align with customer requirements while feeding lessons learned into NPDI standards.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with customers and offering management to define TCS/SFN or related piping system requirements, design criteria, and constraints.
* Generate rapid concept layouts of TCS/SFN systems, including piping, manifolds, valves, clamps, and fittings, to support timely and accurate quote preparation.
* Use and help refine rapid layout/quoting tools to streamline CPQ integration and improve speed and accuracy of proposals.
* Translate concept layouts into manufacturable designs using company standards and supplier capabilities.
* Work with suppliers early in the design process to confirm manufacturability, cost targets, and lead times, and validate final builds through pressure/leak testing, cleanliness verification, and quality checks.
* Oversee the smooth transition from concept to production, including documentation, BOM creation, and engineering change management in PLM systems (Oracle PD Cloud, Windchill).
* Capture lessons learned and integrate improvements into standard NPDI TCS/SFN modules and design practices.

  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* 3 - 8 years of experience in piping/fluid systems, preferably in data center liquid cooling, HVAC, hydronics, or process cooling.
* Proficiency with Creo for detailed TCS/SFN design, assemblies, and engineering documentation.
* Familiarity with rapid concept and layout tools such as Creo, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Revit MEP, or SpaceClaim for quick iteration and customer visualizations.
* Experience preparing layout drawings, routing plans, and BOMs for piping or liquid cooling systems.
* Knowledge of pressure testing, leak detection, and cleanliness requirements for fluid assemblies.
* Strong English communication skills for collaboration with customers, offering teams, and suppliers.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with global engineering teams.

  

* **Preferred Skills**

+ Experience with automation/configuration tools such as kBridge, Eplan, or similar for generating repeatable layouts and BOMs.
+ Knowledge of manufacturing processes for stainless-steel and plastic piping systems, including welding, bending, clamping, and joining methods.
+ Understanding of fluid system components such as manifolds, quick disconnects, strainers, expansion tanks, balancing valves, and sensors.
+ Ability to perform system balancing, pressure drop calculations, and valve Cv selection.
+ Familiarity with NPDI, Stage-Gate, or other structured product development processes.
+ Hands-on involvement in prototype builds, FAT/SAT, and validation reporting.

9495d403.description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a Solution Architect to design and lead a central email gateway. It will sit between the client's commerce platform, its middleware (enterprise service bus) and a new email service provider, and will carry all business-critical transactional email, such as order, shipping, refund and account notifications. The gateway offers two integration models:
  
  

* a pass-through API for systems that are ready to use the new provider directly
* a backward-compatible API that mimics the legacy provider, so existing systems only need to change an endpoint

The Architect will own the AWS target architecture, the versioned API contracts, a configuration-driven mapping model, and the resilience design needed to make sure no email is lost or sent twice. The role leads a small cross-functional team on a short build window, drives technical decisions with the client's architects, and owns cutover readiness and early-life support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design**

* Own the AWS target architecture across edge, API Gateway, private networking, load-balancing and ECS Fargate integration, containerized compute, eventing, audit and data flows
* Define versioned OpenAPI contracts for the pass-through and backward-compatible APIs
* Design a configuration-driven mapping engine for campaign, field and error-code translation
* Design resilience patterns: timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaker, idempotency and dead-letter queue (DLQ) handling
* Design the Security & Observability Framework

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead discovery and capture existing integration contracts from live traffic
* Set engineering standards and review all code, including AI-generated code
* Guide developers, DevOps and QA on design, testability and performance
* Establish AI-assisted application-building workflows using AI approved

**Stakeholder & Delivery**

* Present options and recommendations to the client's architecture and platform teams
* Coordinate the ecommerce, middleware and email provider teams through integration and SIT
* Own cutover planning, go/no-go criteria and early-life support

**Security & Compliance**

* Ensure OAuth2 machine-to-machine authentication, encryption, least-privilege IAM and PII masking
* Align audit retention and the data purge approach with GDPR/CCPA requirements

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong solution architecture experience on AWS: API Gateway, ECS/Fargate, SQS, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, IAM and KMS
* Configuration management using AppConfig or DynamoDB; observability with CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry/ADOT or X-Ray; CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code design.
* Proven design of API gateways or enterprise integration layers for high-volume transactional systems
* Hands-on with Node.js/TypeScript or Java/Spring Boot microservices
* Strong grasp of resilience patterns, idempotency and event-driven design
* OpenAPI-first design and contract testing practices
* Excellent stakeholder communication and technical leadership

**Good-to-Have**

* Exposure to email service provider platforms; retail transactional email, ESB/middleware platforms
* Fastify; Akamai WAF; Terraform or AWS CDK; OpenSearch/ELK-based operational search.
* AWS Solutions Architect – Professional certification

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of relevant software engineering experience with solution architecture and hands-on technical leadership.
* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent
* AWS architecture certification is desirable.

3c7778b3.title: SAP Service Delivery Manager
3c7778b3.description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 11/20/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Remote Job

**Job Description**
-------------------

This is a remote position.

**Job Description – SAP Service Delivery Manager**
==================================================

  

**Role at a glance**
--------------------

Item

Details

Job title

SAP Service Delivery Manager

  

Company

Elfonze Technologies

  

Location

Hyderabad (hybrid; Remote, Travel to client sites as needed)

  

Experience

12–16 years total IT, including 5+ years managing SAP AMS / service delivery

  

Employment type

Full-time, permanent

  

Reports to

SAP Practice Head

  

Team size managed

15–40 consultants across functional, technical, Basis and Security

  

Notice period

Immediate to 30 Days

**Role summary**
----------------

We are hiring an SAP Service Delivery Manager to own end-to-end delivery of SAP Application Management Services (AMS) and project engagements for our clients. The role is accountable for SLA performance, client satisfaction, team management and commercial health of the account.

The ideal candidate has run SAP ECC and S/4HANA support landscapes, can talk confidently with CFOs and IT heads, and keeps a multi-module team (FICO, MM, SD, PP, HCM, ABAP, Basis, Security) delivering to agreed service levels.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Service delivery and SLA management**

* Own day-to-day delivery of SAP AMS services: incidents, service requests, change requests and minor enhancements.

* Meet contracted SLAs and KPIs for response, resolution and backlog; drive root-cause analysis for P1/P2 and repeat incidents.

* Run ITIL processes: incident, problem, change, release and knowledge management, using ServiceNow, Solution Manager / Cloud ALM or Jira.

* Govern transport and release management across DEV, QAS and PRD with clear approval controls.

**Client and stakeholder management**

* Be the single point of contact for client IT and business leadership, including finance and operations heads.

* Run weekly status calls and monthly / quarterly service reviews with executive summaries, SLA dashboards and improvement plans.

* Manage escalations calmly and close them with clear action plans and timelines.

* Identify upsell opportunities: S/4HANA upgrades, new modules, automation and CRs.

**Team leadership**

* Lead and mentor a multi-module team of functional, technical, Basis and Security consultants, onsite and offshore.

* Plan shift coverage, on-call rosters, leave and backup for 24x7 or business-hours support models.

* Set goals, review performance and build skills through cross-training and certifications.

* Coordinate between functional, ABAP, Basis and integration teams to resolve cross-module issues quickly.

**Commercial and governance**

* Track effort, utilisation, billing and margins; manage SOWs, change orders and invoicing inputs.

* Maintain RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and keep delivery audit-ready.

* Ensure compliance with security, data-privacy and client audit requirements (SOX / internal controls where applicable).

* Lead service transition for new accounts, including knowledge transfer and hypercare.

**Continuous improvement**

* Reduce ticket volumes through automation, monitoring, self-service and permanent fixes.

* Support project work alongside AMS: S/4HANA conversions, rollouts, upgrades and support packs.

* Publish lessons learned and keep runbooks and knowledge articles current.

**Required skills and experience**
----------------------------------

* 12–16 years in IT, with at least 5 years as Service Delivery Manager, AMS Manager or Engagement Manager for SAP accounts.

* Hands-on SAP background (8+ years) in at least one module — FICO, SD, MM or PP preferred — with working knowledge of how modules integrate.

* Proven delivery of SAP ECC and S/4HANA support, including at least one S/4HANA conversion, upgrade or rollout.

* Strong ITIL process knowledge and experience with ticketing tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Solution Manager / Cloud ALM).

* Track record of meeting SLAs on accounts with multi-module teams of 15+ people.

* Experience with commercials: SOWs, effort estimation, resource planning, utilisation and margin tracking.

* Excellent client-facing communication; comfortable presenting to CXO-level stakeholders.

* Experience working with Middle East or global clients and distributed onsite–offshore teams is a strong plus.

* Willingness to travel to client locations for reviews, transitions and critical phases.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Education: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA / MBA, or CA / ICWA for a finance-background candidate.

* Certifications (any of): ITIL v4 Foundation or higher, PMP or PRINCE2, SAP S/4HANA module certification, SAP Activate.

* Exposure to SAP BTP, Cloud ALM, Fiori, and integration (CPI / PI-PO, bank and EDI interfaces).

* Experience with automation and monitoring tools that reduce ticket volume.

* Prior experience in an IT services or consulting firm handling multiple clients.

07c69810.title: MS - IT Infra/Cloud - Manager - Telecom/Voice Lead - operate
07c69810.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Telecom and Voice Operations Manager, you will lead client-facing telecom and voice services across cloud and on-premises infrastructure within our Advisory practice at PwC Acceleration Center India. This role offers the opportunity to shape managed service delivery through cloud administration, performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and service management. You will work with platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud, using tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, and CrowdStrike where appropriate. By connecting infrastructure optimization, cloud compliance, and cost management practices, including FinOps and Apptio, you will help clients manage operational complexity and improve service performance.
  
  
As a Manager, you will own the planning, budgets, execution, and delivery of telecom and voice workstreams, using independent judgment as client needs evolve. You will coach team members through feedback and work review, draw on their varied strengths, and foster an inclusive environment where concerns can be raised. Your accountability includes coordinating with practice leadership on quality and timelines, addressing difficult conversations with clients and stakeholders, and escalating issues when appropriate. With professional skepticism and business knowledge, you will identify opportunities to improve delivery through AI and automation while upholding technical standards, independence requirements, and the firm’s values.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading telecom and voice service operations across client cloud and on-premises infrastructure, coordinating incident response, maintenance, service requests, and technical support
* Managing cloud operations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud platforms, aligning infrastructure administration with client service requirements
* Directing troubleshooting of voice and infrastructure issues, using Splunk, Dynatrace APM, and Performance Monitor to investigate disruptions and track performance
* Guiding cloud migration handoffs and infrastructure changes, reviewing architecture, operational readiness, performance impacts, and continuity of voice services
* Overseeing cloud compliance and security activities within managed operations, coordinating use of CrowdStrike and escalation of risks affecting infrastructure and voice environments
* Applying Apptio and FinOps practices to assess cloud consumption and infrastructure costs, identifying opportunities to improve resource use and service efficiency
* Managing client workstreams, timelines, and deliverables, consulting with stakeholders to clarify technical needs, communicate tradeoffs, and address changing priorities
* Coaching team members through technical reviews and feedback, using automation, digital tools, and AI-assisted workflows to improve service management and problem resolution

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 5 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Leading telecom and voice service operations across client infrastructure environments while coordinating cloud service delivery
* Managing cloud and on-premises infrastructure support, troubleshooting issues and improving service performance
* Leveraging AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform for cloud administration and migration initiatives
* Applying Dynatrace APM and Splunk to monitor infrastructure performance and guide operational improvements
* Using Apptio and FinOps operating models to assess infrastructure costs and identify optimization opportunities
* Coaching technical teams through complex service issues, providing feedback and maintaining client communication
* Integrating cloud compliance and security considerations into operational planning and technology administration

0f39af02.description:
Delivery Manager - US IT Staffing

  

**Location:** Sector 74A, Gurugram Onsite

**Experience:** 3+ years in US IT Staffing

  

**Suitable profiles:** Delivery Manager, Delivery Lead, Lead Recruiter, or Senior Recruiter ready to take on team leadership responsibilities.

  

About the Role

We are looking for a **sharp, target-driven staffing professional** to drive recruitment delivery for US IT requirements. This is a hands-on role combining **recruiting, team mentoring, and delivery ownership**, with clear accountability for quality submissions, interviews, and placements.

Strong Senior and Lead Recruiters with demonstrated leadership potential are encouraged to apply. **A stable employment history and consistent performance will be highly valued.**

  

Key Responsibilities

* Own recruitment delivery for assigned US IT requirements and meet agreed **submission, interview, and placement targets**.
* Remain actively involved in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and closures.
* Create and refine **advanced Boolean search strings** to identify relevant candidates across job portals, LinkedIn, and resume databases.
* Prioritize requirements, allocate work, and guide recruiters toward timely, quality submissions.
* Review candidate profiles for technical relevance, communication skills, availability, and alignment with client requirements.
* Mentor recruiters on sourcing techniques, screening, professional outreach, follow-ups, and candidate management.
* Track recruitment activity and conversion metrics, identify delivery gaps, and take corrective action.
* Coordinate with account managers and internal stakeholders on priorities, candidate feedback, and delivery progress.
* Maintain professional communication and accurate recruitment records throughout the hiring process.

  

Required Skills and Experience

* **Minimum 3 years of hands-on US IT Staffing experience**, with a proven record of meeting recruitment targets.
* **Strong Boolean sourcing skills**, including the ability to build precise searches for niche technical requirements.
* Good understanding of IT roles, technologies, and US staffing processes.
* Excellent **verbal and written communication skills**, with professional candidate and stakeholder engagement.
* A confident leadership presence, sound judgment, and the ability to hold a team accountable respectfully.
* Ability to mentor recruiters, improve team performance, and lead by example.
* Strong ownership, urgency, organization, and follow-through.
* A **positive attitude, professional conduct, and openness to feedback**.
* Willingness to work **onsite in Sector 74A, Gurugram**.

  

What We Value

**Consistent delivery, career stability, strong sourcing ability, and a lead-by-example mindset.** The ideal candidate is commercially focused, communicates clearly, supports the team, and takes responsibility for results.

08dd5918.title: STEM Program Manager
08dd5918.description:
**Job Title: STEM Program Manager**  
**Department:** Programs / STEM Education  
**Reports To:**  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Location:** Kalyan Nagar, Bengaluru  
**Experience:** 3–7 years in program management, education, STEM/EdTech, training, or a related field

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **STEM Program Manager** to plan, manage, and deliver STEM education programs across schools, institutions, and other learning environments.

The Program Manager will be responsible for end-to-end program execution, including curriculum planning, trainer management, school/client coordination, resource planning, quality monitoring, reporting, and program improvement.

The ideal candidate should have strong project management, communication, leadership, and stakeholder-management skills, along with a good understanding of STEM education and experiential learning.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Planning & Execution**

* Plan and manage STEM education programs from initiation through completion.
* Develop program plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and implementation schedules.
* Coordinate with schools, educational institutions, clients, and internal teams for successful program execution.
* Ensure programs are delivered according to agreed scope, timelines, quality standards, and learning objectives.
* Identify potential operational challenges and implement timely solutions.

**Curriculum & Content**

* Work with curriculum/content teams to develop and improve STEM learning programs.
* Review lesson plans, projects, activities, assessments, and training materials.
* Ensure content is age-appropriate, practical, engaging, and aligned with program objectives.
* Identify new STEM technologies, tools, and learning methodologies that can strengthen programs.

**Trainer Management**

* Recruit, onboard, train, and manage STEM Trainers and facilitators.
* Prepare trainer schedules and allocate resources based on program requirements.
* Conduct trainer orientation, reviews, and performance assessments.
* Monitor trainer performance and provide coaching and feedback.
* Ensure trainers follow curriculum, safety procedures, classroom standards, and reporting processes.

**School / Client Management**

* Act as the primary program contact for assigned schools or clients.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, teachers, coordinators, and other stakeholders.
* Conduct regular review meetings and collect stakeholder feedback.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate internally to address them.
* Support presentations, demonstrations, workshops, and program onboarding when required.

**Operations & Resource Management**

* Plan STEM kits, equipment, consumables, infrastructure, and other resources required for programs.
* Coordinate logistics for workshops, events, competitions, exhibitions, and STEM labs.
* Ensure proper utilization, maintenance, inventory tracking, and safety of STEM equipment.
* Coordinate with procurement and operations teams for timely availability of resources.

**Monitoring & Reporting**

* Track program progress against defined milestones and objectives.
* Monitor student participation, attendance, learning outcomes, and project completion.
* Prepare regular program reports, MIS dashboards, and performance summaries.
* Analyze feedback and program data to identify areas for improvement.
* Maintain accurate documentation of program activities and outcomes.

**Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish and maintain quality standards for STEM program delivery.
* Conduct periodic classroom observations and program audits.
* Identify gaps in curriculum, training, operations, and student engagement.
* Implement corrective and improvement measures.
* Develop best practices and standard operating procedures for program delivery.

**Events & Special Programs**

* Plan and manage STEM competitions, hackathons, exhibitions, science fairs, innovation challenges, boot camps, and other special events.
* Coordinate trainers, students, schools, equipment, logistics, and event partners.
* Ensure smooth execution and timely closure of events.

**Required Skills**

* Strong program/project management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management abilities.
* Team leadership and people-management skills.
* Strong organizational and planning abilities.
* Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.
* Good understanding of STEM education and experiential learning.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace and program-management or reporting tools.
* Ability to analyze program data and prepare reports.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degrees in engineering, Technology, Science, Education, Management, or a related field.
* A certification in Project Management, Education, STEM, or a related area is an advantage.

**Preferred Experience**

* 3–7 years of experience in program/project management, education, EdTech, STEM education, training, or a related field.
* Experience managing trainers or education teams.
* Experience working with schools, educational institutions, or corporate/CSR education programs.
* Experience managing multi-location programs is an advantage.
* Practical exposure to robotics, coding, electronics, IoT, AI, maker education, or other STEM domains is preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Successful and timely execution of STEM programs.
* Program quality and achievement of learning objectives.
* Student engagement and learning outcomes.
* Trainer performance and retention.
* School/client satisfaction.
* Program completion and adherence to timelines.
* Resource and operational efficiency.
* Quality and timeliness of reporting.
* Successful execution of events and special programs.
* Continuous improvement in program delivery.

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong leadership and ownership.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
* Structured and detail-oriented approach.
* Passion for education and STEM.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Proactive problem-solving mindset.
* Ability to build strong relationships with multiple stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel, if required.

Pay: ₹700,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

b401f9e5.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Gurugram, Haryana, India; New Delhi, Delhi, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program or project management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Knowledge of advanced technical and cultural domains.
* Ability to bridge the gap between cultural sector and emerging technologies with a track record of such programs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to travel 20% of the time domestically and internationally

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. * Define cross-functional challenges, manage stakeholder expectations, and guide alignment on project goals and deliverables.
* Use stand-alone judgment to navigate changing circumstances and escalate obstacles to leadership in a timely manner.
* Leverage AI and internal tools to optimize project portfolios while maintaining professional documentation and milestone tracking.
* Monitor progress and communicate results by applying standard organizational processes and technologies.

b52c50c3.description:
**Job Description**
Thomson Reuters is seeking a Solutions Consultant to drive revenue growth for its tax technology portfolio across the India market. This client-facing, commercially focused pre-sales role partners closely with Sales teams to identify, qualify, shape and close strategic opportunities, bringing deep domain expertise in indirect tax, GST, direct tax, e-invoicing, compliance workflows, global trade and tax technology solutions. The Solutions Consultant acts as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them understand how Thomson Reuters solutions address their business, compliance, operational and technology challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Sales teams across the full sales cycle, from opportunity qualification through solution design, proposal development, negotiation support and deal closure, and help develop and close new business to meet and exceed gross sales targets.
* Lead customer discovery to understand business challenges, compliance requirements, current tax processes, technology landscape and desired outcomes, then recommend the most appropriate Thomson Reuters tax solutions.
* Translate complex indirect tax, GST and e-invoicing requirements into clear solution narratives and differentiated value propositions that position Thomson Reuters against competitors.
* Own and deliver tailored product demonstrations, solution workshops, proof-of-concept discussions and functional deep-dives for stakeholders across tax, finance, IT, procurement, shared services and executive leadership.
* Support RFPs, RFIs, tenders and customer questionnaires, contribute to business cases and commercial positioning, and work with Sales, Product, Legal and Commercial Policy to execute complex deals.
* Stay current on indirect tax, GST, e-invoicing, regulatory change and tax technology trends in India, and bring these insights into customer conversations and industry forums.
* Share customer feedback, market trends, competitive insights and product enhancement opportunities with Product and Business teams, acting as an internal advocate for customer needs.

**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
  
  
We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
  
  
**Your Career**
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. As a Solutions Consultant for IT/ITeS, you will be part of the core technical team, architecting solutions for large IT/ITeS customers in the region. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Role**
Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  
  

* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.
* Your ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio based on customer business needs.
* Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
* Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.
* Demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to influence through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, technical engagements, and workshops
* Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.
* Orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy

* Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating our leadership
* Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events

You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of speech AI , LLM and RAG capabilities.

* B.Tech ,Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in a technical role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs) ,Speech AI
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM ,Speech AI models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.

78787c78.title: Infrastructure & Platform Architect
78787c78.description:
**Infrastructure & Platform Architect**

**ENTERPRISE DATA & ANALYTICS**

  

**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER**. Its our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**1. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Architecture**

* Lead the architecture, design, deployment, and management of enterprise cloud infrastructure primarily on **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**.
* Provide technical leadership and hands-on expertise across Oracle cloud services and technologies, including:

+ **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Enterprise application integration, API-based connectivity, and integration orchestration.
+ **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data transformation, ELT workflows, and data integration.
+ **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – Change Data Capture (CDC), replication, and real-time data integration.
+ **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Modern data platform architecture, data engineering, analytics, and AI-enabled workloads.

* Architect scalable, secure, highly available, and cost-effective OCI environments.
* Design and implement cloud networking, IAM, security policies, connectivity, and resource governance.
* Lead platform modernization, infrastructure optimization, and cloud integration initiatives.
* Establish architecture standards, best practices, and operational guidelines for Oracle Cloud platforms.

  

**2. Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Architecture**

* Design, implement, and support enterprise infrastructure and data platforms on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**.
* Provide architectural guidance across GCP services, including:

+ BigQuery
+ Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow)
+ Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)
+ Cloud Run
+ Cloud Storage
+ Compute Engine
+ IAM, VPC, and Cloud Monitoring

* Design and support hybrid and multi-cloud architectures integrating OCI and GCP.
* Ensure infrastructure scalability, security, performance, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to design reliable and scalable cloud data platforms.

  

**3. Kubernetes & Container Platform Architecture**

* Architect, deploy, and manage enterprise Kubernetes environments, including **Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**.
* Define standards for container orchestration, workload deployment, scaling, security, and networking.
* Drive adoption of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and container-based deployment strategies.
* Provide technical guidance on Kubernetes cluster management, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and platform reliability.
* Establish best practices for container security, high availability, and disaster recovery.

  

**4. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Cloud Automation**

* Lead the design and implementation of **Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** solutions across OCI and GCP.
* Develop standardized, reusable Terraform modules for automated cloud infrastructure provisioning.
* Architect **self-service cloud provisioning solutions** that enable engineering teams and business users to request and deploy approved cloud resources through automated workflows.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, access management, and environment lifecycle management.
* Establish infrastructure governance, policy enforcement, approval workflows, and automated compliance validation.
* Integrate infrastructure automation with GitLab CI/CD or equivalent DevOps platforms.
* Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational effort and improve platform efficiency.

  

**5. Enterprise Data Platform & Pipeline Architecture**

* Provide architectural guidance and operational oversight for enterprise data platforms and integration pipelines across OCI and GCP.
* Support Oracle GoldenGate CDC pipelines, OIC integrations, Oracle Data Transforms, and cloud-based data ingestion and transformation frameworks.
* Guide the implementation and optimization of data orchestration tools such as Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow) and dbt.
* Design reliable data integration patterns across Oracle applications, cloud databases, and enterprise analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with data architects and engineers to ensure data platform scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Establish monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational standards for enterprise data pipelines.

  

**6. Infrastructure Operations, Monitoring & Platform Reliability**

* **Lead and provide technical direction to cloud infrastructure, platform support, and monitoring teams** responsible for maintaining enterprise cloud environments.
* Oversee day-to-day platform operations, infrastructure health, monitoring, incident management, and production support.
* Establish operational processes, service-level objectives (SLOs), availability targets, and platform reliability standards.
* Implement proactive monitoring, centralized logging, alerting, and automated incident response across OCI and GCP.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA), problem management, capacity planning, and performance optimization.
* Lead infrastructure patching, upgrades, vulnerability remediation, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
* Establish operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and support models.
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring infrastructure support and maintenance activities.

  

**7. Technical Leadership, Governance & Collaboration**

* Serve as a **senior technical leader and subject matter expert** for enterprise cloud infrastructure and platform architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design discussions, and platform modernization initiatives.
* Mentor platform engineers, infrastructure engineers, DevOps engineers, and cloud support teams.
* Collaborate with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, networking, data engineering, and application teams.
* Drive cloud governance, infrastructure standardization, security compliance, and cost optimization.
* Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and recommend platform improvements aligned with enterprise objectives.
* Provide technical oversight for vendor implementations, infrastructure upgrades, and cloud transformation initiatives.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* **10+ years of hands-on experience** in Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Platform Engineering, or DevOps, including significant experience leading enterprise cloud infrastructure initiatives.
* **Strong, recent, and hands-on expertise in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**, including designing, provisioning, configuring, deploying, and managing production cloud environments.
* **Demonstrated hands-on experience with Oracle cloud data and integration technologies**, particularly:

+ **Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)** – Integration development, deployment, administration, and troubleshooting.
+ **Oracle Data Transforms (ODT)** – Data integration, transformation workflows, and platform administration.
+ **Oracle GoldenGate (OGG)** – CDC, replication, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
+ **Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP)** – Practical knowledge of its architecture, capabilities, and integration with enterprise data and AI workloads.

* **Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, including infrastructure architecture, cloud networking, IAM, Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, and core data platform services.
* **Proven experience with Kubernetes**, preferably Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE) and Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), including cluster administration, container deployments, networking, scaling, security, and troubleshooting.
* **Extensive hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**, including building reusable modules, automating cloud resource provisioning, and implementing standardized infrastructure deployment frameworks.
* **Experience designing and implementing self-service infrastructure automation**, enabling automated provisioning of cloud services with appropriate governance and access controls.
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD and DevOps automation**, preferably GitLab CI/CD, including infrastructure and application deployment pipelines.
* **Prior hands-on experience with enterprise data platforms and pipelines**, including data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and integration tools such as Oracle GoldenGate, OIC, ODT, BigQuery, Cloud Composer (Airflow), or dbt.
* **Demonstrated experience leading infrastructure operations, platform maintenance, and production support teams**, including incident management, monitoring, troubleshooting, and service reliability.
* **Strong experience with enterprise cloud monitoring and observability**, including OCI Monitoring, OCI Logging, Google Cloud Monitoring, and centralized alerting solutions.
* **Practical experience with cloud security, networking, IAM, disaster recovery, high availability, and infrastructure governance**.
* **Proven technical leadership experience**, including architecture ownership, mentoring engineers, leading technical reviews, and coordinating cross-functional engineering and support teams.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using Python, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
* Excellent analytical, architectural decision-making, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  

**Important:** This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership position. Candidates must demonstrate recent implementation and operational experience with **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Oracle integration technologies**, along with the ability to architect solutions, lead engineering teams, and maintain enterprise cloud platforms. Experience limited to high-level architecture, advisory roles, or people management without hands-on technical involvement will not be sufficient.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Oracle AI Data Platform and AI-enabled enterprise data solutions.
* Experience with Oracle Autonomous Database, Oracle Fusion Cloud applications, and Oracle Database services.
* Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud integration architectures between OCI and GCP.
* Knowledge of GitOps, Helm, Argo CD, and Kubernetes deployment automation.
* Experience with enterprise cloud FinOps, cost governance, and resource optimization.

7ab9e45e.title: Application Services Delivery Manager
7ab9e45e.description:
Hyderabad | Full-Time | Individual Contributor Role

**Build What Matters at Model N**

At Model N, we help life sciences companies solve complex revenue challenges so they can operate smarter and bring important innovations to market faster. We are looking for people who like practical problem solving, cross-functional work, and seeing the impact of what they build.

If you are energized by keeping complex client applications running smoothly and leading the teams behind them, this could be a great fit.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **Application Services Delivery Manager** to join our Application Services team. In this role, you will own end-to-end delivery and service outcomes for assigned application portfolios, drive delivery across the support, development, and QA teams that run them, and keep client service levels on track. You will work closely with Account Leadership, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders to protect service quality, manage risk and cost, and drive continuous improvement.

This role matters because customers rely on stable, predictable application services to run their revenue operations, and strong service governance is what keeps those systems dependable as they grow.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery and service outcomes for assigned application accounts, including L2/L3 support, application maintenance, and enhancements, so SLA and customer experience targets are met.
* Lead service governance, including weekly and monthly service reviews, operational reviews, and QBR support, so clients have clear status and accountability.
* Own ITSM processes across incident, problem, change, request, and release management, so changes are controlled and service stays predictable.
* Manage major incidents end to end, coordinating resolution, stakeholder communication, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.
* Drive execution across cross-functional support, development, and QA teams, partnering with team leads on capacity planning and workload balancing.
* Track service cost, effort, and scope to prevent unplanned work, and identify delivery and operational risks early with timely mitigation.

**What Success Looks Like**

***First 90 days***

* Learn the assigned application portfolio, its SLAs, and the governance cadence.
* Build working relationships with the delivery team, Account Leadership, and key customer stakeholders.
* Lead a service review and a major incident process end to end.

***First 6–12 months***

* Consistently meet SLA and KPI targets, with clear accountability for service outcomes.
* Reduce repeat incidents and unplanned work through process and automation improvements.
* Build team capability and capacity so the team runs with fewer escalations.

**How You Will Grow and Make an Impact**

At Model N, our competency model helps us talk about growth, impact, and how work gets done.

* **People Leadership –** You model continuous development and elevate capability within your team, such as building coaching practices that help delivery leads grow.
* **Problem-Solving Leadership –** You drive solutions across teams and influence outcomes beyond your immediate scope, such as resolving a recurring incident pattern across several accounts.
* **Thought Leadership –** You introduce forward-thinking ideas that improve outcomes beyond your team, such as proposing service models that reduce unplanned work across the portfolio.
* **Entrepreneurial Leadership –** You drive innovation across teams and create measurable impact, such as launching automation that cuts the effort of service reviews.
* **Operational Leadership –** You drive execution across teams and improve delivery effectiveness, such as raising SLA attainment across multiple application portfolios.
* **AI Leadership –** You drive adoption of AI within your team and identify practical use cases, such as AI-assisted incident trend analysis and service reporting.

We don't expect everyone to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.

**Qualifications**

***Required***

* Typically, 8-11 years of relevant experience.
* 4–6 years in service delivery, project management, or managed application services roles, with hands-on exposure to all phases of the SDLC.
* Experience managing application services or operations in a managed services environment, with a solid understanding of ITIL-based service delivery and ITSM practices.
* Experience driving delivery across cross-functional teams of 8–15 or more members, through influence and team leads rather than direct management.
* Proven client-facing experience in service reviews, escalations, and stakeholder management.
* Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini) to improve productivity, decision-making, or problem-solving in a professional or personal context.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

***Preferred***

* Certifications such as PMP, ITIL, or equivalent in project management or ITSM.
* Experience managing application support portfolios in SaaS, enterprise software, or revenue management domains.
* Exposure to AI-assisted service management, such as incident trend analysis, knowledge-base improvement, RCA support, and service reporting.
* Experience working with global delivery models and distributed teams.
* Interest in leveraging AI, automation, or modern technologies to improve outcomes.

#### **How We Work**

**Our DARE core values** - **D**REAM**, A**LIGN**, R**ESPECT, and **E**XCEL - shape how we work together.

* We solve practical problems that matter to our customers and teams.

* We work across functions and value clear, respectful communication.

* We recognize good work and support growth over time.

* We are curious about better ways to work, including thoughtful use of AI and modern tools.

We do not expect every person to be perfect in every area. We look for strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership, and the ability to keep growing.

#### **Compensation, Benefits, and Inclusion**

At Model N, your well-being and growth matter. We offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support employees personally and professionally.

Benefits and compensation for this position will be provided in accordance with Model N’s India programs and applicable local requirements.

#### **Bring Your N Factor**

We are not just looking for a checklist of skills. We are looking for people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a point of view.

If this role sounds interesting and you can see yourself adding value, we would love to hear from you.

**About Model N**

Model N is transforming how Life Sciences companies manage revenue, commercialization, and compliance.

For more than **25 years,** Model N has been the leader in end-to-end commercialization, revenue optimization, and compliance for pharmaceutical and medical technology companies.

Our intelligent, cloud-based platform combines technology, data, analytics, AI, and industry expertise to help leading Life Sciences organizations **optimize revenue, navigate complex regulations, improve decision-making,** and bring life-changing products to market faster.

Today, **150+ leading companies** across the globe trust Model N to optimize growth and transform critical commercial processes. Our solutions manage approximately **$1.3 trillion in gross revenue**, helping customers reduce complexity, strengthen compliance, and unlock new opportunities for growth.

At Model N, we are building the next generation of **Life Sciences revenue management**—where technology, data, AI, and human expertise come together to create meaningful business impact.

Join us to build technology that powers innovation in Life Sciences and makes a difference at global scale.

For more information, visit www.modeln.com.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

3778f9e1.title: Solution Engineer - GCC (FSI)
3778f9e1.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
  
  
We are looking for world-class Solution Engineers to join our Global field teams whose technical skills and customer savvy will help customers understand and utilise the value of the cutting-edge data platform that we are building. They must share our passion about reinventing the data platform and thrive in a dynamic environment.
  
  
The Solution Engineer will work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Marketing. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team on a handful of global accounts with GCCs in India to accelerate their Snowflake journey. The Solution Engineer will be responsible for providing the technical expertise to make Snowflake customers successful in driving existing projects and uncover new use cases. This data architect will have a broad range of skills and experience ranging from data architecture to ETL/ELT, data science, security, performance analysis, analytics, etc. He/she will have the insight to make the connection between a customer’s specific business problems and Snowflake’s solution, the customer-facing skills to communicate that connection and vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences, and the technical skills to be able to not only build demos and execute proof-of-concepts but also to provide consultative assistance on architecture and implementation.
  
  
***This is a hands-on, individual contributor role with high visibility across the organisation.***
The Solution Engineer has the willingness to jump in and do what it takes to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving technologies for data and analytics in order to be an authoritative resource for both Snowflake and customers. They should work collaboratively with a broad range of people, both inside and outside the company.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Present Snowflake technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers
* Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation
* Maintain a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing
* Be an advocate and develop mutual trust with the technical audience on the customer side
* Run training sessions, workshops, webinars to help customers become proficient in Snowflake
* Keeping customers up to date on key Snowflake product updates and future roadmaps to help them represent Snowflake to their clients about latest technology solutions and benefits
* Run technical enablement programs to provide best practices, and solution design workshops to help customers create effective solutions
* Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive Snowflake adoption
* Represent Snowflake at customer or industry events
* Forward Strategic thinking - quickly grasp the essence of new concepts and business value messaging. Sharing customer success stories & case studies to showcase the impact of Snowflake

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 10+ years of experience working in customer facing solution engineering (tech sales) role, preferably with large Global accounts
* University degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent experience
* Strong competency on modern data stacks, ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lake, data science and data apps
* Outstanding skills presenting to both technical and executive audiences, in small groups or at public events, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos.
* Hands-on expertise with SQL and Python
* Experience working with large global accounts, GSIs and/or Global Capability Centers
* Experience with large-scale database technology (e.g. Netezza, Exadata, Teradata, Greenplum, Hadoop etc.)
* Pre-sales experience in data related tech products
* Sound understanding and experience in the enterprise market and technology ecosystem
* Prior industry domain experience with a focus on BFSI is highly desirable.

**ADDED BONUS FOR:**

* Data Science/AI/ML experience across a variety of platforms
* Familiarity and experience with common BI and data exploration tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Metabase etc).
* Cloud Provider Experience - Amazon AWS/Microsoft Azure/Google Cloud
* Data modeling and data architecture experience
* Experience selling enterprise SaaS software to Global Accounts

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
  
  
How do you want to make your impact?
  
  
For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
