4c530eac.title: Archt II-Solutions Archt (INTL)
4c530eac.description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Type of Work: Highly consultative, collaborative with internal Sales and architectural . The daily focus is on independently leading technical pre-sales for mid-to-large enterprise accounts, leading whiteboarding sessions, and designing hybrid telecom/cloud networks. You will also play a critical role in identifying and scoping automation opportunities within customer deployments.
* Expected Volumes: Managing a robust pipeline of concurrent enterprise deals independently, while partnering with Architect IIIs on specific components of global strategic accounts. You will oversee technical discovery, design full network topologies, and guide Architect Is in building the corresponding lab/PoC environments.
* Risk & Criticality: Moderate-to-High commercial risk. You are independently designing solutions and scoping out automation requirements for significant revenue-generating accounts. Inaccurate scoping, missed requirements during discovery, or flawed architectural designs can lead to delivery delays, margin erosion, or lost competitive bids.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Mid-to-Large Deal Ownership: Act as the primary technical lead for mid-to-large enterprise deals. Take full ownership of the technical sales cycle, from initial discovery and requirements gathering to the final solution presentation.
* Automation Scoping & Strategy: Move beyond basic scripting to identify strategic automation opportunities. Assess customer environments and internal workflows to scope out where zero-touch provisioning, API integrations, or RPA can be applied. Define these requirements clearly for the Automation Team or Architect I to execute.
* Technical Discovery & Whiteboarding: Lead interactive customer workshops and whiteboard sessions with IT Directors and Network Managers. Uncover deep technical pain points and map them directly to our SD-WAN, cloud, and modern telecom portfolio.
* Solution Architecture & Validation: Design comprehensive, scalable network architectures. Oversee the generation of accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs) and technical RFP responses, ensuring everything is technically viable and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Mentorship: Guide the Architect I in understanding the actual customer requirement and solution design
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a bridge between Sales, Delivery, and Product. Ensure the solutions you architect are deployable by the delivery team and provide structured feedback to Product Management on mid-market feature requests.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in the telecom or tech industry, with at least 2-3 years in a customer-facing pre-sales, systems engineering, or solutions architecture role.
* Advanced Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of enterprise architectures, including SD-WAN, complex routing/switching (BGP, OSPF), firewalls, VPNs, and legacy telecom transitions.
* Automation Acumen: Strong ability to identify automation scope. You must understand how APIs work (REST/JSON) and how tools like Python, Terraform, or Ansible integrate into a network, even if you are no longer writing the code from scratch every day.
* Cloud Integration: Practical experience designing networks that connect securely to public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding cloud-native networking constructs.
* Presentation Skills: Proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value for mid-level technical decision-makers (Directors of IT, Network Managers).

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Mid-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNP (Enterprise or Security), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, MEF SD-WAN Professional, or equivalent.
* Experience navigating the transition of legacy MPLS networks to modern, internet-first SD-WAN or SASE architectures.
* Experience managing or orchestrating vendor relationships (OEMs) for specific components of a larger deal.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

**Job Summary**
Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit-for-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. 72c10222.description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
**Type of Work:**
Highly technical, hands-on, and execution-focused. The daily focus is on supporting senior architects on massive enterprise deals, managing smaller transactional deals independently, and building technical designs centered around enterprise networking, 5G, and Unified Communications.
  
  
**Expected Volumes:**
High volume of tactical execution. You will manage multiple solution designs, design network and telecom hardware/software, build Bill of Materials (BOMs), draw network topologies, and assist in drafting technical responses for RFPs/RFIs concurrently.
  
  
**Risk & Criticality:**
You are the hands-on technical validator for the team. While your architectural designs on large deals are overseen and approved by senior architects or your Manager, your ability to rapidly and flawlessly execute solution designs directly impacts deal momentum. Design failures or inaccurate BOMs can stall the sales cycle and impact margins.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For...**

* Technical Sales Support: Partner with Solution Architects and Account Executives to provide tactical support on large deals. This includes generating accurate Bill of Materials (BOMs), creating detailed network topology diagrams, and drafting technical RFP/RFI responses.
* Mid-Market Solution Design: Take full ownership of solution architecture and technical pre-sales for smaller, lower-complexity transactional deals (e.g., standard branch office networking or basic UCaaS deployments), applying best practices learned from the team.
* Cross-Functional Technical Handoff: Package successful solution designs,, and technical documentation to ensure a clean, seamless handoff to the internal Implementation teams once a deal is closed.
* Basic Tool Automation: Identify opportunities to use basic scripts (e.g., Python, REST APIs) to speed up repetitive lab setups or configuration tasks.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related engineering field.
* 2 to 4 years of hands-on technical experience in networking, network engineering, tech support, or a junior pre-sales/systems engineering role.
* Hands-on Networking Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding of routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, and LAN/WAN architectures (equivalent to a CCNA level of knowledge).
* Deep understanding on software-defined networking (SDN) or SD-WAN, 5G, RAN and UCC concepts
* Thorough knowledge of cloud computing principles (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how traditional networks connect to cloud environments.
* Entry-level industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA, Cisco DevNet Associate, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, or CompTIA Network+/Security+

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Hands-on in software-defined networking (SDN) or SD-WAN, 5G, RAN and UCC services.
* Hands-on Automation Skills: Practical experience writing scripts to automate technical tasks. Familiarity with Python, Ansible, JSON/XML, REST APIs, and using tools like Postman
* Understanding, integrating or building with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, or equivalent) including prompt engineering and tool/function calling.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

40

82450ba1.title: Taazaa Tech _ Hiring For Java Technical Architect
82450ba1.description:
Were looking for a **Technical Architect** to join our Core engineering team in Noida & Pune.

Working at Taazaa involves engaging with cutting-edge technology and innovative software solutions in a collaborative environment. We emphasize on continuous professional growth, offering workshops and training. Our employees often interact with clients to tailor solutions to business needs, working on diverse projects across industries. We promote work-life balance with flexible hours and remote options, fostering a supportive and inclusive culture. Competitive salaries, health benefits, and various perks further enhance the work experience.

  

Looking ahead, we aim to expand our technological capabilities and market reach, investing in advanced technologies and expanding our service offerings. We plan to deepen our expertise in AI and machine learning, enhance our cloud services, and continue fostering a culture of innovation and excellence. Taazaa is committed to staying at the forefront of technology trends, ensuring it delivers impactful and transformative solutions for its clients.

We are seeking a **Java Technical Architect** who owns the end-to-end architecture of cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS products. You will bring deep hands-on expertise in Java (8 through 17/21), Spring Boot, microservices, event-driven systems and AWS, combined with the judgment to make and defend architectural trade-offs.This is a hands-on architecture role. You will define target architectures, set engineering standards, review critical code, and guide multiple teams and Technical Leads. You will also act as a trusted technical advisor to clients, translating business goals into scalable, secure and cost-effective solutions

**What youll do:Architecture & Solution Design**

+ Define and own the end-to-end architecture for enterprise, cloud-native SaaS products, from solution vision to deployment topology.
+ Design multi-tenant architectures, including tenant isolation, data partitioning, tenant-aware security and per-tenant configuration.
+ Decompose domains using Domain Driven Design (DDD) and define microservice boundaries, APIs and data ownership.
+ Design event-driven and reactive systems using Kafka, CQRS, event sourcing and Saga patterns where appropriate.
+ Define non-functional requirements (scalability, availability, performance, security, observability, cost) and design to meet them.
+ Architect AWS solutions using services such as EKS, S3, Cognito, KMS, RDS, SQS/SNS, API Gateway and Lambda.
+ Evaluate options and present multiple architectural approaches with clear trade-offs, then document decisions as Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
+ Lead modernization of legacy monoliths to microservices and cloud-native platforms.
+ Research emerging technologies, including AI/ML and GenAI integrations, and build proofs of concept to validate them.

  

**Technical Leadership & Governance**

+ Set coding standards, reference architectures, reusable frameworks and engineering best practices across teams.
+ Review designs and critical code through Git pull requests, ensuring quality, security and performance.
+ Mentor Technical Leads and senior engineers, and raise the overall architecture maturity of the team.
+ Define API strategy and standards for REST, gRPC and GraphQL services, including versioning and contracts.
+ Drive security by design: authentication and authorization (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), encryption, secrets management and OWASP compliance.
+ Establish observability standards for logging, metrics, distributed tracing and alerting.
+ Guide CI/CD, DevOps and Infrastructure as Code practices, and own performance and load-testing strategy.
+ Troubleshoot complex production issues and lead root-cause analysis for critical incidents.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

+ Engage with clients and stakeholders in pre-sales and discovery to shape solutions, estimates and technical proposals.
+ Conduct requirement, feasibility and impact analysis for new features and change requests.
+ Coordinate architecture and dependencies across onsite, offshore and external teams.
+ Work with product owners and delivery managers to align technical roadmaps with business priorities.
+ Participate in scrum ceremonies and support delivery teams through the full project lifecycle, including warranty support.

  

**Your QualificationsExperience**

+ Bachelors or master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
+ 12–16 years of software development experience in Java, with at least 4 years in an architect or solution architect role.
+ Proven record of architecting and delivering cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS products at enterprise scale.
+ Experience leading multiple teams and Technical Leads across concurrent projects.

  

**Technical Skills**

+ Expert in Java 8 and modern Java (11/17/21), including concurrency, JVM internals and performance tuning.
+ Deep expertise in Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud (Config, Gateway, Discovery), Spring Security and Spring WebFlux.
+ Strong command of microservices architecture, DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, and resilience patterns (circuit breaker, retry, bulkhead).
+ Mastery of design patterns, including GoF, J2EE, enterprise integration and cloud design patterns.
+ Hands-on AWS experience is a must, including EKS, S3, Cognito, KMS, RDS, IAM and networking (VPC). AWS Solutions Architect certification is a strong plus.
+ Proven experience designing multi-tenancy (database-per-tenant, schema-per-tenant and shared-schema models).
+ Strong SQL and data modeling with RDBMS such as PostgreSQL, Oracle and MySQL; experience with NoSQL such as MongoDB, Cassandra or DynamoDB.
+ Experience with caching (Redis, Hazelcast) and search (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
+ Skilled in ORM and data access with Hibernate, JPA, MyBatis/iBatis and JDBC.
+ Experience with messaging and streaming platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ or JMS.
+ Proficient in designing and consuming REST, gRPC and GraphQL APIs.
+ Containerization and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes; Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
+ CI/CD with Jenkins, GitHub Actions or GitLab CI; build tools Maven and Gradle; version control with Git.
+ Testing practices including TDD, JUnit, Mockito, contract testing, and performance testing with JMeter or Gatling.
+ Observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry or Datadog.
+ Working knowledge of application security, OAuth2/OIDC, and compliance needs such as SOC 2, GDPR or HIPAA.
+ Hands on experience with AI Productivity tools such as Chat GPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude.
+ Experience with Spring AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and implementing observability standards using OpenTelemetry (OTel) for distributed tracing, metrics, and logging in AI-enabled microservices.

**Good to Have**

+ Experience with Azure, GCP or PCF in addition to AWS.
+ Exposure to integrating AI/ML or LLM-based services into enterprise applications.
+ Experience with serverless architectures and cost optimization (FinOps) on cloud.
+ Familiarity with front-end architectures (React or Angular) for full-stack solution design.

  
  

**Behavioral:**

+ Here are five essential behavioral skills a Technical Lead should possess:
+ **Effective Communication:** Clearly and concisely convey ideas, requirements, and feedback to team members, stakeholders, and clients, fostering an environment of open dialogue and mutual understanding.
+ **Leadership and Mentorship**: Inspire and guide the development team, providing support and encouragement, while promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
+ **Problem-Solving Attitude:** Approach challenges with a proactive mindset, quickly identifying issues and developing innovative solutions to overcome obstacles.
+ **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Work well within a team, encouraging collaboration and valuing diverse perspectives to achieve common goals and deliver high-quality results.
+ **Adaptability and Flexibility:** Stay adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, effectively managing changing priorities and requirements while maintaining focus on project objectives.

  

**What you’ll get in return:**Joining Taazaa Tech means thriving in a dynamic, innovative environment with competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. You'll have ample opportunities for professional growth through workshops and certifications, while enjoying a flexible work-life balance with remote options. Our collaborative culture fosters creativity and exposes you to diverse projects across various industries. We offer clear career advancement pathways, comprehensive health benefits, and perks like team-building activities.

**Who we are:**Taazaa Tech is a kaleidoscope of innovation, where every idea is a brushstroke on the canvas of tomorrow. It's a symphony of talent, where creativity dances with technology to orchestrate solutions beyond imagination. In this vibrant ecosystem, challenges are sparks igniting the flames of innovation, propelling us towards new horizons.

**Welcome to Taazaa, where we sculpt the future with passion, purpose, and boundless creativity.**

* Execute subscriber data migration — running the full data migration lifecycle: data profiling,

transformation scripting, data extension population, suppression list loading, consent record migration
  
  
and bulk data load execution using ETL tools and Salesforce Bulk API.
  
  

* Develop AMPscript and SSJS personalisation — writing dynamic content personalisation scripts for

migrated email templates, recreating legacy segmentation logic, lookup functions and conditional content
  
  
rules in MCN native scripting.
  
  

* Configure Salesforce Data Cloud data streams — setting up data stream ingestion from source

systems, configuring DLO schemas, mapping fields to DMOs and validating data completeness per the
  
  
Data Cloud Architect's design.
  
  

* Migrate and rebuild Journey Builder flows — translating legacy marketing automation workflows,

drip campaigns and triggered sends into Journey Builder — recreating entry sources, decision splits, wait
  
  
steps, send activities and exit criteria.
  
  

* Build migration validation and reconciliation tooling — developing Apex batch utilities, LWC

dashboards and Salesforce Flow automations for subscriber count reconciliation, data extension record
  
  
validation and consent flag verification.
  
  

* Execute and manage dry run cycles — coordinating migration dry runs against SIT/UAT environments,

capturing reconciliation counts, logging validation failures and iterating until dry run success criteria are
  
  
met.
  
  

* Configure sender authentication and deliverability — implementing SPF, DKIM and DMARC DNS

records, private domain configuration, reply mail management and IP warm-up scheduling as directed by
  
  
the TA.
  
  

* Develop and execute unit and system integration tests — writing test scripts for migrated journeys,

data extensions and automations; executing SIT cycles; logging defects; retesting fixes against factory
  
  
quality thresholds.
  
  

* Support go-live cutover execution — following the cutover runbook: executing final subscriber data

loads, activating journeys, validating data extension record counts and confirming suppression lists are
  
  
active.
  
  

* Prepare technical handover documentation — producing configuration workbooks, data mapping

sheets, AMPscript library documentation and journey flow diagrams for client team handover post go-
  
  
live.
  
  

* Mentor Technical Consultants — reviewing TC deliverables for quality, explaining MCN platform

patterns, unblocking technical issues and providing feedback aligned to factory standards.
  
  

* Contribute to the factory accelerator library — after every wave, updating reusable MCN

configuration templates, AMPscript snippet libraries, data migration scripts and validation toolkits in the
  
  
shared accelerator repository.
  
  
**Core Technical Skills — Must Have**

* Marketing Cloud Next — Hands-On Configuration: Proven ability to configure Email Studio, Journey

Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder and Contact Builder end-to-end, including sending domain
  
  
configuration, journey entry sources, decision splits and triggered sends.
  
  

* AMPscript & SSJS Development: Proficiency in AMPscript and SSJS for dynamic email personalisation

— lookup functions, conditional content, row sets, attribute rendering and legacy personalisation logic
  
  
recreation.
  
  

* Subscriber Data Migration Execution: Hands-on experience executing subscriber data migrations —

data extension population, bulk data loading via Import Wizard and API, suppression list management,
  
  
consent record migration and reconciliation validation at scale.
  
  

* Salesforce Data Cloud — Configuration: Working knowledge of Data Cloud data stream setup,

DLO/DMO schema configuration, field mapping and data ingestion validation.
  
  

* ETL Tools & Data Loading: Experience using at least one ETL tool (Informatica Cloud, Talend, Azure

Data Factory, MuleSoft) or scripted Bulk API / REST API approaches for subscriber data extraction,
  
  
transformation and loading.
  
  

* Apex & Platform Development: Ability to write Batch Apex, Schedulable classes, REST callout handlers

and Apex test classes for migration utility development, including subscriber reconciliation tools and
  
  
consent flag verification.
  
  

* Lightning Web Components & Salesforce Flow: Ability to build LWC migration dashboards, subscriber

count trackers and Salesforce Flow automations as internal factory tooling.
  
  

* CI/CD & Source Control: Comfortable working within Salesforce DX and Git-based workflows —

committing changes, following branching conventions, submitting PRs and using Gearset/Copado for
  
  
environment promotion.
  
  
**Preferred Skills — Good To Have**

* Experience migrating from Eloqua, Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot or legacy SFMC Classic to Marketing Cloud

Next
  
  

* Knowledge of Marketing Cloud Intelligence (Datorama) for cross-channel reporting post-migration
* Experience with WhatsApp, Push, SMS or LINE channel configuration in Marketing Cloud Next
* Familiarity with Marketing Cloud REST and SOAP API for programmatic data operations and triggered

sends
  
  

* Understanding of IP warm-up strategy and email deliverability monitoring tools (250ok, Validity/Return

Path)
  
  

* Exposure to Agentforce journeys triggered from Data Cloud activation segments

**Experience Requirements**

* 5–8 years of Salesforce and marketing technology delivery experience
* 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud / Marketing Cloud Next configuration experience
* Experience executing at least 1 end-to-end Marketing Cloud migration or large implementation project as

a key delivery contributor
  
  

* Demonstrated hands-on experience with subscriber data migration — bulk loading, data extension setup,

consent migration and reconciliation validation
  
  

* Experience mentoring junior Technical Consultants on MCN configuration and data migration tasks

9b1c38c6.description:
**About Team**
Sam’s Club eCommerce is a team of engineers passionate about taking care of our members and associates. The team helps build and maintain the foundational and experiential systems that allow our members to shop online, pick up in store, experience our several service offerings and check out in the club using Scan & Go. This team is geographically distributed but is tight knit and proud of what they do!
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Work with product managers, architects and engineering leaders to define and scope large and complex initiatives.
  
  
You will build Discovery and Execution plans that include coordination of numerous cross-functional teams
  
  
You will lead multiple teams of engineers to deliver cross-functional initiatives
  
  
You will identify, track and manage risks and issues that threaten project or program success
  
  
You will communicate to team members, peers and leadership in a way that supports effective program execution
  
  
You will work with your team of peer TPMs to drive consistency and improvement in technical program execution. This includes standardization of practices and tooling where it makes sense.
  
  
Build and maintain strong relationships with engineering management and stakeholders, including senior leadership, business partners, and external vendors.
  
  
Stay current with industry trends and advancements, incorporating new technologies and methodologies into project management practices.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
A deep experience in software engineering and technical program management. The candidate should have 10+ years of experience as a technical program manager leading large and cross-functional initiatives. This is a role where one can bring their wealth of experience and grow as a leader!
  
  
The candidate should have previous experience as a systems or software engineer. They are not expected to write software but should be able to contribute to design and architecture discussions based on previous experience.
  
  
The candidate should have experience in eCommerce industry, ideally retail eCommerce. This will help the candidate understand the technical and functional landscape so they can effectively manage across the numerous teams required to bring an eCommerce shopping experience to life.
  
  
The candidate should be a skilled communicator. This role requires an extremely effective communicator who can work with team members, peers and leaders.
  
  
The candidate should be comfortable communicating with senior leadership up to and including VP or SVP. They should be able to adjust their communication style for the audience.
  
  
The candidate should have several years of experience using Jira and Confluence to manage and track program execution.
  
  
Lastly, the candidate should have a very high level of integrity and respect for the individual. These are key attributes that define how we do all of our work.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive

**Job Summary**
**About the role**
Cognizant is looking for a Presales and Bid Manager to drive winning pursuits across our Data, Analytics, and AI business. In this role you will shape compelling client-facing proposals, orchestrate pursuit activities end to end, and partner with sales, delivery, and solution teams to bring our best thinking to every opportunity. If you thrive in a fast-paced, global environment and love turning complex ideas into persuasive narratives, we would love to meet you.
  
  
**In this role you will**

* Support opportunity qualification, account intelligence, and client research activities to strengthen every pursuit.
* Develop proposal content, presentations, response documents, and sales collateral that clearly articulate value.
* Coordinate pursuit activities, reviews, governance checkpoints, and submission timelines across stakeholders.
* Collaborate with solution teams to build compelling Data, Analytics, and AI value propositions.
* Track opportunity progress, risks, dependencies, and action items throughout the pursuit lifecycle.

**Work model**
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* Experience in pre-sales, business development support, bid management, or proposal management.
* An MBA degree.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into compelling client-facing content.
* Experience supporting RFPs, proposals, presentations, capability decks, and client research activities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.

**These will help you stand out**

* Ability to coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders across sales, delivery, and solution teams and manage pursuit processes in a structured manner.
* Familiarity with Data, Analytics, AI, and Generative AI concepts and solution narratives.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and collaboration tools, with exposure to proposal management and CRM platforms.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

We are excited to see how you will help shape the pursuits that define our future. Apply today and bring your talent to Cognizant.

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
We are seeking an experienced
**Presales Architect - Applications**
with deep expertise in
**enterprise data architecture and on-premises data platforms**
to support complex sales engagements.
  
  
This role focuses on designing
**scalable, secure, and high-performance data solutions within traditional enterprise environments**
, enabling organizations to modernize legacy systems, improve data governance, and enhance analytics capabilities.
  
  
You will partner with sales, delivery, and customer stakeholders to shape data strategies, build compelling proposals, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Solution Architecture & Design
* Lead discovery sessions to assess existing enterprise data ecosystems, legacy platforms, and business requirements
* Design end-to-end data architectures including:

+ Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW)
+ Operational Data Stores (ODS)
+ Data marts and reporting systems
+ Batch and near real-time data integration

* Define architectures across:

+ Relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, etc.)
+ ETL and data integration tools
+ Storage, archival, and lifecycle management systems

* Develop logical and physical data models aligned to business needs
* Ensure architectures meet requirements for performance, scalability, high availability, and disaster recovery
* Present solutions to technical and business stakeholders, linking architecture to business value
* Cost Modeling & Financial Analysis
* Develop detailed cost models covering:

+ Hardware (servers, storage, networking)
+ Software licensing (databases, ETL, BI tools)
+ Data processing and integration workloads
+ Ongoing operations and support

* Build bottom-up estimates using:

+ Data volumes and growth projections
+ Workload and performance requirements

* Conduct ROI and TCO analysis for:

+ Legacy modernization initiatives
+ Platform consolidation and optimization

* Compare alternative architecture approaches (e.g., centralized vs distributed data platforms)
* Validate cost assumptions with delivery and finance teams
* Technical Proposal Development
* Develop comprehensive proposals including:

+ Data architecture diagrams
+ Data flow and integration patterns
+ Implementation roadmaps and migration plans
+ Resource planning and timelines
+ Risk mitigation strategies and governance models

* Clearly articulate business value including:

+ Improved data quality and reliability
+ Faster reporting and analytics
+ Operational efficiency and cost savings

* Collaborate with delivery, engineering, and finance teams to ensure feasibility
* Use GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) to:

+ Accelerate documentation
+ Improve clarity and structure of proposals
+ Synthesize complex requirements

* Data Modernization & Transformation
* Define strategies for:

+ Legacy data warehouse modernization
+ Data platform consolidation
+ ETL optimization and re-engineering
+ Data archival and lifecycle management

* Recommend approaches such as:

+ Replatforming to modern database systems
+ Data model redesign (dimensional, normalized, data vault)

* Enable capabilities for:

+ Near real-time data availability
+ Improved reporting performance
+ Better data accessibility

* Data Governance, Quality & Security
* Design and implement frameworks for:

+ Data governance and stewardship
+ Data quality management
+ Metadata management and lineage

* Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards:

+ Role-based access control
+ Data masking and encryption
+ Regulatory compliance requirements

* Delivery Partnership & Post-Sales Alignment
* Ensure solutions are aligned with delivery capabilities and operational models
* Develop transition documents and implementation playbooks
* Support project kickoffs and early delivery alignment
* Define SLAs, KPIs, and operational metrics

Capture feedback to improve solution quality and reusability
  
  
**You will be successful in this role if you have:**
BA/BS degree and 10+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and experience
  
  
Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* 8–12 years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or presales consulting
* Minimum 5 years focused on enterprise data platforms in on-premises environments
* Proven track record in:

+ Designing enterprise data solutions
+ Supporting and influencing large deals
+ Building cost models and ROI justifications

* Experience in RFP responses and technical proposal development

**Technical Expertise**

* Strong experience with enterprise database platforms:

+ Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, or similar

* Deep understanding of:

+ Data warehousing concepts (EDW, ODS, data marts)
+ Data modeling techniques (dimensional, normalized, data vault)

* Hands-on experience with:

+ ETL/ELT tools (Informatica, DataStage, SSIS, etc.)
+ Batch and near real-time data integration

* Knowledge of:

+ Data governance, metadata, and data quality tools
+ Performance tuning and query optimization

* Experience with:

+ High availability, backup, and disaster recovery strategies

* Familiarity with BI/reporting tools (Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, etc.)
* Proficiency in using GenAI tools for presales productivity and documentation

**Business & Soft Skills**

* Strong ability to translate data architecture into business value
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Consultative approach to discovery and problem-solving
* Ability to manage multiple presales opportunities
* Strong collaboration across cross-functional teams
* Financial acumen in cost modeling and ROI analysis

**Certifications & Nice-to-Haves**

* Certifications in database technologies or data management
* Knowledge of frameworks such as DAMA-DMBOK
* Experience in system integrators or managed services environments
* Familiarity with MPP or appliance-based data systems (e.g., Teradata, Netezza)
* Experience with data modeling tools (ERwin, ER/Studio, etc.)
* Thought leadership in enterprise data architecture

**Success Metrics**

* Contribution to deal wins involving data solutions
* Accuracy and competitiveness of cost models
* Quality and scalability of architecture designs
* Customer satisfaction and successful delivery alignment
* Reusability of solution frameworks and assets

9c4d910c.title: Global Partner Solution Engineer – Cisco & Splunk
9c4d910c.description:
**Meet the Team**
Splunk is growing its Global Partner Technical team and is looking for a Global Partner Solution Engineer (Partner SE) to help develop, improve, and scale the productivity and capabilities of our Global Solution Integrator (GSI) partner ecosystem across industries and business segments. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of Cisco and Splunk technology, partners, and customers—creating scalable solutions, enabling partner-led growth, and building trusted technical relationships that drive business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Global Partner Solution Engineer, you will be a strategic technical advisor to partners, customers, and internal sales teams. You’ll combine deep technical expertise with strong business acumen to help GSIs create new solutions and services, accelerate opportunities, expand within existing accounts, and differentiate Cisco and Splunk from the competition.
  
  

* Develop multi-year strategic plans with GSIs, integrating Cisco and Splunk technologies into differentiated solutions and service offerings.
* Lead technical engagements including executive discussions, customer workshops, demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions, and solution design activities.
* Build and mature partner technical practices and Centers of Excellence (CoEs), including enablement, certification, and activation of partner resources.
* Drive partner-led demand generation by identifying new opportunities, developing solution frameworks, and enabling cross-sell, up-sell, and competitive displacement strategies.
* Collaborate with account teams, Business Entities, product teams, and extended sales organizations to influence deal strategy, provide competitive intelligence, and translate customer and partner needs into technical requirements.
* Create scalable technical assets, demos, webinars, and other enablement content that help partners develop and deliver new solutions.
* Lead virtual technical teams through complex sales cycles, mobilizing the right resources to progress and close strategic opportunities.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer and partner stakeholders, shaping technology strategies and demonstrating the business value of Cisco and Splunk solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related experience, Master’s degree with 6+ years of related experience, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
* 5+ years of experience in a technical sales, solutions engineering, consulting, partner engineering, or related customer-facing technical role.
* Experience designing and presenting technical solutions to customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Experience working across complex technology environments and translating business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to travel up to 40%.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cloud, ITOps/Observability, Security, Big Data, Edge, IoT, IIoT, or closely related domains.
* Hands-on expertise in two or more technologies including Splunk SIEM/SOAR/Platform, Cisco XDR, Talos, ThousandEyes, Meraki, Splunk Observability Cloud, AppDynamics, Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Infrastructure as Code, Cloud Native Technologies, or Microservices Architectures.
* Experience building or maturing a technical practice, partner capability, or Center of Excellence focused on developing and scaling service offerings.
* Proven experience delivering technical workshops, webinars, demonstrations, or presentations at external industry events.
* Strong communication, presentation, influencing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage technical and executive stakeholders across partner and customer organizations.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and

Bachelor's Degree

* Sound understanding of computer architecture and embedded SW stacks.
* Skills around integrating flows involving debug and simulation tools is desired.
* Must have excellent debugging skills with ability to understand HW/SW interactions.

Behavioral skills
  
  

* Must possess strong written, verbal and presentation skills.

Vertical Head- Software & Hardware Engineering

Individual Contributor Role

Smart home solution development / ecosystem development: Lead the development of an integrated Smart Home solution in collaboration with ecosystem partners, bringing video doorbells/video door phones, smart locks and smart switches together through a unified connected platform and mobile application. Define seamless user journeys, voice-assistant integration and application use cases to deliver a secure, reliable, interoperable and intuitive smart-home experience.

**KEY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the end-to-end smart-home solution architecture and product roadmap, working with ecosystem partners, device OEMs, platform providers and internal R&D teams to define a unified user experience.
* Identify and translate customer needs into application use cases, user journeys, product requirements, functional specifications, system workflows and measurable acceptance criteria.

* Define and deliver use cases such as visitor notification and two-way communication, remote door unlocking, access permissions, event history, lighting control, scenes, schedules, automation rules and device-status notifications, subject to device capabilities and safety requirements.
* Drive mobile application requirements and integration, including device onboarding and pairing, home/room/device management, user and family access, notifications, settings, firmware status and troubleshooting journeys.
* Integrate voice assistants and voice-based control, including supported commands, device discovery, scene activation and status feedback; coordinate compatibility and certification with the selected ecosystem partners.

* Evaluate and manage ecosystem partners for devices, mobile apps, cloud platforms, voice assistants and integration services; assess technical capability, security, product maturity, commercial fit, roadmap alignment and long-term support.
* Own system-level integration plans, interface specifications, data models, device capability mapping, partner dependencies, release compatibility and end-to-end acceptance criteria.
* Ensure privacy and security by design for video, access-control and home-user data, including authentication, role-based permissions, encryption, secure device onboarding, consent-aware data handling, audit trails, vulnerability management and secure update processes.
* Coordinate integration and validation across device firmware, cloud/platform services, mobile applications and voice ecosystems; lead end-to-end testing, interoperability testing, regression testing, field trials, UAT and defect closure.
* Define reliability and serviceability requirements, including offline behaviour, connectivity recovery, device health, remote diagnostics, incident handling, firmware/software version compatibility and customer support workflows.
* Drive partner and internal teams through design reviews, proof-of-concepts, integration milestones, release readiness and post-launch improvements; manage technical risks, dependencies and issue resolution.
* Work closely with product management, design, firmware, software, cybersecurity, quality, sourcing, marketing, sales and service teams to deliver a market-ready solution within agreed scope, quality, cost and schedule.
* Maintain solution architecture, API/interface documents, use-case catalogues, test plans, integration guides, release notes and operational/support documentation.
* Monitor customer feedback, product usage and ecosystem developments to prioritise enhancements, expand compatible devices and continuously improve the smart-home experience.

**EDUCATIONAL** **QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Bachelors degree in Electronics / Electrical / Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* • A postgraduate qualification in embedded systems, IoT, software engineering or product development is an advantage.

**WORK** **EXPERIENCE**

  

* • 1012 years of relevant experience in IoT, connected consumer products, smart-home solutions, embedded/software integration or digital product engineering.
* • Demonstrated experience delivering an integrated connected product or platform involving multiple devices, mobile applications and external technology partners.
* • Experience taking solutions from requirements and proof-of-concept through integration, validation, launch and post-launch support.

**CERTIFICATIONS**

  

* Relevant certifications in IoT, cloud platforms, mobile/application integration, cybersecurity or smart-home interoperability standards are desirable.

**PREFERRED/** **ADDITIONAL** **REQUIREMENT**

  

* • Strong understanding of IoT architectures, connected platforms, mobile applications, APIs/SDKs and device-to-cloud integration.
* • Hands-on or technical leadership experience integrating video doorbells/video door phones, smart locks and smart switches.
* • Familiarity with voice assistant ecosystems and smart-home interoperability technologies such as Matter, Zigbee, Wi-Fi and BLE; experience will depend on the selected product architecture.

* • Experience in partner evaluation, technical negotiations, joint development, integration governance and vendor performance management.
* • Strong system-level troubleshooting, stakeholder management, technical documentation and cross-functional delivery skills.
* • Experience launching consumer smart-home products at scale and supporting customer-facing applications is preferred.

**INTERNAL** **/** **EXTERNAL** **INTERFACE**

  

* Internal: R&D, Electronics, Firmware, Software, IoT/Cloud, Mobile App, Cybersecurity, Quality & Validation, Product Management, Sourcing, Marketing, Sales and Service.
* External: Smart lock, video doorbell/video door phone and smart switch OEMs; smart-home platform providers; mobile app and cloud partners; voice assistant ecosystem providers; connectivity/chipset partners; certification and testing agencies.

* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.

ef8a5594.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Fulfillment By Amazon (FBA)
ef8a5594.description:
**Description**
Ready to do something big?
  
  
How would you build the next generation of mission-critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store, and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?
  
  
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for worldwide sellers that offers access to Amazon's vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, leveraging our world-class infrastructure. Sellers in 135 countries worldwide, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, rely upon our technology to grow and thrive on Amazon's Marketplaces.
  
  
In a very real way, we are changing lives with the work we do. FBA team members wake up every day thinking about how to enable our sellers to be successful by building highly scalable and highly reliable platforms. Enabling seller success allows us to provide Amazon customers with unparalleled selection and pricing. FBA is a win for sellers and a win for customers.
  
  
What is Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA)?
  
  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IAi4fPb\_kp4&t=2s
  
  
The Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) team
  
  
https://vimeo.com/80948105
  
  
Third-party sellers have become one of Amazon's greatest growth engines, outpacing our own first-party retail business for years. That success did not happen by accident. We invested in building the best possible selling tools — from inventory management and payment processing to shipment tracking, reporting, and cross-border commerce — and we continue to invent new ones every year. FBA and the Prime membership program sit at the heart of that effort, dramatically improving the customer experience of buying from independent sellers and unlocking growth for businesses of every size.
  
  
As a Principal Technical Program Manager with FBA, you will lead broad cross-organization efforts from the early stages through release. You will work closely with product managers, engineering managers, scientists, and engineers to build the next generation of seller platforms. You will be responsible for influencing the organization's product and technical roadmap and technical architecture. You will drive organization-wide engineering and operational excellence initiatives, represent difficult trade-off decisions and solutions clearly to senior leaders, and leverage your technical knowledge to guide technical choices. You will manage cross-functional and cross-organization communication to ensure all stakeholders are informed and needs are aligned, guiding technical direction to deliver solutions that meet Amazon's high standards for customer satisfaction, efficiency, stability, extensibility, simplicity, and operational excellence.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead broad, cross-organizational programs from strategy definition through delivery, owning the technology roadmap for seller-facing platforms and driving alignment across product, engineering, and science teams.
* Define and decompose complex technical problems into clear solutions, assessing risk, driving clarity, and creating the right sense of urgency to keep programs on track.
* Influence the organization's product and technical architecture by applying deep system knowledge, identifying gaps across services and workflows, and proposing improvements that reduce repeated effort year over year.
* Partner with senior leadership to communicate trade-offs, present options, and drive decisions — managing cross-functional stakeholder alignment and escalating with strong judgment when necessary.
* Amplify your impact by mentoring other technical program managers, driving adoption of program management best practices, and contributing to the broader technical community.

A day in the life
  
  
Your primary focus will be guiding large-scale, cross-team programs that directly shape how millions of sellers interact with Amazon's fulfillment network. You will spend your time working across product managers, engineering leaders, and scientists — aligning priorities, unblocking technical decisions, and ensuring delivery stays on course. Expect a mix of deep technical design reviews, strategic roadmap discussions with senior leaders, and hands-on problem solving when programs hit ambiguity.
  
  
**About The Team**
The FBA team builds and operates the platforms that enable sellers in 135 countries to store, ship, and manage billions of products through Amazon's global fulfillment network. Our mission is straightforward: make sellers successful so customers get the selection and value they expect. We are investing in the next generation of seller tools and infrastructure, and this role will be central to shaping that future. If you want to work on programs that operate at massive scale and have a direct impact on both sellers and customers worldwide, this is the team for you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience managing technical programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Role Summary**
  
Microsoft Copilot Architect who owns the end-to-end architecture for Microsoft 365 Copilot and enterprise Copilot Studio agents: from tenant readiness, rollout and extensibility of Microsoft 365 Copilot to the design, integration, governance and scaled deployment of single- and multi-agent solutions. A hands-on architect who sets standards and reference architectures, guides delivery teams, and advises business and IT stakeholders on where and how Copilot creates value

  

**Why This Role Matters**
  
AI is changing how organizations work, and Microsoft Copilot is quickly becoming the main way employees interact with enterprise data, applications and workflows. Getting value from it depends on sound architecture: the right data foundations, the right agent for each use case, and governance that lets the business move quickly without losing control. This role sits at the center of that shift and sets the direction for how Microsoft 365 Copilot and enterprise agents are designed, secured and scaled.

**What You’ll Do**
  
Define the target architecture and roadmap for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio agents, aligned to business priorities and use-case value.
  
Lead Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness and rollout: assess tenant, data and permissions; remediate oversharing; configure admin, security and compliance controls; and plan phased deployment.
  
Choose the right build pattern for each use case (out-of-the-box Microsoft 365 Copilot, declarative agent, Copilot Studio agent, or agent extension using Azure services) and document the decision criteria.
  
Architect and guide the build of enterprise Copilot Studio agents, including autonomous and multi-agent solutions, from proof of concept through to production.
  
Design integrations with enterprise applications, preferably Veeva and Workday, using standard and custom connectors, APIs, MCP servers and Copilot connectors.
  
Define the knowledge and grounding strategy across SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph and external sources, and own answer quality and accuracy.
  
Establish the governance model: environment strategy, DLP policies, agent inventory and lifecycle, sharing and publishing controls, Purview policies and responsible AI guardrails.
  
Set up ALM, CI/CD, testing and evaluation, and release management for Copilot solutions.
  
Put observability in place: monitoring, analytics, quality metrics, and tracking of license and consumption costs.
  
Run or contribute to a Copilot Centre of Excellence: reference architectures, reusable components, templates, standards and design reviews.

**Must-Have Skills**
  
12+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise solutions on the Microsoft stack, including 4+ years in a solution lead role.
  
2 – 3 years of hands-on experience with both Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Studio.
  
Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness and rollout: licensing, tenant and data readiness, oversharing assessment and remediation, SharePoint and OneDrive permissions hygiene, admin controls and usage analytics.
  
Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility: declarative agents, custom engine agents, Copilot connectors (Microsoft Graph connectors), API plugins and the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
  
2 – 3 years of experience in Copilot Studio agent design: Trigger Phrases & Intent Recognition, Entities & Slot Filling, Adaptive Cards, Variables & Conversation State Management, Generative Orchestration, Knowledge Sources, Generative Answers & Custom Prompts, Tools, Connectors & Agent Flows.
  
Experience designing autonomous agents and Multi-Agent Orchestration (connected and child agents, handoffs, human-in-the-loop) for cross-functional business processes.
  
2+ years of experience in MCP Integration with Copilot Studio, Governance, Observability and Enterprise Deployment at Scale.
  
2 – 3 years of Copilot setup, administration, configuration, and governance, including environment strategy, DLP policies, managed environments, and agent sharing and publishing controls.
  
3+ years of experience creating and configuring standard and custom connectors.
  
2 – 3 years of experience integrating Copilot with enterprise applications, preferably Veeva and Workday.
  
5+ years of experience in APIs, REST services, OAuth, authentication, and data integration patterns.
  
3+ years of experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps and Dataverse.

**Good to Have**
  
Azure AI services: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and AI Builder for advanced AI scenarios
  
Azure platform: Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management and Azure Bot Service for extending and hosting integrations
  
Microsoft Graph API: Accessing Microsoft 365 data and building custom integrations
  
SharePoint and Dataverse: Using them as knowledge sources and data stores for Copilot agents, including SharePoint Advanced Management for content governance

1d4cc06e.description:
**ABOUT TELENCE SOLUTIONS**

Telence Solutions is a multi-vendor network engineering, cybersecurity and AI operations partner for service providers and mission-critical industries. From RFP to design, migration and managed operations, we deliver vendor-level depth across IP/MPLS, optics, wireless, broadband, security, cloud, automation and AIOps. Our 70+ certified engineers work across pre-sales, post-sales and operational support, and our Autonomic Network Engine (ANE) unifies orchestration across domains.

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a senior software architect to design and lead the delivery of cloud-native, AI-enabled applications. You will own the architecture from scaffolding to production across web, mobile, serverless and machine learning workloads, and mentor distributed engineering teams.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

* Own the architecture of new products from scaffolding to production, including tech stack selection and architecture decision records
* Design and build scalable backend services in Node.js and TypeScript (Express, NestJS) with REST and GraphQL APIs
* Architect microservices and event-driven systems using Kafka, SQS/SNS and AWS Lambda, deployed with Docker and Kubernetes
* Design and ship generative AI features on AWS: RAG pipelines with vector search, Amazon Bedrock and SageMaker, with guardrails and monitoring
* Build ML pipelines for data ingestion, training, deployment, A/B testing and production monitoring
* Provision multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure) as code with Terraform and AWS CDK, and run CI/CD with blue-green and canary releases
* Guide micro-frontend and cross-platform front ends built in React and React Native
* Apply security and data-integrity practices: least-privilege access, request validation and immutable audit logs
* Lead, mentor and review the work of distributed engineering and data teams, and agree roadmaps with product managers and architects across time zones
* Write reference architectures, runbooks and decision records, and present them to technical and non-technical audiences

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* Experience: 10+ years in software engineering, including several years as an architect or technical lead delivering products from scratch
* Languages: JavaScript and TypeScript on Node.js; familiarity with Java
* Backend and APIs: Express, NestJS, GraphQL (fragments, directives, subscriptions), REST and WebSockets
* Cloud: hands-on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SageMaker, Bedrock, OpenSearch, DynamoDB, S3, ECS/EKS) and Azure (Functions, DevOps)
* AI and ML: RAG, prompt engineering, LLM integration, model hosting and MLOps
* Data: Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB and DynamoDB, including ACID, CAP, replication and sharding
* Architecture patterns: microservices, DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, serverless and twelve-factor
* DevOps: Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines
* Front end: React (hooks, Redux), React Native and Next.js
* Communication: clear documentation and experience leading distributed teams

**CERTIFICATIONS**

* Preferred: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
* Valued: Apollo GraphQL Professional

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Real-time systems with WebSockets and WebRTC
* IoT data integration
* Regulated domains such as healthcare (HIPAA compliance)
* Computer vision with TensorFlow or OpenCV

Telence Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.

71d57d15.title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect WAN/SDWAN
71d57d15.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's wide area network and software-defined WAN platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
  
  
The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
* Extensive experience designing enterprise wide area network and software defined wide area network services.
* Deep knowledge of Border Gateway Protocol, quality of service, resilient routing, internet connectivity and carrier services.
* Evidence of defining reusable architectures that improved performance, security, resilience or cost.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Expert level enterprise routing certification, such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or JNCIE Enterprise Routing and Switching.
* Experience with leading software defined wide area network or secure access service edge platforms.
* Experience with cloud connectivity, network automation or infrastructure as code.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Architecture Reviews, Automation Technology, Cisco Software-Defined (SD) Wide Access Network (WAN) Management, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Design Assurance, IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Platform Architecture, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wide Area Network (WAN), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
