ea1ac741.title: Senior Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Automation
ea1ac741.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Cloud Foundations Engineer – Automation builds and runs the Internal Hosting Portal, with a focus on its server side and workflow automation, that allows application teams across GSK to provision and manage Cloud resources in a self-service manner. The Hosting Portal is a custom-built web application using a modern tech stack based on TypeScript. The automation engineer sets the engineering standard within that platform, owns the portal’s APIs, integrations and workflow orchestration, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through automated software deployment rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil. The role also connects the Hosting Portal to the enterprise infrastructure-as-code platform, so that teams starting their cloud journey in the portal are onboarded to it and can discover its golden paths.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate the provisioning of foundational infrastructure resources through the portal’s services, integrations and workflows, using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting services and workflows for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Why is this level of Education Required?**

* Deep engineering credentials are needed because the role sets the engineering standard other engineers and partner teams build to, and that standard has to hold under code review rather than by assertion.

**Related Experience Required**

* Typically 8-10 years in cloud, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Excellent knowledge and hands on experience with TypeScript (ES6+) and Node.js server-side development.
* Developed REST and GraphQL APIs based on Node.js (Express).
* Integrating with cloud provider and third-party APIs, with retries, idempotency and error handling for long-running operations.
* Designing and automating long-running, multi-step processes (retries, timeouts, compensation, human approval steps) using a workflow orchestration or durable-execution approach.
* Working knowledge of landing zones and serverless technologies across Azure and GCP.
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Building and deploying through CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) with Docker, and operating services on Microsoft Azure (App Service, Application Insights).
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Good knowledge and hands on experience with HTML5, CSS3 (including preprocessors)
* Good knowledge and hands on experience with React, NextJS, GraphQL, Yoga, Prisma ORM, and Apollo Client. Previous experience in developing a React UIs with Mantine, Material UI, or Chakra UI. Familiar with popular patterns and libraries such as React Hooks, and server-state management (Apollo Client, TanStack Query). Previously developed schema-based forms either custom or based on a library such as react-hook-form or Formik, including data validator libraries such as Yup, Zod or JOI. Knowledge of modern authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth v2 or SAML and JSON Web Token and libraries such as MSAL.
* Strong experience with test automation (unit & integration) tools such as Jest and Cypress.

**Desirable:**

* Previously worked in a central IT team within a regulated environment such as the Pharmaceutical or Finance industry, including knowledge of GxP, validation and audit readiness.
* undefined
* Workflow orchestration tools such as Temporal, Camunda, Azure Durable Functions or AWS Step Functions.
* Experience with internal developer platforms, self-service portals or golden-path catalogues (e.g., Backstage).
* Building LLM-powered features (tool use / MCP).
* Scripting in Python and PowerShell.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

b1aebbaf.title: Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)
b1aebbaf.description:
**Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)**  
JOB DESCRIPTION | SECURITY L3 | Technical Service Delivery & Engineering | Hyderabad Service Delivery Center  
**Company:** Palmiq  
**Palmiq Role:** Senior IT Support Specialist - Security Operations Center (L3)  
**Department:** Technical Service Delivery & Engineering  
**Reporting To:** Service Delivery Manager  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Role Category:** Engineering  
**Industry Type:** Emerging Technologies (SOC, Compliance & Cloud)  
**Experience:** 4-6 Years (Min. 3+ yrs hands-on Cloud Security, M365/Purview & Compliance)  
**Compensation:** INR 10 LPA - INR 16 LPA (commensurate with L3 experience)  
**Location:** Hyderabad, India (Remote initially; in-person at HYD office next year)  
**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
Palmiq is seeking a hands-on **Senior Cloud Security & Compliance Engineer (L3)** to serve as the senior technical escalation point across our managed enterprise clients. This role sits at the intersection of **Microsoft 365 & AI Data Governance (Purview/Copilot), Regulatory Compliance (CMMC/HIPAA/NIST/CIS), Identity & Endpoint Security, SecOps (SIEM/XDR), Network Security (Fortinet), and Cloud Migrations**. You will lead complex client security remediations and incident response, mentor L1/L2 engineers, and partner with Service Delivery leadership on technical scoping, Statements of Work (SOWs), security architecture reviews, and executive reporting.  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**1. Data Security, Microsoft Purview & AI Governance**

* Design, deploy, optimize, and troubleshoot **Microsoft Purview** policies, including custom Sensitivity Labels, Auto-Labeling policies (using sensitive information types/identifier formats), **Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**, and **Insider Risk Management**.
* Implement and enforce **data protection lifecycle controls**, including encryption in-transit and at-rest, data retention policies, legal holds, and purge workflows.
* Lead **Microsoft 365 Copilot security and readiness** engagements - disabling external web search where required, blocking Copilot from summarizing labeled sensitive files or accepting restricted prompts, and validating audit logging and retention.
* Audit and remediate **SharePoint and Teams oversharing** by removing company-wide/"everyone" access and enforcing strict named-user sharing defaults.

**2. GRC & Regulatory Compliance (CMMC, HIPAA, NIST & CIS)**

* Execute technical remediation activities aligned with **CMMC, HIPAA, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls** across regulated client environments.
* Establish repeatable compliance procedures, perform quality assurance (QA) checks, conduct **periodic access reviews**, re-run readiness assessments, and compile audit-ready compliance evidence packs for client handover.

**3. Identity, Endpoint Security & SecOps**

* Enforce **IAM/RBAC**, least-privilege access, **Privileged Access Management (PAM)**, and **Zero Trust principles** across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID (hybrid identity) environments.
* Manage and enforce device security baselines via **Microsoft Intune** and **Entra ID Conditional Access** - ensuring corporate devices are enrolled, encrypted, and compliant while restricting unmanaged/personal devices to browser-only access with no downloads.
* Drive continuous **Vulnerability Assessment & Management (VAM)**, structured patch cadence, endpoint/infrastructure security hardening, and **SIEM/XDR operations** (including audit log integrity, threat triage, and KQL-based investigations).
* Build and maintain security automation scripts and workflows using **PowerShell** (and optionally Python or Logic Apps) to streamline bulk M365, Intune, and Purview remediations.

**4. Network Security & Firewall Administration**

* Administer, configure, and troubleshoot **Fortinet (FortiGate) firewalls** and enterprise/cloud network security controls for managed and regulated clients.
* Lead cross-client firewall patching to established quality standards and manage **wireless access point (WAP) certificate updates**.

**5. Cloud Migrations & Workspace Hardening**

* Execute end-to-end **Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace** mailbox and file migrations, including post-migration validation, final delta synchronization, and confirmation of data accessibility and completeness.
* Perform **Google Workspace security hardening**, including configuring Organizational Units (OUs), access controls, MFA enforcement, security alerts, and Gmail security protections.

**6. L3 Escalation, Incident Response, ITSM & Technical Project Delivery**

* Serve as the senior **L3 escalation and de-escalation point** across all clients, including structured on-call support for L1/L2 teams.
* Lead major security incidents (containment, eradication, and recovery), develop **incident response playbooks**, and support client tabletop drills.
* Drive **ITIL v4 Change Enablement** (ensuring rollback plans before critical changes and acting as change manager where required) and **Problem Management** (leading Post-Incident Reviews, Root Cause Analysis, and Knowledge Base linking).
* Mentor and train L1/L2 engineers on firewall standards, security best practices, and compliance execution.
* Partner with Service Delivery leadership to conduct initial client assessments, perform security architecture reviews, author technical **Statements of Work (SOWs)**, and deliver structured end-of-project reports and executive dashboards for senior leadership.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. in Any Specialization (Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, or a related technical field preferred).
* **Domain Experience:** 4-6 years of overall IT/cybersecurity experience, with at least 3+ years of hands-on Cloud Security, M365/Purview, and Compliance delivery (multi-client MSP or enterprise consulting experience strongly valued).
* **Compliance & GRC:** Practical working knowledge of CMMC, HIPAA, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls, including technical remediation, periodic access reviews, and audit evidence gathering.
* **Cloud & Migrations:** Proven experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace administration, security hardening, and cross-platform migrations.
* **Consulting & Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to conduct security architecture reviews, author technical SOWs, produce executive reports, and de-escalate high-priority client issues.

**EXPECTED EXPERTISE (TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES)**  
**Required Expertise - Core Operational Stack**

* **Microsoft 365, Data & Endpoint Governance:** Deep hands-on expertise in **Microsoft Purview** (Sensitivity Labels, Auto-Labeling, DLP, Insider Risk, Retention/Legal Hold), **Microsoft Intune**, **Entra ID Conditional Access**, Active Directory/Entra ID hybrid identity, SharePoint/Teams permissions, and M365 Copilot governance.
* **SIEM & Querying:** Hands-on proficiency operating and investigating security events across **Microsoft Sentinel** and enterprise **SIEM platforms (Splunk / ELK)**, including writing **Kusto Query Language (KQL)** queries for log correlation, alert tuning, and threat hunting.
* **EDR / XDR:** Operational expertise in **EDR / XDR** platforms - specifically **Microsoft Defender XDR** - for endpoint and cloud threat triage, containment, and root cause analysis.
* **Privileged Access Management (PAM):** Practical experience implementing and governing **PAM** controls (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID PIM, CyberArk, or equivalent) alongside IAM/RBAC and Zero Trust enforcement.
* **Vulnerability Assessment & Management (VAM):** End-to-end **VAM** execution, covering continuous vulnerability discovery, prioritization, structured patching, and remediation verification.
* **Firewalls & Perimeter Security:** Proven hands-on experience managing **Firewalls** - specifically **Fortinet (FortiGate)** - covering VPNs, policy management, firmware patching, and certificate administration.
* **Automation:** Working proficiency in **PowerShell** scripting (with exposure to Python or Azure Logic Apps) to automate M365, Intune, Purview, and SecOps tasks.

**Preferred Expertise - Good-to-Have / Expanding Client Scope**

* **Edge, Application & Traffic Security:** Working knowledge of **Web Application Firewalls (WAF)**, **DDoS** protection controls, and **Load Balancers (LB)** across enterprise and cloud environments.
* **Secrets Management & Zero-Trust Access:** Exposure to secrets and encryption lifecycle tooling including **Vault, KMS, and HSM**, as well as Zero-Trust privileged access platforms such as **HashiCorp Boundary** (or equivalent).
* **Container & Policy-as-Code Security:** Familiarity with container **image scanners (Trivy / Clair)** and Kubernetes policy enforcement using **OPA / Gatekeeper**.

**CERTIFICATIONS**  
**Preferred Certifications (One or More Strongly Preferred)**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (**SC-401**, formerly SC-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (**SC-300**) or Azure Security Engineer Associate (**AZ-500**)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (**SC-200**)
* **Fortinet NSE 4** (FortiOS Administrator) or equivalent network security certification

This role is responsible to lead portfolio-wide execution and governance across strategic product and technology programs. **c) Integrated planning and prioritization:** Lead, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and rolling planning across product pillars. Reconcile capacity, regulatory commitments, business-critical dates, technical dependencies and vendor plans; expose trade-offs for leadership decision.

  

**d) Governance and decision architecture:** Design and chair reviews, SteerCos and escalation forums. Ensure each forum has a clear purpose, accurate inputs, decision rights, actions, owners and closure discipline.

  

**e) Delivery assurance:** Independently assess programme health beyond reported RAG status. Validate critical path, milestones, resource assumptions, quality gates, readiness and benefits dependencies.

  

**f) Cross-programme dependency management:** Identify shared services, platform, data, API, security, infrastructure and partner dependencies; assign ownership and resolve sequencing conflicts before they affect delivery.

  

**g) Risk, issue and escalation management:** Maintain an executive RAID view, drive mitigation and trigger escalation at the right point. Distinguish decisions, risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies; prevent silent slippage.

  

**h) Commercial and vendor governance:** Govern delivery obligations, milestones, resource commitments, change requests, SLA performance, commercials and escalations for implementation and managed-service partners.

  

**i) Financial governance:** Track approved business cases, programme budgets, forecasts, purchase dependencies, change costs and benefit assumptions in partnership with Finance and procurement owners.

**k) Regulatory and audit readiness:** Ensure traceability of mandatory commitments, approvals, evidence, controls, risks and closure for regulatory, compliance and audit programmes.

  

**l) Capability and standards:** Establish consistent planning, status reporting, RAID, dependency, release-readiness and decision-log standards. Coach Program Managers to become outcome-led leaders rather than coordinators.

  

**Requirements:**

* Programme / project certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or equivalent is desirable, but demonstrated delivery leadership is more important than certification alone.

**Greetings!!!**

  

**Please find below Job Description:**

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Generative AI Architect with a strong foundation in enterprise and system architecture, combined with significant depth and breadth in Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI application development. This is a senior cross-cutting role responsible for architecting, designing, and guiding the implementation of Industry AI Solutions (IAIS) across multiple teams.

The Generative AI Architect will serve as the technical authority for AI architecture decisions within their assigned teams, working alongside embedded GenAI Developers (who report to this architect for technical direction), traditional software engineers, and business stakeholders. The architect bridges the worlds of robust enterprise system design and cutting-edge AI capabilities translating business goals into scalable, secure, production-ready GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Cross-team Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Architect and own the end-to-end Solution Design, working alongside a System Architect or alone for an Industry AI Solution Team, ensuring architectural consistency, pattern reuse, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Serve as the primary technical authority for GenAI and Agentic AI architecture decisions within assigned teams, providing direction to embedded GenAI Developers and guiding their implementation work.
* Define and enforce architecture standards, design patterns, reference architectures, and guardrails for GenAI and Agentic AI development across teams.
* Lead architecture reviews, proof-of-concept evaluations, and technical design discussions for AI features and components.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Solution Design**

* Design scalable, production-grade GenAI application architectures including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Agentic Workflows, LLM integration layers, prompt management systems, and response evaluation frameworks.
* Architect multi-agent systems and Agentic AI workflows: agent orchestration patterns, tool use, memory management, long-horizon task execution, and human-in-the-loop designs.
* Select and evaluate appropriate LLMs, embedding models, and AI frameworks (commercial and open-source) based on performance, cost, latency, and compliance requirements.
* Define LLM fine-tuning and adaptation strategies (RLHF, PEFT, LoRA, prompt tuning) where required, overseeing implementation by the developer team.
* Design LLMOps and AI observability pipelines including evaluation frameworks, tracing, monitoring, and feedback loops for deployed AI systems.

**Enterprise System Architecture**

* Apply deep system architecture expertise to ensure GenAI solutions integrate seamlessly into existing enterprise platforms including CRM, ERP, workflow automation tools, and analytics systems.
* Design robust, secure API layers, microservices, and event-driven integration patterns that connect AI components with enterprise backends.
* Ensure AI architectures meet enterprise non-functional requirements: scalability, availability, latency, security, and disaster recovery.
* Collaborate with infrastructure and cloud teams to architect AI workloads on cloud platforms (Azure preferred: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure ML) with appropriate cost and performance optimisation.

**Opportunity:** Suitable for experienced DevSecOps Engineers, Cloud Security Engineers, and Kubernetes Security Specialists seeking additional freelance income or part-time consulting opportunities alongside their existing employment.

We are seeking experienced professionals with strong hands-on expertise in Kubernetes Security, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Terraform, AWS Security Services, GitHub Actions, Python, and Enterprise Cloud Security Architecture.

**1. Core DevSecOps & Application Security Technologies**

* Kubernetes Security – Securing Kubernetes clusters, workloads, namespaces, service accounts, RBAC, and containerized applications.
* Trivy – Container image scanning, vulnerability detection, SBOM generation, and Infrastructure as Code security scanning.
* Snyk – Open-source dependency scanning, container security, license compliance, and vulnerability remediation.
* SonarQube – Static Application Security Testing (SAST), code quality analysis, security hotspots, and automated quality gates.
* Checkov – Infrastructure as Code security scanning, cloud misconfiguration detection, and policy enforcement.
* Terraform – Secure infrastructure provisioning, reusable modules, state management, and automated cloud resource deployment.
* AWS IAM / GuardDuty – Identity and access management, threat detection, and cloud security monitoring.
* GitHub Actions – Secure CI/CD workflows, automated security scanning, and DevSecOps pipeline integration.
* Python – Security automation, vulnerability reporting, cloud security scripting, and incident response utilities.

**2. Security Architecture, Threat Modeling & Risk Management**

* Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA) – Implementing identity-based access control, continuous verification, and least-privilege security.
* Defense-in-Depth – Designing layered security controls across applications, infrastructure, networks, and cloud environments.
* Threat Modeling – Applying STRIDE and PASTA methodologies to identify threats, attack surfaces, and mitigation strategies.
* Shift-Left DevSecOps – Integrating security testing into development workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) – Identifying cloud misconfigurations, compliance gaps, and infrastructure security risks.
* Security Architecture Reviews – Evaluating application architecture, infrastructure design, and security controls.
* Incident Command – Coordinating security incidents, incident escalation, response procedures, and stakeholder communication.
* Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR) – Investigating security incidents, analyzing evidence, and supporting recovery.
* MITRE ATT&CK – Mapping adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures to enterprise security controls.
* Risk Assessment & Remediation – Prioritizing vulnerabilities based on exploitability, severity, and business impact.

**3. Security Data, SIEM & Threat Intelligence Platforms**

* Splunk / Microsoft Sentinel / Panther – Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), log analysis, threat detection, and security alerting.
* CrowdStrike Falcon EDR – Endpoint detection, threat investigation, behavioral monitoring, and incident response.
* Threat Intelligence Feeds – Integrating STIX/TAXII feeds for threat intelligence ingestion, enrichment, and detection.
* PostgreSQL / Elasticsearch Security Logs – Centralized security event storage, indexing, and investigation.
* SIEM Data Lakes – Building scalable security data ingestion, retention, and analytics architectures.
* Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) – Generating, validating, and managing software component inventories.
* SBOM Repositories – Maintaining software supply chain inventories and tracking vulnerable dependencies.
* Security Log Correlation – Correlating application, infrastructure, network, and cloud security events.
* Threat Hunting – Identifying suspicious activities, indicators of compromise, and potential attack patterns.
* SOAR Automation – Automating security alert enrichment, incident triage, and response workflows.

**4. Cloud Security, Infrastructure as Code & Kubernetes Orchestration**

* AWS Security Services – IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS, WAF, CloudTrail, and Nitro Enclaves.
* Azure Security – Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Policy, and cloud security monitoring.
* Kubernetes Runtime Security – Implementing Falco, Cilium Tetragon, runtime threat detection, and workload protection.
* Terraform – Secure cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration validation, and policy-based deployment.
* HashiCorp Vault – Secrets management, dynamic credentials, encryption, and secure workload authentication.
* Docker Security – Container image hardening, secure base images, image signing, and vulnerability remediation.
* Kubernetes RBAC – Role-based access control, service account security, and least-privilege permissions.
* Network Security – Network policies, ingress/egress controls, service mesh security, and microsegmentation.
* GitOps Security – Secure deployment workflows, protected repositories, and policy enforcement.
* Cloud Infrastructure Security – Secure networking, encryption, identity management, and infrastructure compliance.

**5. Security Testing, Observability & Compliance Engineering**

* SAST / DAST / IAST – Static, dynamic, and interactive application security testing.
* SonarQube / Snyk / Checkmarx – Source code analysis, dependency scanning, and application vulnerability detection.
* Burp Suite Professional / OWASP ZAP – Web application security testing, API security assessment, and vulnerability validation.
* Trivy – Container, filesystem, dependency, and Infrastructure as Code vulnerability scanning.
* Sigstore / Cosign – Software artifact signing, image verification, and supply chain integrity.
* OPA / Checkov – Policy as Code, infrastructure validation, and security compliance enforcement.
* MITRE ATT&CK – Threat detection mapping, adversary behavior analysis, and security control validation.
* SOAR Automation – Security incident workflows, automated enrichment, and response orchestration.
* ISO 27001 / SOC 2 / PCI-DSS / NIST CSF – Security governance, compliance controls, audit readiness, and risk management.
* Security Observability – Centralized logging, security metrics, alerting, and incident visibility.

**6. Advanced DevSecOps, Leadership & Governance**

* Secure CI/CD Architecture – Designing automated security gates, approval workflows, and secure software delivery pipelines.
* Software Supply Chain Security – Dependency integrity, SBOM management, artifact signing, and provenance verification.
* Vulnerability Management – Vulnerability prioritization, remediation tracking, and security risk reduction.
* Cloud Security Governance – Establishing security standards, policy enforcement, and cloud compliance controls.
* Security Automation – Automating vulnerability assessments, compliance checks, and security operations.
* Production Security Operations – Monitoring production systems, responding to incidents, and maintaining security SLAs.
* Security Architecture RFCs / ADRs – Technical documentation, architecture decisions, and security design reviews.
* FinOps & Security Optimization – Balancing cloud security controls, infrastructure costs, and operational efficiency.
* Technical Mentorship – Guiding engineering teams, conducting security reviews, and establishing DevSecOps best practices.
* Cross-Squad Technical Leadership – Providing asynchronous security architecture guidance to distributed teams across India and global time zones.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Minimum 6–10 years of professional experience in DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Application Security, or Infrastructure Security Engineering.
* Strong hands-on production experience with Kubernetes Security, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, and Terraform.

* Deep understanding of Zero-Trust Architecture, Defense-in-Depth, Threat Modeling, and Shift-Left Security.
* Strong expertise in AWS security services, including IAM, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS, and CloudTrail.

284e5d5d.description:

**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**

Position Summary
  
  
The
**Senior IT Infrastructure Program Manager**
is responsible for driving large, complex, and high-impact infrastructure programs across Network, Platform & Hosting, Cloud, and enterprise IT environments. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, providing strategic direction, solving complex challenges, and leading multi-functional teams to deliver business outcomes.
  
  
At this level, the role requires deep expertise, ability to lead complex programs, influence stakeholders, and identify innovative solutions to business and technology challenges.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Program Leadership & Strategy Execution**

* Lead large-scale, complex infrastructure programs (e.g., data center transformation, cloud strategy execution, network modernization, MSP transition)
* Define program roadmap, milestones, financials, and success metrics aligned to business strategy
* Manage multiple interdependent projects across infrastructure towers (Network, Platform, Security, EUC, Service Desk)
* Drive alignment between IT strategy and execution, ensuring measurable business outcomes

**Governance & Executive Engagement**

* Establish and lead program governance, including steering committees, executive reviews, and decision forums
* Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership (CIO, ELT)
* Drive decision-making across competing priorities and complex stakeholder environments

**Delivery Excellence & Methodology Leadership**

* Define and standardize delivery frameworks (Agile, hybrid, Waterfall) for infrastructure programs
* Lead Agile at scale (program-level backlog, release planning, PI planning where applicable)
* Ensure robust use of ServiceNow (PPM/ITSM) for demand intake, execution tracking, reporting, and governance
* Establish KPIs and dashboards to monitor delivery performance and value realization

**Risk, Dependency & Issue Management**

* Lead resolution of highly complex, cross-functional risks and dependencies
* Anticipate risks proactively and implement program-level mitigation strategies
* Manage multi-vendor, multi-tower dependencies and contractual deliverables (MSP/vendor ecosystem)

**Operational Integration & Transformation**

* Ensure seamless transition of programs into steady-state IT operations
* Drive process integration with ITIL functions (change, release, incident management)
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives and embed best practices across delivery teams

**Leadership & Influence**

* Lead cross-functional program teams and influence without direct authority
* Mentor senior project managers and drive PMO capability maturity
* Foster collaboration between business, IT, and external partners/vendors

Required Skills
  
  

* Extensive experience leading large-scale IT infrastructure programs (Network, Platform, Hosting, Cloud)
* Strong expertise in Agile (Scaled Agile), Scrum, and traditional program delivery
* Deep working knowledge of ServiceNow (PPM/ITSM) and enterprise PM tooling
* Strong understanding of infrastructure architecture, cloud, and transformation initiatives
* Proven ability to manage multi-vendor, outsourcing (MSP), and transformation programs
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder alignment, and influencing skills

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Ability to lead others in solving complex problems and drive innovative solutions
* Strong influencing and negotiation skills across senior stakeholders
* Strategic thinking with strong execution discipline
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and drive outcomes.

Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
* 12–15+ years of experience in IT project/program management, with strong focus on infrastructure transformation
* PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe / Agile certifications (preferred)

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in large-scale outsourcing (MSP) transitions and vendor governance
* Exposure to enterprise cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and hybrid architectures
* Strong understanding of financial management (TCO, budgeting, cost optimization in infrastructure programs).

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

49db5517.title: Program Manager III, Amazon Cross Border, Amazon Cross Border
49db5517.description:
**Description**
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team is growing, and we are looking for a Program Manager III to own selection quality improvement across our global stores. In this role, you will start by building the data foundation — designing metrics, writing SQL queries, and creating dashboards that give the team clear visibility into selection throughput and item data quality. From there, you will use those insights to drive programs that remove barriers to cross-border selection growth and improve the customer shopping experience. You will partner with compliance, localization, catalog, product, and sales teams across multiple countries to align priorities and deliver measurable results. If you are someone who is comfortable with ambiguity, skilled at turning raw data into action, and excited to work on problems with global customer impact, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and build data pipelines, dashboards, and metrics using SQL, Excel, and AI tools to provide actionable visibility into selection throughput and item data quality across global stores.
* Partner with compliance, localization, catalog, and product teams across multiple countries to identify and remove barriers to selection growth, improving the speed and volume of selection onboarded.
* Drive programs to improve item data quality — titles, descriptions, attributes, and images — to directly impact product discoverability, conversion, and sales for customers worldwide.
* Coordinate with global stakeholders to align priorities, define roadmaps, and communicate progress through clear narratives and automated reporting for leadership audiences.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and introduce scalable mechanisms that improve operational efficiency across the selection and sales funnel.

A day in the life
  
  
You start your morning pulling up your selection quality dashboards, checking for new trends or bottlenecks in the data. By mid-morning, you are on a call with compliance and localization partners in another country, working through a plan to unblock a batch of listings. After lunch, you write a summary of program progress and trade-off recommendations for a director review. Later, you dig into SQL to investigate a data quality issue a teammate flagged, then wrap up by updating your roadmap ahead of a stakeholder sync the next day.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Amazon Cross-Border Seller Experience team helps sellers expand internationally and works to bring customers the broadest selection at the lowest price. We operate across geographies and functions to remove barriers to cross-border trade, making it easier for sellers to list, comply, and succeed in stores around the world. Our team is expanding, and this role offers global exposure — you will collaborate with teams across countries and gain visibility with leadership. As you grow, you will build strong analytical and written communication skills and take on increasingly strategic responsibilities.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

f50f7a1e.title: Job Description: PreSales Solution Architect, SAP Lean Manufacturing
f50f7a1e.description:
**Job Description: PreSales Solution Architect, SAP Lean Manufacturing**

**Attribute**

  

**Detail**

Job title

  

PreSales Solution Architect, SAP Lean Manufacturing

Function

  

Presales / Solution Consulting, Manufacturing Industry Practice

Location

  

Bengaluru, India (hybrid). Travel to client sites in India and abroad up to 30-40%

Experience

  

12-18 years total. 8+ years in SAP manufacturing. 4+ years in presales or solution architecture

Reports to

  

Head of Presales / Practice Head, Manufacturing

Works with

  

Account Executives, Delivery Leads, SAP Alliance team, Industry Principals

Employment type

  

Full-time, permanent

Deal size supported

  

Typically USD 1M-15M transformation and rollout deals

**Role purpose**

This role wins SAP manufacturing deals by linking Lean principles to SAP solutions. You will turn plant-floor problems into clear, costed SAP solution designs. You will show clients how SAP S/4HANA and SAP Digital Manufacturing cut waste, lift OEE and shorten lead times.

You are the trusted technical voice in the sales cycle. You lead discovery, build the solution, run demos and POCs, and defend the architecture in front of CXOs, plant heads and IT leaders. You then hand over a deliverable, de-risked scope to delivery.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and solution design**

* Lead discovery workshops with plant heads, operations, quality, maintenance and IT teams.
* Map current-state processes using value stream mapping (VSM) and identify the 8 wastes (TIMWOODS).
* Translate Lean goals into SAP solution architecture across S/4HANA PP, QM, PM, MM, EWM and SAP Digital Manufacturing (DM).
* Design future-state processes for pull production, Kanban, JIT/JIS supply, takt-based scheduling and line balancing.
* Define integration architecture across SAP, MES, PLM, SCADA, historians and IIoT platforms using SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite and OPC UA / MQTT.
* Produce solution blueprints, high-level architecture diagrams, scope documents and assumptions.

**2. Demos, POCs and solution showcases**

* Build and run tailored demos of SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing, SAP DM, SAP IBP and SAP Analytics Cloud.
* Design and lead POCs and pilots with clear success criteria, such as OEE uplift, scrap reduction or WIP reduction.
* Maintain reusable demo environments, storyboards and industry scenarios for discrete and process manufacturing.

**3. RFP, RFI and proposal ownership**

* Own the solution response for RFPs and RFIs. This covers architecture, scope, approach, effort and risks.
* Build effort estimates, staffing models and phased roadmaps with the delivery team.
* Shape commercial models such as fixed price, T&M and outcome-based pricing with sales and finance.
* Write executive summaries and value narratives that tie the solution to measurable business outcomes.

**4. Business case and value engineering**

* Build ROI and TCO models showing savings in inventory, lead time, downtime, quality cost and labour.
* Quantify benefits using Lean metrics: OEE, takt time, cycle time, first pass yield, inventory turns and MTTR / MTBF.
* Present business cases to CFOs, COOs and plant leadership.

**5. Sales partnership and deal leadership**

* Partner with Account Executives on account planning, opportunity qualification and win strategy.
* Lead orals and solution defence sessions. Handle technical objections with confidence.
* Work with the SAP alliance team on joint pursuits, SAP RISE / GROW with SAP positioning and co-innovation.
* Ensure a clean handover to delivery with documented scope, assumptions and risks.

**6. Thought leadership and asset building**

* Build accelerators, industry templates, solution playbooks and reference architectures for Lean on SAP.
* Track SAP roadmap updates for Manufacturing, Industry 4.0 and Joule / SAP Business AI.
* Contribute to whitepapers, webinars, client roundtables and industry events.
* Mentor junior presales consultants and solution analysts.

**Technical skills required**

**Area**

  

**What we expect**

  

**Level**

SAP S/4HANA PP / PP-PI

  

Discrete, repetitive and process manufacturing. MRP Live, pMRP, production versions, routings, BOMs

  

Expert

Kanban and JIT in SAP

  

Classic and event-driven Kanban, JIT/JIS calls, supply area design, eKanban

  

Expert

SAP Digital Manufacturing (DM)

  

Shop floor execution, production operator dashboards, resource orchestration, Plant Connectivity (PCo)

  

Strong

SAP QM

  

Inspection plans, in-process quality, SPC, quality notifications, CAPA flows

  

Strong

SAP PM / EAM

  

Preventive and predictive maintenance, TPM support, MTTR / MTBF reporting

  

Strong

SAP MM and EWM

  

Line-side replenishment, production supply, warehouse to line flows

  

Working

SAP IBP / PP-DS

  

Capacity planning, finite scheduling, heijunka-style levelling

  

Working

Integration and BTP

  

SAP Integration Suite, CPI, OData / REST APIs, OPC UA, MQTT, MES and SCADA integration

  

Strong

Analytics

  

SAP Analytics Cloud, embedded analytics, OEE and Lean KPI dashboards

  

Strong

Industry 4.0

  

IIoT, digital twin concepts, SAP Business AI / Joule use cases in manufacturing

  

Working

Deployment models

  

RISE with SAP, GROW with SAP, greenfield, brownfield and selective data transition

  

Strong

**Lean manufacturing expertise**

The candidate must speak the language of the plant floor, not only the language of SAP.

* **Lean foundations:** Toyota Production System, the 5 Lean principles, 8 wastes, flow and pull.
* **Lean tools:** VSM, 5S, Kaizen, SMED, Poka-Yoke, Jidoka, Andon, Heijunka, Gemba walks, standard work.
* **Continuous improvement:** Six Sigma DMAIC, root cause analysis, PDCA, A3 problem solving.
* **Maintenance excellence:** TPM pillars and OEE (availability x performance x quality).
* **Operational KPIs:** takt time, cycle time, lead time, WIP, first pass yield, scrap rate, schedule adherence.
* **Industry exposure:** at least two of Automotive, Industrial Machinery, Electronics / High-Tech, Aerospace, Consumer Goods, Pharma / Life Sciences, Chemicals.
* **Proven impact:** able to cite past programs with numbers. For example, OEE up 10-15 points, WIP down 20-30% or lead time down 25%.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Must have**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Industrial, Production, Electrical or Chemical) or equivalent.
* 12-18 years of total experience. At least 8 years in SAP manufacturing modules.
* 4+ years in a presales, solution architect or bid leadership role.
* 3+ end-to-end SAP implementations or rollouts in manufacturing, with at least one on S/4HANA.
* Hands-on plant or operations exposure, either in industry or through shop-floor-heavy SAP programs.
* Track record of supporting deals worth USD 1M+ with a documented win rate.
* Excellent written English for proposals and executive presentations.

**Preferred certifications**

* SAP Certified Application Associate: S/4HANA Manufacturing (PP) or Production Planning and Manufacturing.
* SAP Certified: SAP Digital Manufacturing.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt.
* TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* SAP BTP or Integration Suite certification.

**Education, preferred**

* MBA in Operations or Supply Chain, or M.Tech in Industrial / Manufacturing Engineering.

**Behavioural competencies**

* **Consultative selling:** asks sharp questions and listens before proposing.
* **Executive presence:** comfortable with CXOs, plant heads and SAP leadership.
* **Storytelling:** turns complex architecture into a simple value story.
* **Commercial acumen:** understands margins, pricing models and deal risk.
* **Ownership under pressure:** delivers quality responses on tight RFP timelines.
* **Collaboration:** works across sales, delivery, alliances and offshore teams.
* **Learning agility:** keeps pace with SAP quarterly releases and AI in manufacturing.
* **Cultural fluency:** works well with global clients in the US, Europe and APAC.

**Success measures**

**KPI**

  

**Indicative target (annual)**

Pipeline supported

  

USD 20-30M of qualified opportunities

Win rate on solutioned deals

  

30-40%

RFP / RFI responses led

  

15-25 per year

Demos and workshops delivered

  

30+ per year

POCs converted to deals

  

50%+

Estimation accuracy at handover

  

Within +/-10% of delivery baseline

Reusable assets created

  

3-5 accelerators or templates per year

Client satisfaction (presales)

  

4.5 / 5 or higher

Targets are indicative. Calibrate them to the firm's deal mix and market.

**First 60 days**

1. **Days 1-15:** learn the offerings, demo landscape, key accounts and live pipeline. Meet sales, delivery and SAP alliance leads.
2. **Days 15-30:** Refresh the Lean on SAP demo storyline and reference architecture.
3. **Days 30-60:** independently own at least one RFP end to end. Publish one solution accelerator or industry point of view.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to non-SAP MES platforms such as Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell Plex / FactoryTalk, AVEVA or Dassault DELMIA Apriso.
* PLM integration experience with SAP PLM, Teamcenter or Windchill.
* Knowledge of sustainability reporting in manufacturing, such as SAP Sustainability Footprint Management.
* Prior work in a GCC, Big 4, global SI or SAP partner presales team.
* Published content, patents or conference talks on Lean, Industry 4.0 or SAP.
* Second language for global pursuits, such as German, Japanese or Spanish.

**What we offer**

* A front-line role in large SAP manufacturing transformations.
* Direct exposure to global CXOs and SAP leadership.
* Competitive fixed pay with a presales incentive linked to wins.
* Funded SAP and Lean Six Sigma certifications.
* A clear path to Principal Solution Architect or Practice Head, Manufacturing.

05713d54.title: Cloud AI Security - AWS - Senior Consultant
05713d54.description:
**Cyber**

Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

**Position Summary**

**Job Title:**Senior Consultant - Cloud AI Security - AWS

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte could be the place for you. Traditional security programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure and support technology innovation required by the business. Join Deloitte's Cyber Cloud AI Security team and become a member of the largest group of cybersecurity professionals worldwide.

  

**Work you’ll do**

As a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant, you will lead and support client engagements focused on securing AI, generative AI, and ML workloads across cloud platforms. You will bring deep experience across cloud security, AI security architecture, governance, compliance, platform controls, and monitoring to help clients design, assess, and implement secure AI capabilities at scale. You will be expected to contribute to solutioning and client delivery, and provide actionable recommendations across the AI lifecycle, including data ingestion, model development, validation, deployment, runtime monitoring, and retraining.

Responsibilities as a Cloud AI Security Senior Consultant will include:

* Drive the design and implementation of AI security solutions within cloud environments aligned to client business objectives, enterprise architecture, regulatory expectations, and security requirements.
* Execute AI security assessments for cloud-hosted AI/ML and GenAI workloads, evaluating controls against frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, CSA CCM, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.
* Define and implement AI security controls across identity, access, network segmentation, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, workload protection, and secure configuration management.
* Support threat modeling and security architecture reviews for AI and GenAI solutions, including risks related to prompt injection, jailbreaks, insecure output handling, excessive agent permissions, sensitive data exposure, model misuse, and insecure tool or connector usage.
* Design and review secure AI architectures spanning model endpoints, APIs, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector stores, plugins, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and external tool integrations.
* Support secure deployment and configuration of cloud-native AI services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Google Vertex AI.
* Implement and review platform-specific controls such as private connectivity, encryption with customer-managed keys, tenant isolation, access restrictions, content safety controls, and service-native logging and monitoring capabilities.
* Drive DevSecOps, MLOps, and MLSecOps integration efforts by embedding policy validation, secrets handling, secure model promotion, compliance checks, and security testing into CI/CD and ML pipelines.
* Define and implement secure AI lifecycle controls across data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, incident response, drift review, and retraining, including protections against data poisoning, model tampering, and supply-chain risk.
* Support AI governance and compliance activities including model inventory, risk classification, approval workflows, traceability, documentation standards, and control mapping aligned to NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001.
* Support clients in implementing responsible AI and model governance controls related to data protection, access control, model usage restrictions, prompt security, content filtering, and audit readiness.
* Execute AI security posture management efforts using cloud-native tooling, CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, and related controls to identify misconfiguration, data exposure, anomalous model activity, and policy violations.
* Support AI-specific monitoring and incident response by helping define detections, alerts, escalation paths, and remediation activities for suspicious prompt behavior, agent abuse, unauthorized model access, and sensitive data leakage.
* Conduct or support AI security testing activities including misuse-case testing, control validation, prompt attack testing, model guardrail validation, and red-team support for AI-enabled applications.
* Work directly with client stakeholders across security, cloud engineering, DevOps, data, ML engineering, privacy, risk, and architecture teams to translate requirements into implementable designs and remediation plans.

**The team**

Deloitte Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs into proactive cyber risk programs. Join the team developing the future state of cyber risk solutions. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory’s Cyber Risk Services practice.

  

**Required:**

* 7+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity consulting, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related disciplines.

* Demonstrated experience leading or owning workstreams in client-facing security engagements.

* Experience designing, assessing, or implementing security controls for cloud-hosted applications, platforms, or AI/ML environments.

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform and working knowledge of the other leading platforms: AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI security concepts, including prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage, secure model access, agent security, and responsible AI fundamentals.

* Experience implementing cloud security controls across IAM, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and policy enforcement.

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Bash, and PowerShell.

* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and secure engineering practices, including policy validation, secrets handling, and continuous compliance.

* Familiarity with cloud AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure OpenAI, Mythos, Anthropic, and Vertex AI.

* Familiarity with AI governance and security frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience conducting AI security assessments, architecture reviews, control design, and remediation programs across AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud.
* Deep hands-on experience with identity and access management, including AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, and Google Cloud IAM.
* Experience designing governance and guardrails for cloud AI environments using services such as AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, Azure Policy, Security Command Center, and equivalent policy enforcement capabilities.
* Experience with cloud-native monitoring and security tooling such as AWS Security Hub, CloudTrail, AWS Config, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Policy, and Google Security Command Center.
* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, DSPM, SIEM, vulnerability management, container security, and posture management tools supporting AI workloads.
* Experience with prompt security, content safety, model guardrails, and AI runtime monitoring for generative AI applications.
* Exposure to AI red teaming, misuse-case testing, prompt attack validation, or adversarial testing of LLM-enabled applications.
* Experience securing containerized, API-driven, and agent-based AI applications.
* Knowledge of privacy, legal, and data governance considerations relevant to AI workloads, including data residency, retention, sensitive data handling, and auditability.
* Experience establishing AI governance processes such as AI inventory, model classification, approval gates, traceability, and documentation aligned to AI risk management practices.
* Relevant certifications such as:

* **AWS Certified Security – Specialty**

* **Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate**

* **Google Cloud Certified – Professional Cloud Security Engineer**

* **Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate**

* **Google Cloud Certified – Professional Machine Learning Engineer**

* **AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)**

* CISSP, CCSP, or comparable senior security certifications
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple client priorities independently.

**How you’ll grow**

At Deloitte, our professional development plan focuses on helping people at every level of their career to identify and use their strengths to do their best work every day. From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer opportunities to help sharpen skills in addition to hands-on experience in the global, fast-changing business world. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs at Deloitte University, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career. Explore Deloitte University, The Leadership Center.

**Benefits**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

  

**Deloitte’s culture**

Our positive and supportive culture encourages our people to do their best work every day. We celebrate individuals by recognizing their uniqueness and offering them the flexibility to make daily choices that can help them to be healthy, centered, confident, and aware. We offer well-being programs and are continuously looking for new ways to maintain a culture where our people excel and lead healthy, happy lives. Learn more about Life at Deloitte.

  

**Corporate citizenship**

Deloitte is led by a purpose: to make an impact that matters. This purpose defines who we are and extends to relationships with our clients, our people and our communities. We believe that business has the power to inspire and transform. We focus on education, giving, skill-based volunteerism, and leadership to help drive positive social impact in our communities. Learn more about Deloitte’s impact on the world.

  

**Recruiter tips**

We want job seekers exploring opportunities at Deloitte to feel prepared and confident. To help you with your interview, we suggest that you do your research: know some background about the organization and the business area you’re applying to. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte professionals.

  

**Education:**

B.Tech / M.Tech / MS / MCA / MBA or equivalent (Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or related field)

  
  

**Location:** Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

  
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

5a014413.description:
Cloud DeveloperThis role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

In the **HPE Hybrid Cloud**, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

**What you will do:**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Private Cloud Infrastructure:** Configure, validate, and troubleshoot compute, storage, networking, virtualization, and OS components supporting private cloud environments.
* **System & Integration Validation:** Execute functional, integration, upgrade, interoperability, resiliency, and failure-recovery testing across infrastructure components.
* **Automation Development:** Develop and maintain automation using Python, REST APIs, scripting, and test frameworks to reduce repetitive manual activities.
* **Automation Adoption:** Identify opportunities to automate environment deployment, configuration, validation, health checks, log collection, and regression testing.
* **AI-Assisted Engineering:** Apply AI tools and agents to improve test development, troubleshooting, log analysis, test planning, documentation, and engineering productivity.
* **Cloud-Native Technologies:** Build working knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, orchestration, and cloud-native technologies relevant to modern private cloud platforms.
* **Problem Solving:** Analyze infrastructure and platform failures, collect appropriate diagnostics, isolate issues, and work with engineering teams toward resolution.
* **Quality & Release Readiness:** Contribute to test planning, defect analysis, risk identification, regression coverage, and release qualification.
* **Customer Scenario Validation:** Understand common deployment and operational scenarios and ensure testing represents realistic customer environments.
* **Collaboration:** Work effectively with development, QA, architecture, automation, and program teams to resolve dependencies and deliver committed milestones.
* **Continuous Learning:** Build deeper product and architecture knowledge while developing expertise across infrastructure, automation, AI, and private cloud technologies.

**What you need to bring:**

### **Technical Skills**

**Infrastructure**

* Servers, compute, storage, and networking fundamentals
* Linux and/or Windows administration
* Virtualization technologies
* TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs and basic network troubleshooting
* Infrastructure deployment and configuration
* Monitoring, logs, and system troubleshooting

**Automation**

* Python and scripting
* REST APIs
* Test automation frameworks
* Git/source control
* CI/CD fundamentals
* Infrastructure or configuration automation
* Ability to convert repeatable manual workflows into automation

**Cloud & Containers**

* Private cloud concepts
* Containers and Kubernetes fundamentals
* Virtual machines and containerized workloads
* Infrastructure lifecycle management
* High availability and resiliency concepts

**AI**

* Understanding of generative AI and LLM concepts
* Effective use of AI coding and engineering assistants
* Ability to leverage AI for test-case generation, automation development, log analysis, and troubleshooting
* Interest in developing AI agents/workflows to improve engineering efficiency

### **Expected TCP2 Behaviors**

At the TCP2 level, the engineer should:

* Independently execute well-defined technical assignments.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned features or validation areas with appropriate guidance.
* Demonstrate strong debugging and analytical skills.
* Proactively identify automation opportunities rather than relying only on manual execution.
* Develop broader infrastructure and product knowledge.
* Communicate defects, technical risks, and execution status clearly.
* Collaborate effectively and build good working relationships across teams.
* Learn new technologies quickly, particularly **AI, automation, and cloud-native technologies**.
* Seek guidance for highly complex architectural problems while progressively increasing independent ownership.

### **Suggested Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately **2–5 years of relevant experience**, with flexibility based on demonstrated technical capability.
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure, system validation, automation, cloud technologies, or platform engineering.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and learning skills.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**
