Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage relationships across international teams, and make informed decisions in a fast-paced, multi-client environment.

dea61405.title: Senior Client Solutions Manager - X (Twitter) Ads
dea61405.description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**
At
**Aleph**
, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
  
  
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
  
  
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.
  
  
As Senior Client Solutions Manager for X in India, you will be the day-to-day link between our advertisers, their agencies and the teams that run their campaigns. You will own client relationships end to end, from planning and launch through to optimisation and review. This is not a coordination-only role. You will step in on campaigns and help with set-up and troubleshooting where it matters or when your judgement says it will move results faster. You are expected to understand how campaigns are built and optimised, explain it clearly to clients, and push back when a request will not deliver the result they want.
  
  
**Location: Gurgaon (office-based, 3 days a week in office)**
**What you will do :-**

* Own and grow relationships with advertisers and agencies on X, acting as their primary point of contact
* Understand client business goals and turn them into campaign plans, media plans and proposals
* Guide campaign set-up, targeting, creative and budget decisions. Step in hands-on where needed to setup, launch and optimize campaigns
* Monitor performance, spot issues early and recommend optimisations that improve results
* Prepare and present campaign reports, post-campaign analyses and quarterly business reviews
* Handle client and agency queries, objections and escalations calmly and professionally
* Work closely with X's partner and product teams to raise requests, access new features and resolve blockers
* Support billing, approvals and collections follow-ups with clients and agencies
* Bring market and category insights back to the team and help build a stronger book of business in North India

**What you bring :-**
**Must have :-**

* 4 to 8 years of experience in client servicing, account management or client solutions within digital advertising, a media agency, an ad platform or a performance marketing team
* Hands-on experience running or optimising paid performance campaigns (for example X, Meta, Google or programmatic)
* Strong command of performance metrics such as CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS and conversion tracking
* Confident communicator who can hold a client conversation, handle objections and manage demanding agency stakeholders
* Strong presentation and reporting skills, including building clear decks and campaign summaries
* Comfortable working across clients, agencies and internal teams at the same time

**Good to have :-**

* Experience on X Ads or other social and video platforms
* Exposure to sectors such as auto, BFSI, gaming, tech or e-commerce
* Existing relationships with agencies or advertisers in North India

**Where You Will Work :-**
Our office is in Gurgaon, and this role requires 3 days a week in the office. Candidates based in Delhi, Noida or nearby are welcome to apply, provided they are comfortable commuting to Gurgaon.
  
  
**Why Aleph :-**
You will work with leading advertisers and agencies on one of the world's most influential media platforms, as part of a team that values ownership, clear thinking and straight talk. You will have room to grow with the India business as it scales.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.
  
  
#ALEPH
  
  
We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy.

843b1a83.title: Program Manager
843b1a83.description:
At Verint, we’re helping shape what is next in customer experience. As a leader in CX automation, we are creating a future where people and AI-powered bots work together to help some of the world’s most iconic brands achieve real business outcomes. Powered by our next-generation Verint Open Platform, we are continuing to grow, innovate, and push the boundaries of what is possible with AI.

We are bringing together passionate people with diverse voices, perspectives, and expertise who want to push what is possible, make an impact, and help shape the future of AI-powered customer experience. If you are excited by who we are, where we are going, and what we are building together, we want to hear from you!

**About the Role:**
===================

As a key member of Professional Services, the role of the Program Manager is to serve as a customer advocate and is responsible for managing a diverse portfolio of strategic or enterprise programs requiring the implementation and enablement of Verint technology solutions across all product lines. These programs are managed within an established budget, defined scope and forecasted timeline, to consistently achieve program margin and other financial targets and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the program life cycle. Additionally, the Program Manager is responsible for building and maintaining ongoing internal and customer relationships, while developing and earning the trust of all program stakeholders. The Program Manager has an advanced understanding of the Verint product suite, of the delivery process, and can manage complex engagements with a broad range of internal and customer stakeholders, potentially including third-party providers and other vendors.

**As a Program Manager, you will:**
===================================

* Manages complex program-level engagements and implementations.
* Responsible for program objectives, defined scope and achieving the conditions of success that serve as major program milestones and require interim or final customer sign-off for approval.
* Participates in Sales-to-Services mobilization activities and/or reviews all pre-Sales documents and informs Sales and Contracts of potential technical, logistical, project scheduling or business issues, and liaisons with internal departments to ensure necessary program needs and goals are being met.
* Reviews of pre-Sales and Sales documentation to ensure the overall Professional Services effort and deliverables are accurately scoped and defined.
* At the conclusion of each critical program, creates a program summary outlining both strengths and shortcomings of the program management process and perceived customer experience.
* Leads a program team, including customer stakeholders and other potential third-party resources through either a traditional or agile program lifecycle. Trains, mentors and guides program teammates to drive successful outcomes.
* Interacts regularly with the PMO Director, keeping them informed of program progress and seeking guidance where needed to ensure overall program success and customer satisfaction.
* Completes standard and ad hoc status reporting requirements.
* Effectively coordinates the allocation of program resources with the functional managers and other Project Managers in order to maintain program deployment schedules.
* Accountable for adhering to the escalation process for installation issue resolution and managing the final “go/no-go” decision for installation deployment.
* Develops and monitors the program schedule and defines milestones to accurately know the percentage complete based on hours consumed and impact to revenue recognition.
* Updates and regularly maintains the program budget forecast and ensures timesheet adherence for timely financial reporting.
* Creates, gathers approval and executes Change Orders as required.
* Establishes and maintains client-focused professional relationships with all customers and business executives to facilitate transparent, honest and timely communication.
* Stays attuned to changes in the customer’s business and technology environment, as well as organization and culture that could adversely affect the efforts of Verint Systems, Inc.
* Attends required product and services training and related demonstrations to acquire a fundamental understanding of Verint’s product suite and business advisory services.
* Engages in special programs as assigned by PMO leadership.

**Requirements you will need to be successful:**
================================================

* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
* 6+ years of experience in technical program or project management, process improvement, management consulting, and/or customer relationship management.
* Demonstrated experience in leading enterprise scale software deployments of $250K or greater.
* Past demonstrated experience in managing projects or programs in a complex environment.
* Experience leading to complex implementations that require strong integration across lifecycle components using critical thinking and problem solving.
* Program financial management experience; inclusive of developing and maintaining program level budgeting and forecasting.
* Ability to effectively lead a cross-functional team without direct reporting responsibility in a manner that achieves desired business results.
* Effectively demonstrates a leadership presence when dealing with senior leaders; can remain composed, focused and productive when confronted with escalated issues or unanticipated change.
* Must possess Executive level communication skills, determining their purpose, impact, and appropriate timing without coaching. Must be able to effectively communicate with Executive Level Clients; this includes setting client expectations, the ability to deliver sub-optimal updates, and deftly deal with escalations.
* Experience in project lifecycle activities and tasks .
* Consulting experience translating model and business process knowledge to clients.
* Ability to manage and conduct resource requirements analysis.
* Up to 25% of travel is required.
* Software specific working knowledge required of the following: Smartsheet, Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and FinancialForce.

**Requirements that will differentiate your candidacy:**
========================================================

* Contact Center industry or Back-Office Operations experience a plus
* PMP or PgMP certified.
* Experience in Process Improvement or workflow consulting a plus.
* Highly motivated individual driven to keep pace in a fast moving and dynamic environment. Ability to adapt to rapid change.
* Proven ability to influence others, demonstrated leadership and management skills.
* The ability to interface with all levels within the organization.
* Demonstrate a high level of integrity in all business dealings.

At Verint, our values are more than words. They are how we work together every day. We operate as One Team, embrace Continuous Innovation, communicate openly with Zero Daylight, bring a Bias to Action, and stay Customer Powered in the decisions we make. Together, these values guide how we collaborate, innovate, and deliver meaningful impact.

Our people are at the heart of Verint, and we are committed to supporting their well-being. We offer a variety of benefits that includes paid time off, health and wellness benefits, and retirement benefits, based on eligibility and local requirements.

If you require a reasonable accommodation or adjustment to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@verint.com as soon as possible so we can discuss your needs and provide appropriate support.

Verint is committed to protecting your privacy. For information about how we process candidate personal data, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

3dc9600d.title: Solutions Engineer
3dc9600d.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.
* Develop use cases where real-time event triggers drive autonomous agent actions: banking operations and service, airport and airline disruption handling, supply chain and plant operations, citizen service workflows, and public infrastructure monitoring.
* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

  

**What You’ll Bring to the Role**

Required

* 5+ years in technical sales or solutions engineering, selling complex enterprise software.
* Proven ability to lead technical evaluations and communicate business impact to executives and engineers.
* Experience supporting Indian government, PSU or regulated large-enterprise customers (banking, telecom, aviation, manufacturing or logistics), directly or through system integrators and channel partners.
* Working understanding of how Indian public sector buys technology: RFP and RFI processes, tender portals and GeM, pre-bid and technical evaluation stages, L1 and QCBS selection, empanelment, and partner-led delivery.
* Excellent presentation, communication and relationship-building skills.
* Willingness to travel up to 35% within India.

  

**Preferred**

* Experience with event-driven architecture, streaming or messaging middleware (Solace PubSub+, Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO, NATS or MQTT brokers).
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks, LLM orchestration and multi-agent systems (LangChain, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen or similar); working knowledge of A2A and MCP is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with AWS, Azure, GCP and Indian cloud and data-centre providers, plus Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift.
* Programming knowledge in Java, Python, Go or JavaScript.
* Hands-on familiarity with security and compliance in Indian regulated settings: MeitY empanelment, DPDP Act, CERT-In, RBI and SEBI guidelines, ISO 27001, and secure or air-gapped environments.
* Experience with government or defence-linked programmes, and a willingness to undergo background verification where a customer requires it.
* Experience writing or contributing to technical proposals, RFP responses and compliance matrices.

  

**Travel and location**

Expect up to 35% travel, primarily across India, for customer workshops, bid presentations, deal closures and industry events, including regular visits to Delhi NCR, Mumbai and Bengaluru and to government and PSU sites. Occasional regional travel may be needed. The role is hybrid and based in Delhi NCR.

**Why You’ll Love Working at Solace**

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

* **Work with brilliance** – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
* **Balance matters** – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
* **Hybrid-first** – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
* **Values-driven** – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.
* **Growth mindset** – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
* **Customer Obsessed** – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
* **Keep it fun** – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
* **Creative culture** – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

  

**At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.**

To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

  

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

  

**Let’s Talk**

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

  

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

  

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

  

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Solution Engineer – AXP

**Fibr AI | HSR Layout, Bengaluru | Full-time, in office | 3–5 years**

**About Fibr**

Fibr AI is an agentic web experience platform, backed by Accel. Ads are one-to-one, but websites still talk to everyone. Fibr fixes that by turning static pages into adaptive experiences that respond in real time to each visitor, human or AI. Our customers include large enterprises in banking, financial services, telecom and healthcare.

**The role**

AXP (Agent Experience) is our newest product. It makes websites visible, understandable and persuasive to AI assistants and agents like ChatGPT and Perplexity, and to the visitors those agents send. You'll be the technical owner on every AXP client. You'll work out how a client's website is served and how AI agents read it, deploy AXP across their web and cloud setup, track what moves, and turn what you learn into product requirements. The role is hands-on, technical and fully client-facing.

**What you'll do**

* Own AXP rollouts with client engineering and marketing teams, from technical setup to measurable results
* Work inside client CDN and cloud setups (Cloudflare, AWS CloudFront, S3) to deploy and configure AXP
* Diagnose how AI crawlers and LLM-powered search read a client's site, and fix what's holding it back
* Track results and explain clearly what moved and why
* Spot patterns across clients and turn them into clear product requirements
* Build your own tools and workflows with LLM APIs, agents, Claude, Cursor and similar

**Non-negotiables**

* **Client-facing experience:**
  you've worked directly with clients and can hold your own with their engineering and marketing teams
* **Web fundamentals:**
  you know how a website is served (DNS → CDN → origin), understand HTTP headers and user agents, and have worked hands-on with Cloudflare or AWS CloudFront
* **Cloud basics:**
  you're comfortable in the AWS console, understand S3 and IAM roles and permissions, and can read Terraform
* **LLM fundamentals:**
  you know how ChatGPT and other AI bots crawl and cite websites, why they miss JavaScript-heavy content, and how RAG and LLM APIs work. Ideally, you've built something with LLM APIs

**Also great to have**

* 3–5 years in a solutions engineering, sales engineering, forward-deployed or technical CSM role, or as an APM at an AI, dev-tools or SaaS startup
* AI-native habits: you've built real things with LLMs, agents or AI coding tools
* Product thinking: you spot patterns, write crisp requirements and raise quality
* Comfort with data

**You'll fit if**
you have high agency, love figuring things out from first principles, and teach yourself whatever the problem needs.

af351d96.title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployment
af351d96.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About Beneficial Deployments**
--------------------------------

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and research institutes in APAC get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment, and you'll support a wider set of accounts through learning sessions. With nonprofits, you'll find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations. With research institutes, you'll help researchers and the teams who support them use Claude in work they can check and stand behind. You'll design solutions that fit each partner's budget, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something others across the region and beyond can use.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofits and research institutes from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success.
* Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation.
* Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code and Science for nonprofits and research institutes
* Help researchers evaluate Claude on their own questions and data before they rely on it, and be plain about its limits.
* Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement, including rules that differ by country and limits on how research data can be used.
* Support a wider portfolio of accounts through learning sessions and enablement.
* Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams, from program staff to research groups.
* Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next.
* Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed.
* Travel up to 30% to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building.

**You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have**
---------------------------------------

* 7-10 years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting.
* A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams with many stakeholders to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it.
* Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code.
* The ability to earn the trust of researchers and other specialists: you can show how you tested something, where it fails and what you don't know yet.
* Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, researchers, operations staff and executives.
* Patience with long buying and partnership cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit.
* A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.
* Bonus if you've worked with or at nonprofits, foundations, research institutes or other mission-driven organizations, worked in a sales team, built multilingual products, or worked with partners in more than one country.

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

d243b53f.title: Director, Enterprise Architect - Commercial Technology
d243b53f.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The **Director, Enterprise Architect - Commercial Technology** is responsible for defining and driving the **end-to-end architecture strategy** for **Pharma commercial products, SaaS platforms, enterprise data platforms, and AI/GenAI solutions** in a **federated enterprise architecture model**. This leader ensures that **engineering teams are empowered with the right frameworks, patterns, and guardrails** to accelerate delivery while maintaining technical excellence, scalability, and security.

  

As the Director, Enterprise Architect - Commercial Technology, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our company's Commercial Data, AI / GenAI, Cloud and application platforms, products direction and ensuring our initiatives align with our strategic objectives. We are seeking a visionary yet strong technology leader to our **AI-Driven, Cloud-Native, and SaaS centric architecture** function.

The role requires expertise in but not limited to **Pharma commercial technology stacks, Veeva CRM, Salesforce CRM, cloud-native architectures (Azure & GCP), AI-driven innovation, and FinOps governance**, working closely with **Enterprise Architecture (EA), Product & Engineering teams, Data & AI leadership, and business stakeholders**to align technology with business objectives.

***Key Responsibilities:***

**1. Technology & Platform Architecture**

* Define the technical architecture strategy for Pharma commercial SaaS platforms, Veeva CRM, Salesforce CRM, and omnichannel engagement solutions.
* Establish and govern reference architectures, best practices, and technology standards across full-stack web applications, APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
* Ensure scalability, security, and high availability across all technology platforms.

**2. Data, AI/GenAI & Commercial Analytics Architecture**

* Architect enterprise-scale data platforms, including data lakes, data mesh, and real-time analytics solutions tailored for Pharma commercial data.
* Lead the strategy for GenAI/AI-enabled architectures, including LLMs, AI/ML models, embedding AI into Pharma applications, and AI-driven insights for HCP & patient engagement.
* Collaborate with Data & AI teams to optimize data pipelines, model deployment, and AI-driven automation.
* Enable intelligent automation and next-best-action recommendations across commercial functions.
* AI and GenAI Infrastructure Planning:
  + Define and oversee the development of AI and GenAI infrastructure, including hardware, software, and data management systems.
  + Ensure scalability and reliability of AI and GenAI solutions.
  + Factor in cost optimisation from the ground up, to ensure long term commercial scalability.

**3. Cloud & FinOps Strategy (Azure & GCP)**

* Define cloud strategy across Azure & GCP, ensuring a hybrid, multi-cloud, and edge computing approach.
* Oversee adoption of containerization (Kubernetes), serverless computing, and API-first architectures.
* Drive cost optimization, resilience, and security best practices for cloud infrastructure through FinOps principles.

**4. Technology Enablement & Design Authority for Engineering Teams**

* Act as a design authority, ensuring engineering teams adhere to architectural principles, patterns, and technology roadmaps.
* Define technology enablement frameworks, providing reusable components, APIs, and cloud automation to accelerate software development.
* Lead the adoption of AI-driven engineering productivity tools, DevSecOps, and automated governance to improve developer efficiency.
* Facilitate engineering communities of practice to share best practices, drive innovation, and improve architectural consistency.
* Technology Assessment:
  + Stay current with AI and GenAI deployment trends, emerging technologies, and industry benchmarks.
  + Align technical implementation with existing and future requirements.
  + Evaluate and select the most suitable AI and GenAI technologies and tools to support strategic objectives.

**5. Federated Enterprise Architecture & Governance**

* Partner with Enterprise Architecture to ensure alignment with business strategy and technology governance in a federated model.
* Establish a decentralized but standardized architecture model, enabling domain-driven design while ensuring reusability and interoperability.
* Define technology roadmaps, balancing global consistency with localized business needs.

**6. Leadership, Collaboration & Execution**

* Lead a **high-performing team of architects** across **application, data, cloud, and AI domains**.
* Partner with **Product, Engineering, and Business Leaders** to align technology with **Pharma commercial strategy and product roadmaps**.
* Act as a **trusted advisor to C-level executives**, translating technical vision into **business impact**.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define AI and GenAI project requirements, ensuring successful implementation.
* Work closely with senior leadership to communicate the value and impact of AI and GenAI architecture strategies.

**7. Vendor & Ecosystem Engagement**

* Evaluate and integrate third-party **SaaS solutions, AI/GenAI models, and enterprise platforms** such as **Veeva CRM, Salesforce CRM, Adobe Experience Cloud, and next-gen AI agents**.
* Define **guiding principles for vendor selection**, balancing **build vs. buy** decisions.
* Ensure strategic alignment with **technology partners (Microsoft, Google, OpenAI, NVIDIA, and Pharma-specific AI providers)** to drive innovation and differentiation

**Required Skills & qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Ph.D. preferred.
* **18+ years of technology leadership experience**, with expertise in **Pharma commercial technology, SaaS platforms, and AI/GenAI solutions**.
* **Deep expertise in Veeva CRM, Salesforce CRM, omnichannel marketing technologies, and data-driven engagement models**.
* **Strong experience with Azure & GCP cloud-native architectures**, including **microservices, API-led integration, and event-driven design**.
* Expertise in **developer enablement, DevSecOps, platform engineering, and technology governance**.
* Knowledge of **enterprise architecture frameworks** (TOGAF, Zachman) and ability to operate in a **federated model**.
* Proven leadership in **cross-functional teams, engineering collaboration, and technology governance**.
* Experience in **FinOps and cloud cost optimization strategies**.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* Proven experience in AI architecture, with a track record of successfully leading ML and deep learning strategy development and implementation. 9fd9ec10.title: ServiceNow Technical Architect
9fd9ec10.description:
**Overview**
------------

The ServiceNow Technical Architect is the technical design authority for complex, enterprise-scale solutions on the Now Platform. The role translates business and product requirements into secure, scalable, and supportable architectures, provides design governance through delivery, and helps AtkinsRéalis maximize value from its strategic ServiceNow investment.

Working within a global product-led environment, you will partner with product managers, process owners, enterprise architects, developers, administrators, delivery partners, and operational teams. You will balance strategic platform direction with practical delivery, promoting configuration over unnecessary customization and ensuring that solutions remain maintainable, upgradeable, and aligned to ServiceNow recommended practices.

The role is based in India and will collaborate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders across regions. Some working-time flexibility and occasional travel may be required to support global delivery and key program activities.

**Your role**
-------------

*Architecture and Solution Design*

* Act as technical design authority for medium-to-large ServiceNow initiatives and cross-platform solutions.
* Translate business, functional, and non-functional requirements into solution architectures, technical designs, integration patterns, and implementation guidance.
* Design for scalability, security, resilience, performance, accessibility, data quality, maintainability, and upgradeability.
* Define and maintain reusable architectural principles, patterns, guardrails, and decision records for the ServiceNow platform.
* Assess technical options and trade-offs, identify architectural debt, and recommend pragmatic remediation or modernization approaches.
* Ensure solutions align with AtkinsRéalis enterprise architecture, security, privacy, data, and integration standards.

*Technical Governance and Assurance*

* Lead or contribute to design reviews, technical assurance forums, and platform governance decisions.
* Review solution designs, code, configuration, and integration approaches, ensuring adherence to engineering standards and ServiceNow best practices.
* Identify technical, security, data, performance, and delivery risks early, with clear mitigation and escalation paths.
* Provide architecture oversight across the delivery lifecycle, including build, testing, release, transition, and early-life support.
* Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including high-level and detailed designs, interface specifications, data models, standards, and operational handover materials.

*Platform Engineering and Delivery Leadership*

* Guide the implementation of ServiceNow capabilities, integrations, workflows, and scoped applications, remaining close enough to delivery to validate feasibility and quality.
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to developers, administrators, and technical consultants, encouraging consistent engineering practices and knowledge sharing.
* Partner with product and delivery leads to shape roadmaps, sequence technical enablers, and estimate the architectural impact of proposed changes.
* Support troubleshooting of complex platform issues and lead root-cause analysis where architecture, integrations, data, or performance are contributing factors.
* Contribute to upgrade planning, platform health improvement, technical debt reduction, and continuous improvement.

*Stakeholder and Supplier Engagement*

* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders.
* Facilitate discovery and design workshops, challenge assumptions constructively, and build consensus around architectural decisions.
* Work effectively with internal teams and delivery partners, providing clear acceptance criteria and assurance expectations.
* Act as a trusted adviser on ServiceNow platform capabilities, limitations, implementation choices, and emerging technology.

**About you**
-------------

*Essential Experience*

* Typically 7+ years of ServiceNow delivery experience, including substantial experience as a Technical Architect, Lead Technical Consultant, or equivalent design authority on complex implementations.
* Demonstrable experience designing enterprise ServiceNow solutions across multiple products and shared platform capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of the Now Platform architecture, application and data models, security model, update and deployment mechanisms, development tooling, and implementation patterns.
* Hands-on architecture and delivery experience with core capabilities such as ITSM, ITOM, CMDB/CSDM, HR Service Delivery, Strategic Portfolio Management, Employee Center, IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, App Engine, Workspaces, and Platform Analytics.
* Experience designing integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, event-driven patterns, and enterprise middleware, with a clear approach to authentication, error handling, monitoring, and support.
* Strong JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting knowledge, including Glide APIs, Script Includes, Business Rules, client scripting, and scoped application development.
* Experience with technical governance, architecture reviews, coding standards, automated testing, release controls, platform upgrades, and performance optimization.
* Experience working in Agile and product-led delivery environments, with the ability to operate across multiple workstreams and geographically distributed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.

*Now Assist and Agentic AI Experience*

The successful candidate will bring practical awareness of how generative and agentic AI should be introduced safely and sustainably on the ServiceNow platform.

* Experience assessing, designing, configuring, or governing ServiceNow Now Assist capabilities, including relevant generative AI skills and user experiences.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow AI Agents, AI Agent Studio, and agentic workflows, including how agents use instructions, tools, enterprise context, and orchestration to complete tasks.
* Ability to identify appropriate AI use cases and define human oversight, approval, exception handling, and fallback controls for autonomous or semi-autonomous actions.
* Understanding of grounding and retrieval approaches, knowledge quality, prompt/instruction design, model selection considerations, and the risks of inaccurate or inappropriate AI output.
* Experience defining AI security and governance guardrails covering access controls, data exposure, auditability, testing, monitoring, responsible use, and production readiness.
* Ability to assess the architectural impact of AI features on licensing/consumption, operational support, integrations, data residency, and platform performance.
* Awareness of interoperability patterns for connecting ServiceNow with external AI assistants, models, or enterprise agent ecosystems.

*Qualifications and Certifications*

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Application Developer (CAD).
* One or more relevant Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) credentials.
* ServiceNow Architecture Excellence (ArchX), Certified Technical Architect (CTA), or Certified Master Architect (CMA) is highly desirable.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or equivalent service management knowledge is desirable.
* Relevant ServiceNow Now Assist, AI, or automation learning credentials are desirable.

*Technical Leadership*

* Systems thinking and sound architectural judgment.
* Ability to simplify complexity and make clear decisions.
* Strong design assurance and risk management.
* Coaching, mentoring, and technical influence.
* Commercial and delivery awareness.

*Ways of Working*

* Collaborative, inclusive, and outcome-focused.
* Comfortable challenging constructively.
* Curious and committed to continuous learning.
* Accountable, pragmatic, and self-managing.
* Able to work effectively across cultures and time zones.

*Measures of Success*

* Architectures are clear, proportionate, approved, and implementable, with risks and decisions visible.
* Solutions are secure, supportable, performant, and aligned to platform standards, with avoidable customization reduced.
* Delivery teams receive timely technical direction and issues are resolved or escalated early.
* Platform capability, technical quality, and reuse improve over time, while architectural debt is actively managed.
* Now Assist and agentic AI use cases are introduced with appropriate value measures, governance, testing, and human oversight.
* Stakeholders trust the architecture function and understand the rationale behind key technical decisions.

**Rewards & benefits**
----------------------

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.

This includes:

* Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
* Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
* Generous annual leave balance.
* Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
* Remote work opportunities outside of country.
* Company gratuity scheme.
* Discretionary bonus program.
* Relocation assistance.
* Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

d9725453.title: Senior Account Program Manager, EMEAI Creative Operations
d9725453.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.

Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

The Creative Operations team is the engine that helps get things done on our design projects. This includes global packaging, print, digital campaigns, websites, digital experiences, out-of-home, video, photography, product launches and physical events to showcase our technology. We need passionate, hard-working and creative people to help us take on some of these outstanding opportunities!

This role suits an experienced Program Manager who loves calendars, spreadsheets and has a superpower for crafting organisation from chaos. It is an operational role rather than a creative one.

**What you'll be doing:**

Lead complex, high-visibility creative programs from inception to success, using internal and external creative resources. You'll collaborate with designers, art directors, video and photography specialists, marketing, PR, sales, developers, event teams and outsourced vendors, ensuring everyone is singing from the same song sheet to achieve our goals.

This role has a strong focus on our global packaging work, so you'll be working with a worldwide team to ensure the timely delivery of quality creative assets to our internal clients, supporting many regions and languages globally. Alongside packaging, you'll lead work for major global events such as GTC, regional events including those in India, and always-on and launch work across print, digital, out-of-home and web. Our creative operations teams are dynamic and flexible, so we'll call on you to support and drive other areas as needs evolve.

**Account Management**

* Understand the processes, technologies, products, customers, campaign objectives and team dynamics of the businesses we serve.
* Be the responsive, go-to person accountable for the success of the groups we serve, building trust and a one-team mentality.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing and Creative Account Program Managers to prioritise workloads and align with campaign, launch and event timelines.
Act as a senior point of contact and path for blocking issues for collaborators, setting expectations clearly and managing them proactively.  

**Program / Project Management**

* Lead the planning of multi-workstream programs and events, running planning meetings between internal requesters and creative staff, and proactively communicating schedules, action items and owners.
* Work with requesters to build rock-solid briefs and action plans, including deliverables lists, milestones, project complexity and language requirements.
* Own the end-to-end packaging workflow, from brief through artwork, localisation, approvals and handoff to print and production partners, across many regions and languages.
* Understand the creative workflow across print, digital, out-of-home, web, video and photography: what a request requires, which reviews need to happen, who to include, and how long things take, so you can project actions and schedules accurately.
* Plan and deliver assets for major events, including global events like GTC and regional events such as those in India, coordinating on-site and off-site deliverables, signage, environmental graphics, content and production timelines.
* Coordinate production logistics where required, such as video and photography shoots, including locations, talent, props, gear, call sheets, catering and on-site support.
* Execute the plan, navigating uncertainty, course correcting, communicating and adjusting as required. Anticipate risks and obstacles and propose practical solutions to keep schedules and quality on track.
* Support dynamic resourcing of designers, vendors and production partners as projects inevitably shift during execution.
* Manage vendors and agencies, including briefing, scheduling, cost tracking and quality control.
* Ensure assets are delivered to spec, accurate, and up to quality and best-practice standards.
* Manage creative projects end to end, great and small, from programs with thousands of assets and tens of collaborators to the resizing of a single email banner.
* Mentor and support less experienced project and program managers, sharing best practice and helping to set standards for the team.
Drive continual process improvement by reviewing and evolving workflows for greater efficiency and effectiveness. Think creatively, try new things and foster a culture of continual improvement.  

**What we need to see:**

* 10+ years of experience in project or program management, production or creative operations within a corporate, studio or agency environment.
* Experience working with packaging projects, including multi-language and multi-region artwork.
* Proven experience delivering across multiple channels, such as print, digital, out-of-home and web, and familiarity with creative, multimedia and web development processes and file formats.
* Experience delivering events or event-related creative, with the ability to manage fixed, high-pressure deadlines.
* Excellent analytical, resourcing and project management skills.
* Outstanding organisational abilities and meticulous attention to detail, with the ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication and negotiation skills: clear, professional and proactive across all channels.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and act as a problem solver.
* Able to work effectively in a matrix organisation and with global, multi-time-zone teams.
* Comfortable in a fast-paced environment, able to create clarity from the unknown and adjust quickly to changing market and company needs.
* Flexibility to support key events and launches occasionally outside regular business hours, including evenings and weekends, and willingness to travel occasionally for events and on-site support.
* Experience with PM software (e.g. Workfront, Jira, MS Project, Trello).
Educated to degree level or equivalent experience.  

**Ways to stand out**

* AI literate – utilising tools and workflows to multiply your output.
* Extensive experience running packaging programs at global scale, including localisation and print production.
* Experience in creative project management, particularly in an in-house or agency creative operations team.
* Experience running global events or large-scale experiential programs, ideally including India or other regional events.
* Experience with video or photography projects.
Knowledge of Waterfall and Agile methodologies.  

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

The Zonal Solution Manager- TASC will act as a key enabler for delivering tailored payment and collection solutions to Institutional Banking clients. Qualifications: Post Graduate in Technology/Engineering

Experience: 7 to 10 years

1726c96f.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, PaySec, StoreSec
1726c96f.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it.  
  
Payments Security owns full-stack Product Security for Payments across Amazon and its business units. We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default.  
  
We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead how security scales across IESP. Our builders now write most new code with AI assistance and ship faster than ever before. Security cannot keep pace through manual reviews or by adding headcount. You will own the multi-year program that makes security automatic: security rules built into AI-assisted code creation, continuous assurance in place of point-in-time reviews, detection agents that find risk across production, and paved paths that bring acquired businesses and new markets onto the same controls.  
  
You will connect security strategy to the business. You will help IESP adopt AI quickly and safely, including AI agents that act on behalf of customers, so that security speeds up launches instead of slowing them down. You will own the team's operating plan and its business reviews with customers, define the metrics that show whether automation is reducing risk and builder effort, and run the quarterly security reviews that senior IESP leadership use to make decisions. Payment regulators in MENA, APAC, and South America expect strong security evidence, and a well-built automation program produces that evidence as a by-product.  
  
This role needs real technical depth. You will challenge architecture, data, detection, and AI agent design trade-offs with engineers and scientists, judge whether a proposed mechanism will work at scale, and explain the result to directors and vice presidents in clear writing.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the multi-year strategy and roadmap for security automation across IESP, with measurable outcomes such as risk reduced, coverage gained, and builder time saved.
* Drive adoption of security controls built into AI-assisted development tools, code review, and build pipelines across many engineering organizations.
* Lead the shift from manual, point-in-time security reviews to continuous, automated assurance, and decide with engineering leaders where human review still adds value.
* Partner with business and engineering leaders to adopt AI safely, including identity, consent, and guardrails for AI agents that act on behalf of customers.
* Drive programs that bring acquired businesses, third-party payment partners, and new markets onto Amazon's standard security controls, including security due diligence for acquisitions.
* Turn large volumes of security data into accurate, prioritized signals, and measure the precision and adoption of every automated control.
* Own the team's annual operating plan: size investments, make data-driven trade-offs between coverage, cost, and speed, and write the costed asks presented to IESP business leadership.
* Run customer-facing business reviews and quarterly security reviews for senior leadership, with precise metrics, clear denominators, and specific asks.
* Make sure the automation program produces continuous evidence that meets the security expectations of payment regulators and partners across IESP markets.
* Manage dependencies across security, engineering, science, compliance, and Amazon's central security platform teams, and raise risks early with a recommended path forward.
* Use AI tools to speed up planning, analysis, and cross-team status reporting.
* Mentor technical program managers and set the standard for how large security programs are run across Payments Security.

  
About the team  
IESP Payments Security is a single-threaded Business Security Team for all of International Emerging Stores Payments. We are security engineers, technical program managers, and software engineers working as one team. We own security for regulated payments and lending businesses, for acquired companies joining Amazon, and for new markets as they launch. We believe security scales through mechanisms and automation, not headcount. As AI writes more of the code our builders ship, we move security into the moment code is created and replace episodic reviews with continuous assurance. We invest in each other's growth as much as we invest in protecting our customers.  
  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why Amazon Security?  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.  
  
Training & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5+ years of software development experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience driving security programs across large diverse organizations
* Experience defining system architectures and exploring technical feasibility tradeoffs
* Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience with AI or machine learning programs, such as AI-assisted software development, LLM-based automation, or AI agents.
* Experience with payments or financial services, including security requirements from regulators in multiple countries.
* Experience with application security, secure software development life cycle, or continuous control monitoring.
* Experience driving adoption of security automation, developer tooling, or platforms across many engineering teams.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
